source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Mondloch transcription with ammendments by Vincent Stanzione. Popol Wuj opens with the narrator providing the context within which this Ancestral Story will be told as it is acted out through dance drama with its song and dance, narration and recitation as the Ancestral Word, Ojer Tzij, of the Kʼicheʼ Maya. Popol Wuj is a myth that brings out the ancestral soul of the Kʼicheʼ People or Kʼicheʼ Winaq who knew themselves as transformations and descendants of the mythic figures coming to life through the mythic language, Ojer Tzij, that Maya Kʼicheʼ speaking  scribes wrote out their ancestorsʼ ancestral story, Ojer Tzij, known to us today as Popol Wuj. So let us address this sacred text of Kʼicheʼ Winaq as sacred scripture because this is what the Popol Wuj was and continues to be for many Maya and non-Maya people.

Popol Wuj in many ways is a ʼdivineʼ language that is often more playful than solemn, because of this we ask that those who come to read this translation of Popol Wuj realize that it is a Native American text that is as light-hearted, playful, and humorous as it is serious, solemn, and somber. Here, at the beginning, the narrator invokes the Divine Ancestors who will make their presence felt throughout this transcription and translation of Popol Wuj as they are called into the recitation of their ancient ways, works, and words that brought forth the Sky-Earth and all that came to sprout forth into being to then begin the divine process of being formed and shaped by the ideas and images found here in the Popol Wuj.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
This makes the words of the Popol Wuj the very essence of the Kʼicheʼ Maya World or Sky-Earth within and upon which the descendents of the ancestors become the ʼreplacementsʼ of their ancient Mother-Fathers or Chuch-Qajaw who once intoned as they danced out this ancient, ancient Maya Kʼicheʼ myth as their truest of all truths that taught as it exemplified how a human being must act in order to become the replacement of their divine ancestors. This then is the Ancestral Story, Ojer Tzij, of the Kʼicheʼ Maya. This then is the Ancient Word, transcribed in Maya Kʼicheʼ and translated into English with the deepest desire to bring forth the essence of the Ancestral Language, Ojer Tzij, of the Kʼicheʼ People, Kʼicheʼ Winaq. In this way we will come to show that myth as ancestral language tells us of the past in the most beautiful way; a way in which the highest ethics and deepest truths of life come to magically reveal themselves through mythic language that opens our hearts and souls, minds and imagination to a world that in truth is never far away. Let us bring this world created by the Popol Wuj back to life through the collaboration of our thoughts and the cooperation of our imagination; and in this way allow in order to enable this Ancestral Myth of the Kʼicheʼ Maya known as the Popol WujMay to be born again in our cultural consciousness of one of this worldʼs most revitalizing myths. May it come to pass-Cha ta chuxoq!

[1r]	Areʼ uxeʼ Ojer Tzij waral Kʼicheʼ ubʼiʼ.

Waral xchiqatzʼibʼaj wi, xchiqatikibʼaʼ wi Ojer Tzij, utikaribʼal, uxeʼnabʼal puch ronojel xbʼan pa tinamit Kʼicheʼ, ramaqʼ Kʼicheʼ Winaq.

Areʼ kʼut xchiqakʼam wi ukʼutunisaxik, uqʼalajobʼsaxik, utzijoxik puch Ewaxibʼal [awaxibʼal], Saqiribʼal rumal Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alom, Kʼajolom kibʼiʼ; Jun Ajpu Uchʼ, Jun Ajpu Utiw, Saqi Nimaʼ Aq-Sis, Tepew Qʼukumatz, Ukʼuʼx Cho, Ukʼuʼx Palo, Ajraxa Laq, Ajraxa Tzel, chuchaxik.

Rach bʼixik, rach tzijoxik ri Iyom, Mamom, Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane ubʼiʼ; Matzanel, Chʼuqenel, kamul Iyom, kamul Mamom chuchaxik pa Kʼicheʼ Tzij.

Ta xkitzijoj ronojel rukʼ xkibʼan chik chi Saqil Kʼolem, Saqil Tzij.

Waʼe xchiqatzʼibʼaj chupam chik uchʼabʼal Dios.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Pa Christianoyil chik xchiqelesaj rumal majabʼiʼ chik ilbʼal re, Popo [Popol] Wuj, ilbʼal saq petenaq chʼaqa palo; utzijoxik qamuʼjibʼal, ilbʼal Saq Kʼaslem chuchaxik.

Kʼo nabʼe uwujil ojer tzibʼam puch.

Xa ewal [ewatal] uwach ilol re, bʼisol re.

Nim upeʼoxik, utzijoxik puch.

Ta chikʼis tzʼuq ronojel Kaj-Ulew: ukaj tzʼuquxik; ukaj xukutaxik retaxik, ukaj chʼexik, umej kʼaʼmaxik, uyuk kʼaʼmaxik upa Kaj, upa Ulew; Kaj Tzʼuq, Kaj Xukut chuchaxik rumal ri Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol; uchuch, uqajaw Kʼaslem Winaqirem; Abʼanel, Kʼuʼxlanel; Alay rech, Kʼuʼxlaʼay rech Saqil, Amaqʼil; Saqil Al, Saqil Kʼajol.

Ajbʼis, Ajnaʼoj chirech ronojel[1v]a ta kʼol wi Kaj-Ulew, Cho-Palo.

Areʼ utzijoxik waʼe:

Kʼa katzʼininoq, kʼa kachamamoq.

Katzʼinanik, kʼa kasilanik, kʼa kalolinik.

Kʼa tolona puch upa Kaj.

Waʼe kʼute Nabʼe Tzij uchan.

Majabʼiʼoq Jun Winaq, Jun Chikop, Tzʼikin, Kar, Tap, Cheʼ, Abʼaj, Jul, Siwan, Kʼim, Kʼicheʼlaj.

Xa utukel Kaj kʼolik.

Mawi qʼalaj Uwach Ulew.

Xa utukel remanik Palo.

Upa Kaj ronojel.

Majabʼiʼ naqilaʼ kamolobʼik, kakotzobʼik, jun ta kasilobʼik; kʼa mal kabʼan taj, kakotz kabʼan taj pa Kaj.

Xma kʼowi naqilaʼ kʼolik, yakalik.

Xa remanik Jaʼ, xa liyanik Palo, xa utukel remanik.

Xma kʼo wi naqilaʼ lo kʼolik.

Xa kachamanik.

Katzʼininik chi qʼequʼm, chi aqʼabʼ.

Xa utukel ri Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Tepew Qʼukumatz.

E Alom, e Kʼajolom kʼo pa Jaʼ.

Saqteʼtoj e kʼo wi.

E muqutal pa qʼuqʼ, pa raxon; areʼ ubʼinaʼam wi riʼ: Qʼukumatz.

E nimaʼq etaʼmanel, e nimaʼq ajnaʼoj chi kikʼojeʼik.

Kejeʼ kʼut xax kʼo wi ri Kaj.

Kʼo nayipuch Ukʼuʼx Kaj.

Areʼ ubʼiʼ ri kʼabʼawil kuchaxik.

Ta xpe kʼut utzij waral.

Xul kukʼ ri Tepew Qʼukumatz waral chi qʼequʼmal, chi aqʼabʼal.

Xchʼaw rukʼ ri Tepew Qʼukumatz.

Xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xenaʼojinik.

Ta xebʼisonik.

Xeriqow kibʼ.

Xkikuch kitzij, kinaʼoj ta xqʼalaj, ta IxKikʼuʼxlaʼj kibʼ xeʼ wi saq, ta xqʼalaj puch winaq.

Ta xkinaʼojij utzʼuqik [utzʼaqik], uwinaqirik cheʼ, kʼaʼm, utzʼuquxik [utzʼaqik] puch kʼaslem winaqirem chi qʼequʼmal, chi aqʼabʼal rumal ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj; Juraqan ubʼiʼ.

[2r]Kaqulja Juraqan nabʼe.

Ukabʼ kʼut Chʼipi Kaqulja.

Rox chik Raxa Kaqulja.

Chi e kʼu oxibʼ ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj.

Ta xeʼul kukʼ ri Tepew Qʼukumatz.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xnaʼojixik Saq Kʼaslem.

“Jupa chaʼ ta chawaxoq, ta saqiroq puch? Apachinaq tzuqul, kʼoʼl? Ta chuxoq!

Kixnoʼjin taj: Areʼ ri jaʼ chel taj. Chi jamaʼ taj. Chi winaqir waʼ Ulew.

Ulaqel ta kʼu ribʼ chʼata kʼut.

Ta chawaxoq; ta saqiroq Kaj-Ulew!

Ma ta kʼut uqʼijilabʼal, uqʼalaʼibʼal ri qatzʼaq, ri qabʼit.

Ta winaqiroq: Winaq Tzʼaq, Winaq Bʼit,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xwinaqir kʼu ri Ulew kumal.

Xa kitzij xkʼoje wi uwinaqirik chi winaqir Ulew: “ULEW!,” xechaʼ.

Libʼaj chi xwinaqirik: kejeʼ ri xa sutzʼ, xa mayul uwinaqirik chik, upupujeʼik.

Ta xtape [xtaseʼ] pa jaʼ ri juyubʼ.

Jusukʼ nimaʼq juyubʼ xuxik.

Xa kinawal, xa kipus xbʼanataj wi unaʼojixik juyub-taqʼaj.

Jusukʼ rach winaqirik ukʼisisil upa chajil uwach.

Kejeʼ kʼut xkiʼkot wi ri Qʼukumatz.

“Utz mixatulik, at Ukʼuʼx Kaj, at Juraqan, at Chʼipi-Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja.

Xchutzinik qatzʼaq, qabʼit,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Nabʼe kʼut xwinaqir Ulew: juyub-taqʼaj.

Xchʼobʼochʼox ubʼe jaʼ; xbʼinijeʼik.

Kʼole jeʼ raqan xoʼl taq juyubʼ.

Xa chʼobʼol chik xekʼojeʼ wi jaʼ.

Ta xkʼutunijeʼik Nimaʼq Juyubʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼut uwinaqirik Ulew riʼ ta xwinaqirik kumal ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Ukʼuʼx Ulew keʼuchaxik.

Riʼ kʼut e nabʼe xkinoʼjij.

Xkʼolo [kʼola]wi ri Kaj, xkʼolo [kʼola] nayipuch Ulew chupam Jaʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼut unoʼjixik riʼ ta xkinoʼjij, ta xkibʼisoj rutzinik, ubʼana[2v]tajik kumal.

Ta xkinoʼjij chik uchikopil juyubʼ, chajal re kʼicheʼlaj, ronojel uwinaqil juyubʼ: ri kej, tzʼikin, koj, bʼalam, kumatz, sochoj, kʼantiʼ, chajal kʼaʼm.

Kachaʼ ri Alom, Kʼajolom: “Xa pa chi lolinik, ma xa on chi tzʼininik uxeʼ cheʼ, kʼaʼm.

Kʼateʼ utz chi kʼojeʼ chajal re,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xkinoʼjij, xkitzijoj puch.

Jusukʼ xwinaqir kej, tzʼikin.

Ta xkisipaj kʼut rochoch kej, tzʼikin.

“At kej, pa bʼe yaʼ, pa siwan katwar wi.

Waral katkʼojeʼ wi.

Pa kʼim, pa saqʼul, pa kʼecheʼlaj [Kʼicheʼlaj] kipoqo wi iwibʼ.

Kajkaj ibʼinibʼal, ichakabʼal chuxik,” xeʼuchaʼxik ta xkichʼik kʼut kochoch chʼuti tzʼikin, nima tzʼikin.

“Ix ix tzʼikin, chuwiʼ cheʼ, chuwiʼ kʼaʼm kixochochin wi, kixjaʼin wi.

Chiriʼ kixpoqʼ wi, kixkʼiritaj wi chuqʼabʼ cheʼ, chuqʼabʼ kʼaʼm,” xeʼuchaʼxik kej, tzʼikin.

Ta xkibʼano kibʼanoj.

Ronojel xukʼamo uwarabʼal, uyakalibʼal.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kejeʼ kʼut kochoch wi chikop ri ulew xuyaʼo Alom, Kʼajolom.

Xutzininaqa chik ronojel ri kej, tzʼikin.

Ta xeʼuchax chi kʼut ri kej, tzʼikin rumal Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alom, Kʼajolom.

“Kixchʼawoq kixsikʼinoq. Mixyonolikinik, mixsikʼinik.

Kixchʼawajeʼ taj chi jununal, chu jutaq chobʼil, chi jutaq molajil,” xeʼuchaxik ri kej, tzʼikin, koj, bʼalam, kumatz.

“Chibʼij na kʼut ri qabʼiʼ, kojiqajarisaj, oj ichuch, oj iqajaw.

Kixchʼawa [kixchʼawa]na kʼut: Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja, Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Ukʼuʼx Ulew, Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alom, Kʼajolom.[3r]Kixchʼaʼoq, kojisikʼij, kojiqʼijilaʼ,” xeʼuchaʼxik.

Ma kʼu xutzinik xechʼawik kʼeje ta ri winaq.

Xa kewachʼelajik.

Xa kekʼaralajik, xa kewojonik.

Mawi xwachinik uwach kichʼabʼal.

Jalajoj xkoqʼibʼej chi kijujunal.

Ta xkita ri Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol.

“Mawi mixutzinik, mixechʼawik,” xechaʼ chik chi kibʼil kibʼ.

“Mawi mixutzin ubʼixik qabʼiʼ rumal, oj kajtzʼaq, oj pu kajbʼit. Mawi utz,” xchaʼ chik chi kibʼil kibʼ ri Alom, Kʼajolom.

Xeʼuchax kʼut: “Xa kixjalatajik rumal mawi mixutzinik, mawi mixixchʼawik. Mi kʼu xqajal qatzij: iwechaʼ, ikʼuxuʼn, iwarabʼal, iyakalibʼal, ri iwech wi, mixeʼuxik siwan, kʼecheʼlaj rumal mawi xutzin qaqʼijiloʼxik, mawi ixsikʼiy qe. Kʼa kʼo, kʼo wi lo qʼijiloʼnel, nimanel chi qabʼan chik. Xa chikʼam ipatan, xa itiyoʼjil chikachʼik. Ta chuxoq! Areʼ kʼut chipatanij,” xeʼuchaxʼik ta xepixabʼaxik chʼuti chikop, nima chikop kʼo chuwach ulew.

Ta xraj kʼu kitij chik kiqʼij, xraj kitijtobʼej chik.

Xraj pu kinukʼ chik qʼijilabʼal.

Xma xkita kichʼabʼal chi kibʼil kibʼ.

Xma xnawachir wi kʼut.

Xma xbʼanataj wi puch.

Kejeʼ kʼut xechʼakataj [xekachʼataj] wi kitiyoʼjil.

Xkipatanij xetiʼik, xekamisaxik ri chikop kʼo waral chuwach ulew.

Kejeʼ kʼut utijtobʼexik chi winaq tzʼaq, winaq bʼit kumal Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alom, Kʼajolom.

“Xa qatijaʼ chik, mixyopij rawexik, usaqirik? Qabʼanaʼ tzuqul qe, kʼoʼl qe. Jupachaʼ ta kojsikʼixoq, ta kojnabʼax puch chuwach ulew? Mixqatijo chirech ri nabʼe qatzʼaq, qa[3v]bʼit. Mawi mixutzinik qaqʼijiloʼxik, qaqʼaʼlajixik puch kumal. Kejeʼ kʼut qatijaʼ wi ubʼanik ajnim, ajxobʼ, tzuqul, kʼoʼl,” xechaʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta utzʼaqik kʼut, ubʼanik puch: ulew xoqʼoʼl utiyoʼjil xkibʼano; ma kʼu utz xkilo.

“Xa chi yojomanik, xa tubʼulik, xa nebʼelik, xa lubʼanik, xa wulanik, xa pu chiʼumarik. Mawi chi kʼolol ujolom. Xa jun bʼenaq wi uwach. Xa kuʼl uwach. Mawi chiʼ muqun chirij.Chichʼaw nabʼek; majabʼiʼ unaʼoj. Xa jusukʼ chiʼumar pa jaʼ. Mawi ko,” xechaʼ chi kʼu ri Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit.

“Kawach labʼeq ta chuxoq. Xa labʼe, mawi chibʼinik, ma pu chipoqʼotajik. Ta chuxoq! Xa unaʼoj chiriʼ,” xechaʼ.

Ta xkiyoj kʼut.

Xkiyoqʼ chik ri kitzʼaq, kibʼit.

Xechaʼ chi kʼut: “Jupachaʼ qi chi qabʼano? Chutzin ta wi, chinawachir ta wi qʼijiloʼy qech, sikʼiy qech?”

Xechaʼ ta xkinaʼojij chik: “Xa qabʼij chike Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane; Jun Ajpu Wuchʼ, Jun Ajpu Utiw. Kitijaʼ chik uqʼijixik, ubʼitaxik,” xeʼuchan qi kibʼ Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit.

Ta xkibʼij kʼut chire Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ubʼixik riʼ chikech ri e nikwachinel, Ratiʼt Qʼij, Ratiʼt Saq keʼuchaxik kumal ri Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol.

Areʼ kibʼiʼ riʼ: Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane.

Xechaʼ kʼu ri Juraqan rukʼ Tepew Qʼukumatz.

Ta xkibʼij chirech Ajqʼij, Ajbʼit, e Nikwachinel: “Xukʼulu [Xa chukʼulu], xa pu churiqo cheʼ ta chik.Chi qawinaq bʼitoj, chi qawinaq tzʼaqoj ta chik tzuqul, kʼoʼl. Kojsikʼix taj, kojnaʼbʼax taj puch. Katok ta kʼut pa tzij Iyom, Mamom, Qatiʼt, Qamam, Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane. Cha taj ta chawaxoq, ta saqiroq qasikʼixik, qatoqʼexik, qa[4r]nabʼaxik rumal winaq tzʼaq, winaq bʼit, winaq poy, winaq anom. Cha ta chuxoq! Chi kʼutun ibʼiʼ Jun Ajpu Wuchʼ, Jun Ajpu Utiw, Kamul Alom, Kamul Kʼajolom, Nim Aq, Nima Sis, Ajkʼuʼal, Ajyamanik, Ajchʼut,Ajtzʼalam, Ajraxa Laq, Ajraxa Tzel, Ajqʼol, Ajtoltekat, Ratiʼt Qʼij, Ratiʼt Saq kixuchaxik rumal qatzʼaq, qabʼit. Chimalaʼ chi ixim chi tzʼiteʼ. Xa chi bʼanatajik, xa pu chel apanoq. Chi qajaj, chi qakʼotaj puch uchiʼ, uwach cheʼ,” xeʼuchaxik e ajqʼij.

Kʼateʼ puch uqajik, uqʼijiloʼxik riʼ.

Xmalik chi ixim, chi tzʼiteʼ.

“Qʼij, bʼit,” xechaʼ kʼu ri jun atiʼt, jun mamaʼ chikech.

Areʼ ri mamaʼ areʼ ajtzʼiteʼ, Xpiyakok ubʼiʼ.

Areʼ kʼu ri atiʼt ajqʼij, ajbʼit chi raqan, IIxMuqkane ubʼiʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xechaʼ kʼut ta xkitikibʼaʼ qʼij: “Xa chukʼuluʼ, xa pu churiqo. Chabʼij. Kuta [Kuta]qaxikin, kachʼawik, katzijon taj. Xa chukʼulu ri cheʼ chajawaxoq, chikʼotox puch kumal Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit. We areʼ tzuqul, kʼoʼl ta chawaxoq, ta saqiroq! At ixim, at tzʼiteʼ, at qʼij, at bʼit katchokonik, kataqen taj,” xchaʼ chire ixim, tzʼiteʼ, qʼij, bʼit.

“Katkixlaʼ uloq, at Ukʼuʼx Kaj. Ma qajisaj uchiʼ, uwach Tepew Qʼukumatz,” xechaʼ ta xkibʼij kʼut usukʼulikil.

“Utz areʼ chuxik ri ipoy, ajam cheʼ. Chichʼawik, chitzijon bʼaʼ laʼ chuwach ulew. Ta chuxoq!” xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xkibʼij jusukʼ xbʼanik poy, ajam cheʼ. Xewinaq-wachinik, xewinaq-tzijonik puch; areʼ[u]winaqil uwach ulew xeʼuxik, xepoqʼik, xemeʼalanik, xekʼajolanik ri poy, ajam cheʼ.

Ma kʼu ja bʼiʼ kikʼuʼx; ma pu jabʼiʼ kinaʼoj; mawi naʼtal kajtzʼaq, kajbʼit.

Xa loqʼ xebʼinik, xecha[4v]kanik. Mawi xkinaʼtaj chik ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj; kejeʼ kʼut xepaj chiri. Xa utijtoʼbʼexik, xa pu uwabʼabʼexik chi winaq.

Kechʼaw nabʼek, xa chaqiʼj kiwach. Mana sonol [sanal] kaqan, kiqʼabʼ. Majabʼiʼ kikikʼel, kikomajil. Majabʼiʼ kitikowal, kikabʼchiyal. Chaqiʼj kotz, kʼoj kiwach. Kʼapichipoj kaqan, kiqʼabʼ, kʼa yeyoj kitiyoʼjil. Kejeʼ kʼut mawi xenaw chiwi chuwach Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alay kech, Kʼuʼxlaʼay kech.

E nabʼe tzatz chi winaq xeʼuxikwaral chuwach ulew.

[This is where our corrected Kʼicheʼ text from November ended—see/compare the “Draft Kiche-first section” file]

Kʼateʼ kʼut kikʼisik chik, kimaʼixik, kiqʼutuxik puch. Xekamisax chik poy, ajam cheʼ. Ta xnaʼojix kibʼutik rumal UkʼuʼxKaj; nima bʼutik xbʼanik; xpe pa kiwiʼ ri e poy, e ajam cheʼ.

Tzʼiteʼ utiyoʼjil ri achij ta xajaxik rumal Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol. Ixoq sibʼak kʼut utiyoʼjil ixoq xraj okik rumal Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol.

Mawi xenawik. Ma pu xechʼawik chuwach kajtzʼaq, kajbʼit, bʼanol ke, winaqirsay kech.

Kejeʼ kʼut kikamisaxik, xebʼutik. Xpe nima qʼol chilaʼ chi kaj. Xekʼotkʼowach ubʼiʼ; xkʼotin uloq ubʼaqʼ kiwach. Xepe kamalotz [Kama Sotzʼ] xkʼupin ula kijolom.

Xpe Kotz Bʼalam xtiʼow kitiyoʼjil.

Xpe Tukum Bʼalam xtukinik, kichowik kibʼaqil, kibʼochʼil.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xqajixik, xmuchulixik kibʼaqil, qajisabʼal kiwach rumal mawi kinawik [kenawik] chuwach kichuch, chuwach puch kiqajaw: ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Juraqan ubʼiʼ kumal.

Xqʼequʼmarik uwachulew: xtikarik qʼeqal jabʼ, qʼijil jabʼ, aqʼabʼal jabʼ.

Xok ula chʼuti chikop, nima chikop.

Xqʼut kiwach rumal cheʼ abʼaj.

Xchʼawik ronojel kiqʼeʼbʼal [5r] kixot, kilaq, kibʼoʼj, kitzʼiʼ, kikaʼ, jaruj pa laʼ ronojel xkʼutuw kiwach.

“Kʼax xibʼan chiqe: xojitiʼyo, ix chi kʼut xkixqatiʼ chik!” xchaʼ ri kitzʼiʼ, kakʼ chikech.

Are kʼu ri kaʼ: “Xojkʼokʼonik iwumal. Juta qʼij, juta qʼij; xqʼek-xsaqiririk. Amaqʼel joli, joli, jukʼi, jukʼi qawach iwumal. Areʼ ta nabʼe qapatan chiwach, ix ta na winaq. Wakamik kʼut xchitij qachuqʼabʼ. Xchiqakeʼej, xchiqajokʼ puch itiyoʼjil,” xchaʼ ri kikaʼ chike.

Are kʼu ri kitzʼiʼ xchaʼ chik ta xchʼawik: “Nakipaʼ rumal mawi chiyaʼ qawa? Xa kojmuqunik, xa pu kojikʼuxij, kojitzaq[itzaq] pu uloq.Yakal ubʼi qacheʼel iwumal ta kixwaʼik. Xere kojiwuchaʼaj wi, mawi kojchʼawik. Mata kʼu mixojkamik chiwe. Jupa chaʼ mawi mixixnawik, xixnaw ta kʼut. Chiwij ta kʼut xojsach wi. Wakamik kʼut xchitij qabʼaq kʼo pa qachiʼ. Xkixqatiʼo,” xechaʼ ri tzʼiʼ chike.

Ta xqʼut kiwach.

Areʼ chi kʼu ri kixot, kibʼoʼj xchʼaw chik chike: “Kʼax waʼ xibʼan chiqe. Xaq qachiʼ, xaq qawach, amaqʼel oj tzaqal chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ. Kojikʼato. Mawi kʼax xqanaʼo? Xchitij kʼut x kixqaporoj,” xchaʼ kibʼoʼj ronojel xqʼutuw kiwach.

Areʼ ri abʼaj, ri kixkʼubʼ chitaninik chipe pa qʼaqʼ, taqal chi kijolom. Kʼax xbʼan chike.

Anilabʼik kemalmalijabʼ chik.

Keraj aqʼanik chuwiʼ ja.

Xa chi wulij ja, ketzaq uloq.

Keraj aqʼan chuwiʼ cheʼ, kechʼakix uloq ruma [rumal]cheʼ.

[5v] Keraj ok pa jul.

Xa chiyuch jul chi kiwach. Kejeʼ kʼut ukayojik winaq tzʼaq, winaqbʼit, e tzixel, e tzalatzoxel chiwinaq. Xmayixik. Xqʼutuxik kichiʼ, kiwach konojel.

Xchaʼ kʼut areʼ retal ri kʼoy kʼo pa kʼecheʼlaj wakamik. Areʼ xkʼoje wi retal rumal xa cheʼ kitiyoʼjil xkojik rumal Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit. Areʼ kʼu ri kʼoy kejeʼ ri winaq chiwachinik, retal ju leʼ Winaq Tzʼaq, Winaq Bʼit.

Xa Poy, xa pu Ajam Cheʼ.

ACTA DOS: Chʼakatajik Wuqubʼ Kaqix, Sipakna, Kabʼraqan

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼut xa jubʼiqʼ saqnatanoj uwach ulew, ma jabʼiʼ qʼij. Jun kʼut kunimarisaj ribʼ: Wuqubʼ Kaqix ubʼiʼ. Kʼo nabʼe Kaj-Ulew. Xa kamoymot uwach qʼij, ikʼ.

Kachaʼ kʼu riʼ: “Xawi xere usaqetal winaq ri xbʼutik. Kejeʼ ri Nawal Winaq ukʼojeʼik. In nim kikʼojeʼ chik chuwiʼ Winaq Tzʼaq, Winaq Bʼit. In uqʼij, in pu usaq, in nayi pu rikʼil, ta chuxoq! Nim nusaqil, in bʼinibʼal, in pu chakabʼal rumal winaq; rumal pwaq ubʼaqʼ nuwach xa katiltotik chi yamanik, raxa kʼuwal nayipu we; rax kawakoj chi abʼaj kejeʼ ri uwa kaj. Areʼ kʼu ri nutzaʼm saq julujuj chi naj kejeʼ ikʼ. Puwaq kʼut nuqʼaʼlibʼal, kʼa saq pakeʼ uwach ulew ta kinel uloq chuwach nuqʼaʼlibʼal. Kejeʼ kʼut in qʼij wi, in pu ikʼ rumal Saqil Al, Saqil Kʼajol. Ta chuxoq! Rumal chi naj kopon wi nuwach,” chaʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Ma kʼu tzij areʼ ta qʼij ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix; xere kunimarisaj ribʼ, ri uxikʼ, upuwaq; xere kʼut tokʼol wi uwach ri chi kubʼeʼ wi; mana ronejel ta [6r] uxeʼ kaj kopon wi uwach.

Majaʼ kʼut qi kiloq uwach qʼij, ikʼ, chʼumil; majaʼoq kasaqiroq. Kejeʼ kʼut kuqʼobʼisaj wi ribʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix chi qʼijil, chi ikʼil.

Xa maja chi kʼutunoq chi qʼalajobʼoq usaqil qʼij, ikʼ. Xa xurayij nimal ikʼowen areʼ ta xbʼanik bʼutik kumal Poy, Ajam Cheʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼut xchiqabʼij chik ta xkamik Wuqubʼ Kaqix, ta xchʼakatajik, ta xbʼanatajik winaq rumal Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit.

Waʼe uxeʼ uchʼakatajik uyiqoxik chi puch uqʼij Wuqubʼ Kaqix kumal e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ: Jun Ajpu ubʼiʼ jun, Xbʼalanke ubʼiʼ ukabʼ.

Xawi e kʼabʼawil rumal itzel xkilo ri nimarisay ribʼ xraj ubʼan chuwach Ukʼuʼx Kaj.

Xchaʼ kʼu ri kʼajolabʼ: “Mawi utz chuxoq. Mawi chikʼaseʼ winaq waral chuwach ulew. Kejeʼ kʼut chi qatij uwabʼaxik. Chuwiʼ rechaʼ chi qawubʼaj wi. Chiriʼ chiqakoj wi uyabʼ.Ta kʼisoq uqʼinomal, uxit, upwaq, ukʼwal, uyamanik ri kuqʼaqʼabʼej. Kejeʼ kʼut chubʼano ronojel winaq. Mawi areʼ chiwinaqir wi qʼaqʼal riʼ xa puwaq. Ta chuxoq!” xechaʼ ri kʼajolabʼ, jujun chi ubʼ kitelem kikabʼichal.

Areʼ kʼu ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix e kaʼibʼ ukʼajol: areʼ nabʼeʼal ri Sipakna; ukabʼal chi kʼut Kabʼraqan. Chimalmat kʼut ubʼiʼ kichuch, rixoqil ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼu ri Sipakna areʼ chire chaʼaj ri nimaʼq juyubʼ riʼ: Chi Qʼaqʼ, JunAjpu, Pekul Ya, Xkanul, Makamobʼ, Julisnabʼ chuchaxik ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xkʼolik ta chi saqirik.

Xa jun aqʼabʼ chiwinaqirik [6v] rumal ri Sipakna.

Areʼ riʼ chi kʼu ri Kabʼraqan chisilabʼ juyubʼ rumal.

Chinebʼowik chʼuti juyubʼ nima juyubʼ rumal.

Xawi kejeʼ nimarsabʼal kibʼ xkibʼano ukʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

“Ix [In] waʼ in qʼij,” xchaʼ Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

“In waʼ, in bʼanol ulew,” xchaʼ ri Sipakna.

“In chi kʼut chinkiyow kaj. Chinwulij ronojel ulew,” xchaʼ ri Kabʼraqan.

Xawi ukʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix, xawi chiriʼ IxKikʼam wi kinimal chirij kiqajaw.

Areʼ kʼut itzel xkil ri kʼajolabʼ. Majaʼ chibʼantajoq qanabʼe chuch, qanabʼe qajaw.

Kejeʼ kʼut xnoʼjix wi kikamik, kisachik kumal kʼajolabʼ.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ uwubʼaxik Wuqubʼ Kaqix rumal kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ.

Xchaqabʼij kichʼakatajik chi kijujunal ri nimarisaj ribʼ.

Areʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix jun nima cheʼ, ri tapaʼl areʼ kʼu rechaʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Areʼ chuloʼ ri uwach tapaʼl chaqʼan chuwiʼ cheʼ juta qʼij. Xiloma kʼut rechabʼal kumal ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Kikʼakʼalem chi kʼut chuxeʼ cheʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix. E matzamoj ulo ri kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ pa xaq cheʼ ta xopon kʼut [kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ] Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Taqal chuwiʼ rechaʼ, ri tapaʼl. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xwubʼaxik kumal ri Jun Jun Ajpu [Jun Ajpu]. Taqal ubʼaqʼ ubʼ chu kakateʼ. Churaquj uchiʼ ta xpe chuwiʼ cheʼ, taqal chuwach ulew.

Chimalmat kʼut ri Jun Jun Ajpu[Jun Ajpu], anim xbʼek. Qi tzij wi xbʼe uchapaʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xqupix ula uqʼabʼ ri Jun JunAjpu [Jun Ajpu] rumal ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix. [7r] Jusukʼ xtzaq uloq, xmejo uloq tzaʼm utelebʼ. Ta xutzoqopij chi kʼut Jun Jun Ajpu [Jun Ajpu] ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Xawi utz xkibʼano ma na bʼa kichʼakatajik taj rumal Wuqubʼ Kaqix. Ukʼaʼm chi kʼut uqʼabʼ ri Jun Jun Ajpu [Jun Ajpu] rumal ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix ta xbʼe chi rochoch.

Xa chi kʼu ulotʼom [ulotʼem] ukakateʼ xoponik.

“Naki paʼ mixkʼamow chilaʼ?” xchaʼ kʼu ri Chimalmat, rixoqil Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Nakipaʼ riʼ? Ri e kaʼibʼ kʼaxtokʼ mixikiwubʼaj. Mixsilabʼataj nukakateʼ rumal. Xa kachuywaj eʼ we, kaqʼoxow chik. Mi nabʼe mixnukʼam uloq, chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ kʼut chixekeʼ wi. Chitzayabʼaʼ chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ ta kulkikʼamaʼ chik. Qitzij chi e kʼaxtokʼ,” xchaʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Ta xuxekebʼaʼ uqʼabʼ ri Jun Jun Ajpu [Jun Ajpu]. Kinaʼojinik chik ri Jun Jun Ajpu [Jun Ajpu], Xbʼalanke. Ta xkibʼij kʼut chirech jun mamaʼ. Qitzij saq chik rismal wiʼ chi mamaʼ.

Jun kʼu atiʼt qi tzij kemel atiʼt chik. Xa keluqʼukilaʼ chik chi riʼj itaq winaq: Saqi Nim Aq ubʼiʼ mamaʼ, Saqi Nima Sis kʼut ubʼiʼ, atiʼt.

Xechaʼ kʼu ri kʼajolabʼ chike ri atiʼt, mamaʼ: “Kixqachiʼlaj taj, chibʼetakʼamaʼ qaqʼabʼ rukʼ Wuqubʼ Kaqix. Xa kojtereʼ chiwij:

«“Kʼi ri qamam ri qachbʼilaʼn. Kaminaq kichuch kiqajaw. Kejeʼ kʼut ketereʼ kekotila wi chiqij. Ta laʼ keqasipaj wi rumal xa elesan uchikopil eyaj kaqabʼano,” kixchaʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼu riʼ oj akʼalabʼ chirilo ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Xawi oj kojyaʼwik inaʼoj,» xechaʼ ri e kaibʼ kʼajolabʼ.

“Utz bʼa laʼ,” xechaʼ[7v] kʼut.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xebʼek.

Tzamal [Tzalan]kʼu bʼi ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix chuwach uqʼaʼlibʼal ta xeʼikʼowik ri atiʼt, mamaʼ. Keʼetzʼeyaj kʼu ri e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ chikij. Ta xeʼikʼow chuxeʼ rochoch ajaw kuraquj kʼu uchiʼ ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix rumal re. Ta xril kʼut Wuqubʼ Kaqix ri mamaʼ, atiʼt kachbʼiʼlan kibʼ.

“Apa kixpe wi qamam?” xchaʼ kʼu ri ajaw.

“Xa oj tzuqbʼey qibʼ, lal ajaw,” xechaʼ kʼut. “Nakipaʼ itzuqubʼal, ma iwalkʼuʼal ri iwachbʼiʼlan?”

“Ma jabʼiʼ, lal ajaw, e qamam riʼ. Xere na re kaqatoqʼobʼaj kiwach ri iyaʼxel. Jupir chʼaqaʼp kaqayaʼ chikech, lal ajaw,” xechaʼ kʼut ri atiʼt, mamaʼ.

Kutzin kʼu ri ajaw rumal uqʼoxom reʼy, xa kunimaq wachij chik kachʼawik.

“In ta bʼaʼ kanij chiwech, chitoqʼobʼaj ta nuwach. Nakipaʼ qi chibʼano? Nakiʼon qi chikunaj?” xchaʼ kʼut ajaw.

“Xa uchikopil eyaj chiqelesaj; xa kʼu ubʼaqʼ wach chiqakunaj, xa bʼaq kaqawiqo, lal ajaw,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, chikunaj ta bʼaʼ weʼy. Qitzij kaqʼoxowik juta qʼij. Mawi chiqʼitajik. Ma jabʼiʼ nuwaram rumal rukʼ ubʼaqʼ nuwach. Xa xinkiʼwubʼaj e kaʼibʼ kʼaxtokʼ. Ta xtikarik mawi kinechajik rumal. Kejeʼ ta kʼut chitoqʼobʼaj wi nuwach, xa kachʼuyubʼ weʼy jeʼ chikri weʼy.”

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, lal ajaw. Chikop bʼaʼ kaqʼuxuwik. Xa chok ukʼexel chel ri e la.”

“Ma bʼaʼ utz lo chel ri weʼy rumal xere in ajaw wi, nukowibʼal ri weʼy rukʼ ubʼaqʼ nuwach.”

“Xchiqakoj chik na kʼut ukʼexel; jokʼom bʼaq xchok chik.” Areʼ kʼut jokʼom bʼaq xriʼ, xa saqi ixim.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ chiwelesaj. Chitoʼoʼ uloq,” xchaʼ kʼut. Ta xel kʼu ri [8r] re Wuqubʼ Kaqix. Xa saqi ixim ukʼexel re xokik. Xa chi kʼu saq julujuj chi ula ixim pu chiʼ.

Jusuʼ kʼu xqaj uwach, mawi ajaw chik xwachinik. Xkʼis elik ri reʼy kʼuwal rax kawakoj pu chiʼ. Ta xkunax chikʼut ubʼaqʼ uwach Wuqubʼ Kaqix, ta xchʼolik ubʼaqʼ uwach, xkʼis elik ri puwaq.

Mana kʼax taj xunaʼo; xawi xere kamuqunik ta xkʼis kʼu elik ri unimarisabʼal ribʼ.

Xawi kinaʼoj ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke; ta xkam kʼut ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix; ta xukʼam kʼut uqʼabʼ ri Jun Ajpu. Xkam nayipuch Chimalmat, rixoqil Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Kejeʼ kʼut usachik uqʼinomal Wuqubʼ Kaqix riʼ. Xa ajkun xkʼamowik ri kuʼwal yamanik xupunabʼejwaral chuwach ulew. Nawal atiʼt, nawal mamaʼ xbʼanowik ta IxKikʼam kʼut kiqʼabʼ xtikitax [xtikixtaj] ukoq. Utz chik xuxik. Xa rumal ukamik Wuqubʼ Kaqix xkaj, kejeʼ xkibʼano. Itzel xkilo ri nimarisabʼal ibʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut xebʼe chik e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ; xa utzij ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj ta xkibʼano.

Waʼe chi kʼuteʼ ubʼanoj chik Sipakna, unabʼe kʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

“In bʼanol juyubʼ,” kachaʼ ri Sipakna. Areʼ kʼu ri Sipakna katinik chuchiʼ jaʼ ta xeʼikʼowik omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ, e juruy cheʼ raqan kikabʼal.

Omuchʼ chubʼinik. Ta xkiqʼat kʼut jun [8v] nima cheʼ uwapalil kikabʼal. Kʼateʼ kʼut xbʼe ri Sipakna, xopon kʼu chilaʼ kukʼ ri omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ.

“Nakipaʼ kibʼano, ix kʼajolabʼ?”

“Xa cheʼ mawi kaqayako chitelebʼaʼ”

“Xchintelej, apa kopon wi.”

“Nakipaʼ uchak chi ikʼuʼx?”

“Xa uwapalil qakabʼal.”

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut.

Ta xujuruj kʼut, xutelebʼaʼ kʼu aqʼanoq chuchiʼ kikabʼal omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ.

“Xa ta wi katkʼojeʼ qukʼ, at kʼajol. Kʼo pa achuch, aqajaw?”

“Ma jabʼiʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut.

“Kaqachakimaj ta na bʼaʼ laʼ chweʼq chuwabʼaxik jun qacheʼ, raqan qakabʼal.”

“Utz,” xchaʼ chi kʼut.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kʼateʼ kʼut xkʼam kinaʼoj ri omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ: “Areʼ ri ala, jupachaʼ chiqabʼan chire. Chiqakamisaj taj rumal mawi utz ri kubʼano. Xa utukel mixuyak ri cheʼ. Qakʼotoʼ jun nima jul. Chiriʼ ta kʼut chi qatzaq wi pa jul.”

“Jakʼamaʼ qaja ulew pa jul,” kojchaʼ ta chire. Chi areʼ ta kʼut pachal qajoq pa jul ta qatarij qajoq ri nima cheʼ. Chiriʼ ta kʼut chikam wi pa jul,” xechaʼ kʼut omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ.

Ta IxKikʼot kʼut jun nima jul, najt xqajik.

Ta xkitaq kʼut ri Sipakna: “Oj kanij chawech. Chibʼe ta akʼotoʼ chik ulew; mawi kaqariqo,” xuchaxik.

“Utz bʼaʼ la,” xchaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xqaj pa jul.

“Kasikʼin uloq ta kʼototajoq ri ulew, naj ta chiqajik awumal,” xuchaʼxik.

“We!” xchaʼ kʼut. Ta xutikibʼaʼ ukʼotik jul. Xa kʼu ujul xukʼoto, ukolbʼal ribʼ. Xretaʼmaj ri ukamisaxik. Ta xukʼot kʼut jun wi chi jul chutzalanem ukabʼ jul. Xukʼoto xkolotaj wi.

“Kʼa janikʼan pa laʼ?” xuchax kʼu qajoq kumal omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ.

“Kinanukʼoto.We xkixnusikʼij aqʼanoq ta chutzinoq u[9r]kʼototajik,” xchaʼ uloq Sipakna chiriʼ pa jul.

Ma kʼu areʼ kukʼot uxeʼ jul ri umukikil; xa ujul kukʼoto, kʼolbʼal ribʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xsikʼin uloq ri Sipakna, kolom chi ka chiriʼ pa jul.

Ta xsikʼin uloq: “Kixpetoq, chulikʼamaʼ ulew, rachaq jul, mixkʼotojajik. Qitzij naj mixqaj wumal. Ma pu kita nusikʼibʼal lo? Areʼ kʼu isikʼibʼal xa ubʼi kaxojanik. Kejeʼ riʼ jun elebʼal, kaʼibʼ elebʼal ix kʼowi kanutaʼo,” xchaʼ ula ri Sipaknapa ujul.

Chiriʼ kʼut matzal uloq, kasikʼiyaj chi ula pa jul.

Areʼ kʼut kajurux uloq ri kinimacheʼ rumal kʼajolabʼ, kʼate puch xkitarij qajoq ri cheʼ pa jul.

“Ma kʼo; ma chʼawik! Chiqata na ta churaquj uchiʼ, ta kamoq,” xechaʼ chi kibʼil kibʼ.

Xa kejaslabʼik, xa pu chimatzalaj kiwach chi kijujunal ta xkitarij qajoq ri cheʼ.

Areʼ kʼu xchaʼ kʼut ta xuraquj uchiʼ.

Xa jupaj chik xsikʼinik ta xqaj apanoq ri cheʼ.

“Oka! Mixutzinik, kʼi utz mixqabʼano chire, mixkamik! Ata la bʼe chitaqen chubʼano, chuchakuj tachuxoq! Unabʼe la xukoj ularibʼ qukʼ, chi qaxoʼl puch la oj omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut, kekiʼkot chik.

“Kʼo ri ubʼanik qakiʼ oxij kelekʼowik. Oxij puch chiqukʼaʼj laqʼabʼebʼal qakabʼal la, oj omuchʼ chi kʼajolabʼ,” xechaʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Chuweʼq kʼut chiqilo, kabʼij puch chiqilo ma pa chipe sanik pa ulew ta chuwinoq, ta qʼeyoq? Kʼateʼ kʼut kuʼl chi qakʼuʼx, ta qukʼaj ri qakiʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Kutaʼ kʼu uloq ri Sipakna chiriʼ pa jul ta xkibʼij kʼajolabʼ riʼ. Ka chukabʼij [9v] puch ta xtubʼukij sanik; kebʼinowik, kebʼuchuwik, ta xekʼulun xeʼ cheʼ.

Jumaj, kikayeloʼon is, kikayeloʼn puch rixkʼaq Sipakna, ta xkil kʼu ri kʼajolabʼ: “Mi pa xutzin ri kʼaxtokʼ. Chiwilaʼ na sanik mi xekʼulun uloq, mi xetubʼukij uloq? Jumaj is kikayen; kʼo rixkʼaq riʼ chilaʼ na mixqabʼano kʼa!” xechaʼ chikibʼil kibʼ.

Areʼ kʼu ri Sipakna xawi kʼaslik. Xuqʼat uloq rismal uwiʼ, xa pu kukʼux uloq rixkʼaq chi reʼy, kuyaʼ ula chikech ri sanik.

Kejeʼ kʼu riʼ xkamik xkinaʼo omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ. Kateʼ kʼut xtikar kikiʼ chi roxij.

Ta xeqʼabʼar puch konojel kʼajolabʼ. E kʼu qʼabʼarinaq chik konojel omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ maja bʼiʼ kakinaʼ chik. Kʼate puch xwulix ri kabʼal pa kiwiʼ rumal ri Sipakna.

Xekʼis chʼayatajik konojel; maja bʼiʼ chik jun kaʼibʼ xkolotaj chikech ri omuchʼ chi kʼajolabʼ. Xekamisaxik rumal Sipakna, ukʼajol ri Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Kejeʼ kʼut kikamik omuchʼ kʼajolabʼ riʼ.

Xchaʼ chi kʼut areʼ riʼ xeʼok chi chʼumilal; ri motz ubʼiʼ kumal.

Weʼ kʼut xa sakbʼal [tzʼaqbʼal-tzaqbʼal-saqbʼal] tzij lo.

Areʼ chikʼut chiqabʼij uchʼakatajik chik Sipakna rumal ri e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ, Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Areʼ chik uchʼakatajik, ukamik Sipakna ta xchʼak chik kumal ri e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ, JunAjpu, Xbʼalanke. Areʼ chi kuyoqʼ kikʼux kʼajolabʼ ri omuchʼ chi kʼajolabʼ xekamik rumal Sipakna.

Xa kar, xa tap chutzukuj chi taq aʼ, xere chi rechaʼj juta qʼij. Pa qʼij chiwaʼkatik ta chutzukuj rechaʼ, chaqʼabʼ kʼut chi[10r]reqaj juyubʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ujalwachixikjun nima tap rumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Areʼ kʼut xkikoj ri uwach ekʼ, ri mak ekʼ kʼo pa taq kʼecheʼlaj, areʼ uxul tap xuxik. ʼPajakʼ chi kʼut xok uqʼabʼ xkikojo. Tzel abʼaj kʼu ri uwa rachaq tap ri jowojik.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xkikoj ukoq chuxeʼ pek, chuxeʼ nima juyubʼ ubʼiʼ Meʼawan, ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xchʼakataj wi.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xepe ri kʼajolabʼ.

Xkikulaj [IxKikʼul] ri Sipakna chi yaʼ.

“Apa katbʼe wi, at kʼajol?” xuchaʼx kʼu ri Sipakna.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Ma jabʼiʼ kinbʼe wi. Xa wechaʼ kanutzukuj, ix kʼajolabʼ,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Sipakna.

“Naqipaʼ awechaʼ?”

“Xa kar, xa top. Xma kʼo chi wi kanuriqo. Kabʼijir chinkanaj rechaxik, mawi kanuchʼij chik waʼij,” xchaʼ Sipakna chi kech Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Jun are laʼ top kʼo ula xeʼ siwan, qitzij chi nima top. Kaqʼij ta laʼ chawechaʼaj lo. Xa kojutiʼo mi xraj qachapo; kaqaxibʼij qibʼ rumal. Ma chibʼe on kachapaʼ?” xechaʼ ri Jun Ajpu Xbʼalanke.

“Kitoqʼobʼa nuwach, kibʼe ta iwabʼaʼ, ix kʼajolabʼ,” xchaʼ ri Sipakna.

“Ma bʼa chiqaj, xa ta katbʼek, ma sachibʼal taj. Xa raqan jaʼ katbʼek, at kʼu taqal aponoq xeʼ nima juyubʼ. Jowol ula chuxeʼ siwan, xa katel apanoq,” xechaʼ Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Laqʼij bʼaʼ, toqʼobʼ nuwach. Mabʼaʼ xukʼulu, ix kʼajolabʼ? Kixbʼe na kʼu nuwabʼaʼ kʼo kʼi xo wi ri tzʼikin. Chibʼe taj iwubʼaj. Wetaʼam kʼo wi,” xchaʼ chi kʼut Sipakna.

Xelajik, xok na chi kiwach kʼajolabʼ.

“La ma [10v] qi kʼu x chachap lo? Ta xa kejeʼ xkojtzalij awumal maxa mawi xqatijo. Xa jusukʼ chitiyoʼnik. Ri oj jupulik kojok ubʼik, kʼateʼ kʼut kuxibʼij ribʼ ri oj pakʼalik kojok ubʼik, xa kʼu xkʼakin chik mawi chiqariqo. Kʼateʼ kʼu utz at pakʼalik katok ubʼik,” xuchaʼx kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Sipakna. Ta xbʼe kʼut achbʼiʼlan chi kʼut ri Sipakna, xbʼek.

Xeʼopon chuxeʼ siwan, tzalam [tzalan] kʼu ula ri tap.

Kaq wakawoj ula rij xeʼ siwan.

Riʼ kʼuteʼ kikumatzij.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” chikiʼkot kʼu ri Sipakna. Karaj taj xkok ta puchiʼ rumal. Qitzij kutzin chi waʼij. Xraj kutij riʼ; xa xraj jupunik, xraj okik. Xa pakʼal kʼu ri tap xaqʼanik. Kʼateʼ kʼut xel chuʼloq.

“Mawi xariqo?” xuchax kʼut.

“Majabʼiʼ. Xa pakʼalik kaqʼanik. Xa nabʼe xqaqin chik, mawi mixnuriqo. Kʼateʼ utz lo kipakʼeʼik kinok ubʼik,” xchaʼ chi kʼut. Kateʼ kʼut pakʼal chik ta xok ubʼik, xkʼis kʼu ok ubʼik.

Xa uwiʼ uchʼekchik xkʼutun uloq.

Xkʼis bʼiqʼitajik.

Xtilobʼ qajoq nima juyubʼ chi ukʼuʼx.

Mawi xsolqopij chik.

Abʼaj kʼut xuxik ri Sipakna.

Kejeʼ kʼut uchʼakatajik chik Sipakna kumal kʼajolabʼ Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Ri bʼanol juyubʼ xchaʼ utzijoxik ojer.

Unabʼe kʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix.

Chuxeʼ juyubʼ Meʼawan ubʼiʼ xchʼakataj wi.

Xa nawal xchʼakataj wi ukabʼ nimarisay ribʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Jun chi kʼut xchiqabʼij ubʼixik.

Rox chi kʼut nimarisay ribʼ ukabʼ ukʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix, Kabʼraqan ubʼiʼ.

“In yojol juyubʼ,” xchaʼ.

Xawi kʼu xere Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke xchʼakow re Kabʼraqan.

Xchaʼ[11r]ri Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja.

Ta xchʼawik chikech ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Ukabʼ ukʼajol Wuqubʼ Kaqix, jun chik chi chʼakatajik. Xawi nutzij rumal mawi utz kibʼanoj chuwach ulew. Ka kikʼowisaj qʼij chi nimal chi alal, ma kʼu kejeʼ chuxik. Chi bʼochiʼj kʼu ubʼik chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij,” xchaʼ kʼut ri Juraqan chike ri e kaʼibʼ kʼajolabʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, lal ajaw. Keʼ wi na kʼut, mawi utz wi kaqilo. Ma pa lal kʼolik, lal pu yakalik, lal Ukʼuʼx Kaj,” xechaʼ kʼut ri kʼajolabʼ ta IxKikʼulubʼaʼ utzij Juraqan.

Areʼ puch katajin ri Kabʼraqan, yojol juyubʼ.

Xa xkʼaqin chutinij raqan chuwach ulew, jusuʼ chibʼulij nima juyubʼ, chʼuti juyubʼ rumal. Ta xkʼulutaj kumal ri kʼajolabʼ.

“Apa katbʼe wi, at kaʼjol?” xechaʼ chi rech ri Kabʼraqan.

“Ma jabʼi kinbʼe wi.Xa in wuliy juyubʼ. In puch in yojol rech chibʼe qʼij; chibʼe saq,” xchaʼ kʼut ta xchʼawik.

Xchaʼ chi kʼut ri Kabʼraqan chike ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke: “Jupachaʼ xpetik [xixpetik]? Mawi wetaʼm uwach [iwach]. Nakipaʼ ibʼiʼ?” xchaʼ Kabʼraqan.

“Ma jabʼi qabʼiʼ, xa oj ubʼom, xa pu oj tzarabʼom pa taq juyubʼ, xa oj mebʼaʼ. Ma jabʼi naki laʼ qech, at kʼajol. Xa chʼuti juyubʼ, xa nima juyubʼ kojbʼek, at kʼajol.	Areʼ kʼu jun nima juyubʼ xqilo, xa koqil kakʼiyik. Qitzij najt kaqʼanik; xa kakupupik kikʼowik chuwiʼ juyubʼ ronojel. Ma kʼu jabʼiʼ jun kaʼibʼ tzʼikin mixqakʼam chuwach, at kʼajol. We kʼut qitzij kawulij ronojel juyubʼ, at kʼajol,” xechaʼ ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke chire Kabʼraqan.

“Ma qitzij xiwilo ri juyubʼ? Kibʼij apa kʼo wi. Xchiwil na, xchinwulij qajoq. Apa xiwil wi?”

“Chilaʼ bʼaʼ kʼo [11v] wi chi Relebʼal Qʼij,” xechaʼ kʼut JunAjpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Utz chikʼamaʼ qabʼe,” xeʼuchax kʼu ri kaʼibʼ chi kʼajolabʼ.

“Majabʼi, xa kachapeʼ nikʼaj, chi qaxoʼl kʼut katkʼojeʼ wi, jun chamox, jun chawikiqʼabʼ chi qe rumal kʼo qawubʼ we kʼo tzʼikin chi qawubʼaj,” xechaʼ kʼut.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kekiʼkot chi kitijtobʼelaʼ kiwubʼanik. Areʼ kʼu riʼ ta kewubʼanik mana ulew taj ubʼaqʼ kiwubʼ. Xa chikʼuxlabʼij ri tzʼikin ta chi kiwubʼaj. Chumayijaj kʼu ri Kabʼraqan.

Ta xkibʼaq kʼu kiqʼaqʼ ri kʼajolabʼ, xkibʼol kʼut kitzʼikin chuwach qʼaqʼ. Jun kʼut kitzʼikin xkiqʼul sajkabʼ chrij; saqi ulew xkikojo.

“Areʼ kʼut chiqayaʼ chire ta jiqʼonoq, ta chusiqaʼ puch ruxlabʼ qatzʼikin ta chakʼajoq. Areʼ kʼu ri ulew xchok chrij tzʼikin qumal; pulew chiqatzaq wi, kejeʼ kʼut pulew chimuq wi. We, nima etaʼmanel Jun Tzʼaq, Jun Bʼit ta chawaxoq, ta saqiroq,” xechaʼ ri kʼajolabʼ.

“Rumal xax chirayin wi ukʼuʼxlal ri chi tiyʼik, chichʼaqʼuxik [chikachʼuxik], kejeʼ churayij ukʼuʼx ri Kabʼraqan,” xechaʼ chi kibʼil kibʼ Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Ta xkibʼol ri tzʼikin. Xchaqʼaj kʼut, qʼan ubʼolik: chi yipowik,chi kabʼchiyanik kij ri tzʼikin, chi kʼowinik simisoj ruxlabʼ.

Areʼ kʼu ri Kabʼraqan kurayij chik rechaxik. Xa kawajin uwaʼl puchiʼ; Xa kabʼiqʼilajik, kakʼurulaj puch uchubʼ ukʼaxaj rumal usimisojil tzʼikin. Ta xutzʼonoj kʼut.

“Naqipaʼ ri iwechaʼ? Qitzij qʼus ruxlabʼ kanunaʼo. Chiyaʼ ta skʼaqin wech,” xchaʼ kʼut. Ta xyaʼ kʼut jun tzʼikin chire Kabʼraqan; uchʼakatajik kʼu riʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut xukʼis ri tzʼikin.

Ta xbʼe chi kʼut, xeʼopon kʼu chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij kʼo wi ri nima juyubʼ. Areʼ kʼu Kabʼraqan xa tubʼul chik raqan, uqʼabʼ. Ma jabʼi chikowin chik rumal ri [12r] ulew xkul chrij kitzʼikin xutiʼo. Ma kʼu jabʼi chik naqilaʼ xubʼan chik chi re juyubʼ. Mawi xutzinik xuwulij taj.

Ta xim kʼut kumal kʼajolabʼ: chrij xim wi uqʼabʼ kumal kʼajolabʼ; xim kʼut uqul raqan ukabʼichal. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkitarij qajoq pulew, xkimuqu. Keje kʼut uchʼakatajik Kabʼraqan riʼ.

Xawi xere Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Mawi ajilam kibʼanoj waral chuwach ulew.

Areʼ chi kʼut xchiqabʼij chik kalaxik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Areʼ nabʼe mi xqabʼij ri kichʼakatajik Wuqubʼ Kaqix, rukʼ Sipakna, rukʼ Kabʼraqan waral chuwach ulew.

Acta Tres: Jun Junajpu, Wuqubʼ Junajpu

Kiqajaw ri Junajpu,  Xbʼalanke

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ chi kʼut xchiqabʼij chik ubʼiʼ kiqajaw ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Xqakamuj [kaqakamulij] chuwiʼ; xa pu xqakamuj[kaqakamulij] ubʼixik, utzijoxik puch kikʼajolaxik ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Xa nikʼaj xchiqabʼij, xa chʼaqaʼp ubʼixik kiqajaw. Waʼe kʼateʼ utzijoxik.

Areʼ kibʼiʼ riʼ: Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu keʼuchaʼxik.

Areʼ kʼut kiqajaw ri Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane. Chi qʼeqʼumal, chi aqʼabʼal xeʼalaxik ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu kumal Xpiyakok, IxMuqkane.

Areʼ kʼu ri Jun Jun Ajpu, ekaʼibʼ xeralkʼwaʼlaj, eʼ pu kaʼibʼ ukʼajol. Jun Bʼatzʼ ubʼiʼ nabʼeʼal, JunChowen chi kʼut ubʼiʼ ukabʼal. Areʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ kichuch waʼ: Xbʼaqiyalo, chuchaxik, rixoqil Jun Jun Ajpu.

Areʼ kʼu ri Wuqubʼ JunAjpu ma jabʼi rixoqil. Xa ulaqʼel, xa utukel; xa pu ukabʼ; xa kʼajol ukʼojeʼik.

E nimaʼq ajnaʼoj, nim puch ketaʼmabʼal. E nikʼwachinel waral chuwach ulew. Xa utz kikʼojeʼik, kiyakeʼik puch. IxKikʼutu nawikil chi kiwach ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, JunChowen, ukʼajol Jun Jun Ajpu. E ajsuʼ e ajbʼix, e pu ajtzʼibʼ nayipu aj[12v]kʼot, e ajxit, e ajpuwaq xeʼuxik ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen.

Areʼ kʼu ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu xa sakʼ, xa chaaj chi kibʼano jutaqʼij. Xa e kakabʼ chi kikʼulelaʼj kibʼ. E kajibʼ chi konojel; ta kekuch mayijik pa jom chul kʼu ri wok [wak], ilol ke, usamajel Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja.

Areʼ kʼu ri wok [wak] mawi naj waral chuwach ulew; mawi naj chi Xibʼalbʼa chire. Libʼaj chi chopon chik chi kaj rukʼ Jun Raqan-Juraqan. Xeyaluj waral chuwach ulew xkaminaq kʼa kʼut kichuch ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen.

Areʼ kʼut ubʼeʼel Xibʼalbʼa xechaʼaj wi ta xkita kʼut Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame, rajawal Xibʼalbʼa.

“Nakipaʼ kabʼan chuwach ulew? Xa kenikinotik. Xa pu kejuminik. Kebʼe ta taqoq waral taj keʼul chaaj wi, kechʼak taj kʼut. Xa maja bʼi qanimaxik kumal, maja bʼiʼ kinim. Ma kʼu jabʼi kixobʼ kuxik. Xax kejikʼik uloq pa qawiʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut konojel Xibʼalbʼaʼ ta IxKikʼam kinaʼoj konojel.

Riʼ kibʼiʼ Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame, e nimaʼq qʼatol tzij. Areʼ kʼu ri ajawabʼ ronojel, yaʼol upatan rajawarem puch. Jujun chi ajawabʼ rumal Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame. Areʼ kʼu ri Xikiripat, Kuchuma Kikʼ ubʼiʼ ajaw. Areʼ kipatan ri kikʼ chu yabʼij winaq.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ chi kʼu ri Ajal Puj, Ajal Qʼanaʼ chik. Kʼi ajawabʼ. Areʼ kʼut kajawarem ri chi sipojik winaq. Chipe puj chirij raqan; chipe qanaʼ chrij uwach, chuqʼanel chuchaxik. Kʼateʼ kʼut rajawarem Ajal Puj, Ajal Qʼanaʼ.

Areʼ chi kʼu ri Ajaw Chʼamiʼya Bʼaq, Chʼamiʼya Jolom rajchʼamiʼy Xibʼalbʼa. Xa bʼaq kichʼamiʼy, areʼ kʼut kajchʼamiʼyal ri chibʼaqir winaq. Qitzij chi bʼaq, chi jolom chik ta chikamik. Siyaj bʼaq ʼXupamʼ chikʼamowik. Areʼ upatan wi Chʼa[13r]miʼya Bʼaq, Chʼamiʼya Jolom kibʼiʼ.

Areʼ kʼu ri Ajaw Ajal Mes, Ajal Tʼoqʼobʼ kibʼiʼ. Areʼ kipatan riʼ: xa chikʼulwachij winaq we tzaʼ mes, we pe [kepe] puch rij ja, chuwa ja chikʼulwachix wi. Xa chikitʼokotʼaʼ chi bʼe jupuloq chuwach ulew, ta chikamik. Areʼ kʼut kajawarem Ajal Mes, Ajal Tʼoqʼobʼ, keʼuchaʼxik.

Areʼ kʼu ri Ajaw Xikʼ, Patan kibʼiʼ, areʼ kajawarem ri winaq chikam pa bʼe. Xa rax kamik chuchaxik, chipe kikʼ puchiʼ ta chikamik chuxawaj kikʼ. Xa jujun chi patan, kitelelaʼon. Xa chikiqʼosij uqulel ukʼuʼx winaq ta chikam pa bʼe. Xa chikikʼulaj apanoq we chibʼinik, chikul [chaqʼabʼ]. Areʼ kʼut kajawarem Xikʼ, Patan riʼ.

Areʼ kʼut xkikuch kinaʼoj riʼ ta xetzaʼixik, ta xekotobʼax puch Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Areʼ xkirayij Xibʼalbʼa ri ketzʼabʼaʼl Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu: ri kitzʼuʼm, kibʼate, kipachqʼabʼ, kiyachwach, wachsot puch kikawubʼal Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ JunAjpu.

Are chi kʼut xchiqabʼij chik kibʼeʼik chi Xibʼalbʼa. Xekanaj kʼu kanoq ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen, ukaʼjol Jun Jun Ajpu.

Xkaminaqoq kichuch kʼa chuwiʼ chik kichʼakatajik chik Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen kumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Kʼateʼ kʼut kipetik samajel rumal Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame. «Kixbʼek, ix Rajpop Achij. Jeʼitaqaʼ ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu! Kixchaʼ ta kixopan kukʼ: “Kepetoq! kechaʼ ajawabʼ chiwech.Waral taj keʼulchaaja wi qukʼ chi qakʼastaj ta qawach kukʼ! Qitzij kaqamayijaj kʼi chiʼ, kejeʼ ta kʼut kepe wi. Kechaʼ ajawabʼ.Chikikʼam uloq ri kichokonisaʼn, kibʼate, kipach[13v]qʼabʼ, chipe nayipuch ri kikikʼ, kechaʼ ajawabʼ,” kixchaʼ ta kixoponoq», xeʼuchax ri samajel.

Areʼ kʼut kisamajel ri tukur: Chʼabʼi Tukur, Juraqan Tukur, Kaqix Tukur, JolomTukur keʼuchax usamajel Xibʼalbʼa.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ ri Chʼabʼi Tukur kejeʼ ri chʼabʼ, xa kopkik.

Areʼ kʼu ri Juraqan Tukur xa jun raqan, kʼo uxikʼ.

Areʼ kʼu ri Kaqix Tukur kaq rij, kʼo uxikʼ.

Areʼ chi nay puch ri Jolom Tukur xa utukel ujolom.

Ma jabʼi raqan; xa uxikʼ kʼolik.

E kajibʼ usamajel; rajpop achijabʼ keqʼaleʼm, ta xepe kʼut chilaʼ chi Xibʼalbʼa. Libʼaj chi xeʼulik, ekʼu taqal chuwiʼ jom. Kechaaj kʼut Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu pa jom, ri Nim Xobʼ Karchaj chuchaxik.

E kʼu takʼatoj ri tukur chuwiʼ jom.

Ta xkitzaq kʼut kitzij, xawi xere ucholik utzij Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame, Ajal Puj, Ajal Qʼanaʼ, Chʼamiʼya Bʼaq, Chʼamiʼya Jolom, Xikiripat, Kuchuma Kikʼ, Ajal Mes, Ajal Tʼoqʼobʼ, Xikʼ, Patan kibʼiʼ konojel Ajawabʼ.

Xtzaq kitzij kumal Tukur.

“Ma qitzij kechaʼ Ajaw Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame?”

“Qi tzij bʼa laʼ,” kechaʼ.

«Oj nakʼu achibʼlay iwe.“Chikʼam uloq riʼ ronojel ketzʼabʼaʼl,” kechaʼ ajawabʼ.»

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, kojiwoyobʼeʼj na. Oj na qapixabʼaj kan na qachuch,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Xebʼe kʼut chi kochoch.

Xechaʼ kʼut chire kichuch, xkaminaqoq kiqajaw: «Joʼ na, ix qachuch. Xa et kulic. Mixul usamajel Ajaw, kʼamal qe.“Kepetoq, kachaʼ kʼut,” kechaʼ taqol qe. Xchikanaj kana waʼ qakikʼ,» xechaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ xbʼek-IXIM-aʼ kanoq puwiʼ ja.

“Kojul na. Kʼateʼ chiqachokonisaj chik. Xa kixsuʼanoq; xa pu kixbʼixanoq; kixtzʼibʼanoq; kixkʼotonoq; chimeqʼoj qochoch, chimeqʼoj puch ukʼuʼx [14r]iwatiʼt,” xeʼuchax kʼut Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen ta xepixabʼaxik.

Qʼusqʼus; [qʼuzqʼuj] choqʼ kichuch, ri IxMuqkane.

“Joʼ na; majabʼiʼ kojkamik. Mixbʼisonik,” xechaʼ ta xebʼe JunJun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Kʼateʼ puch ta xebʼe Jun JunAjpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Xkʼam kibʼe kumal ri samajel. Ta xeqaj kʼut pubʼeʼal Xibʼalbʼa. Xuluxuj uchiʼ kumuk, xeqaj kʼut.

Ta xeʼel chi kʼu aponoq chuchiʼ Jal Jaʼ; Siwan Ubʼ; Nuʼ Siwan; Kulku Siwan ubʼiʼ xeʼikʼow wi.

Xeʼekʼow chi kʼut chupam Jaljal Ja Simaj. Mawi ajilan simaj xeʼikʼow wi. Mawi xetoqʼotajik.

Ta xeʼopon chi kʼut chi Aʼ; chi Kikʼiy Aʼ; xeʼikʼow chi riʼ. Mawix kukaj xeʼopon chi Aʼ. Utukel puj chi Aʼ. Mawi xechʼakatajik. Xawi xeʼikʼow chik.

Ta xeʼopon chi kʼut pa Kajibʼ Xalqat Bʼe.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kʼa chi riʼ kʼut xechʼakataj wi pa Kajibʼ Xalqat Bʼe: Jun Kaqa Bʼe; Jun kʼut Qʼeqabʼe; Saqi Bʼe Jun; Jun kʼut Qʼanabʼe. Kajibʼ Bʼe.

Are kʼut xchʼaw ri Qʼeqa Bʼe: “In kinikʼamo; In ubʼe Ajaw,” xchʼaw ri Bʼe. Chiriʼ kʼut xechʼakataj wi, are xkitaqej ri bʼe Xibʼalbʼa.

Ta xeʼopon kʼut pa ki Popobʼal Rajawal Xibʼalbʼa. Xechʼakataj chi kʼut chiriʼ, are nabʼe kubʼulel riʼ: xa Poy, xa Ajam Cheʼ kawutalik kumal Xibʼalbʼa.

Are kʼut nabʼe xkiqʼijilaʼ: “Qʼaʼ la Jun Kame,” xechaʼ chire ri poy.

“Qʼaʼ la Wuqubʼ Kame,” xechaʼ chik chire ri Ajam Cheʼ; ma kʼu xechaʼkowik [xechʼawik]. Kʼateʼ kʼut xejumujubʼ Rajawal Xibʼalbʼa chi tzeʼ. Xa kejumin chik chi tzeʼ konojel Ajawabʼ rumal xechʼakomajik. Chi kikʼuʼx xkichʼak ri Jun JunAjpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu.

Xetzeʼna.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xechʼaw chik Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame: “Utz bʼa laʼ mixixulik. Chweʼq chiqasaʼ uwach [14v] ibʼate, ipachqʼabʼ,” xeʼuchax kʼut.

“Kixkuʼloq chuwiʼ qatem,” xeʼuchaxik. Utukel kʼu kʼatanalaj abʼaj kitem xyaʼik. Xekʼat chikʼut chuwiʼ tem. Qitzij wi xepiskʼalij chik chuwiʼ tem, mawi xeyakamarik. Qitzij wi xewaʼlejik, xkʼat kikuʼlibʼal.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xetzeʼn chik Xibʼalbʼa. Xepichicharik chi tzeʼ. Xwinaqirjeʼik ukumatz tzeʼ chi kikʼuʼx; chikikʼ ibʼ; chikibʼaq kibʼ; chi tzeʼ konojel Rajawal Xibʼalbʼa.

“Xa jix chi ja. We chibʼeyaʼoq ichaj, isikʼ chi warabʼal,” xeʼuchax kʼut.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xeʼoponik pa Qʼequʼma Ja; utukel qʼequʼm upam chi ja.

Ta xkʼam kʼut kinaʼoj Xibʼalbʼa: “Xa keqapusu chweʼq. Xa labʼe ʼjusu, jusuʼ kekamik rumal ri qetzʼabʼaʼl, ri qachaajibʼal,” kechaʼ kʼu ri Xibʼalbʼa chi kibʼilkibʼ.

Are kʼu kichaaj xa kʼolokʼik cha. Saqitoqʼ ubʼiʼ ri chaaj, uchaaj Xibʼalbʼa. Xa juqul kichaaj. Xa jusukʼ chiyojyox bʼaq chi kʼo wi kichaaj Xibʼalbʼa.

Xeʼok kʼut ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu chupam ri Qʼequʼma Ja. Ta xbʼe kʼu yaʼoq kichaj; xa jun chi chaj tzijom [tzijom] chik. Xel rukʼ Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame rukʼ jujun kisikʼ. Xa wi tzijom chik xel kukʼ ajawabʼ. Ta xbʼe kʼu yaʼoq kukʼ ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ JunAjpu.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
E chʼokochʼoj chi uloq pa qʼequʼm ta xopon ri yaʼol kichaj rukʼ kisikʼ. Kajuljut ri chaj. Xok apanoq ri kichaj e kitzijaʼ ri jujun kisikʼ: “Jeʼ chulkiyaʼ chisaqirik. Mawi chikʼisik. Xawi xere uwach chulkimolobʼaʼ,” kechaʼ Ajawabʼ chiwe,» xeʼuchaxik. Xechʼakataj kʼut: IxKikʼis ri chaj, IxKikʼis kʼu ri sikʼ xbʼeyaʼo [xbʼeyaʼoq] chike.

Tzatz kʼu ri tijobʼal Xibʼalbʼa. Kʼiya molaj chi tijobʼal. Are unabʼe ri [15r] Qʼequʼma Ja; xa utukel qʼequʼm upam.

Ukabʼ chi kʼut Xuxulim Ja, ubʼiʼ; tzatz chi tew upam. Saq xuruxuj, saq kʼarakʼoj chi xurulaj tew chok uloq chupam.

Rox chi kʼut Bʼalami Ja ubʼiʼ; xa utukel bʼalam kʼo chupam. Keqichʼowik. Kebʼuchuwik. Chi matat kechʼiqitit ke. E tzʼapimbʼalam pa ja.

Sotzʼi Ja ubʼiʼ ukaj utijobʼal; xa utukel sotzʼ upamchi ja. Ketzʼitzʼotik, ketzʼitzʼilajik. Keropop pa ja. E tzʼapim sotzʼ, ma jabʼiʼ keʼel wi.

Roʼ chi kʼut Chayim Ja ubʼiʼ; xa utukel cha kʼo chupam. Saqleʼloj re chi cha; chi tzʼininik, chi yojojik chi riʼ pa ja.

Kʼi nabʼek utijobʼal Xibʼalbʼa; ma kʼu xeʼok ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu chi upam. Xa ubʼixik apanoq ubʼi tijobʼal ja.

Ta xeʼok kʼu apanoq Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu chwach Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

“Apa kʼo wi ri nusikʼ, aʼon kʼo wi ri nuchaj xbʼeyaʼoq chiwe xqʼeq?” xuchax kʼut.

“Xqakʼiso, at Ajaw.”

“Utz bʼa laʼ, wakamik bʼa laʼ xkʼis iqʼij; kixkamik. Xkixsachik! X kixqaqʼup puch! Waral xchiwewaj wi iwach: Kixpusik,” xcha Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Ta xepus kʼut.

Xemuq kʼut.

Chi Pukʼbʼal Chaj ubʼiʼ xemuq wi.

Xqʼat ujolom ri Jun Jun Ajpu.

Xa unimal xmuqik rukʼ ri uchaqʼ.

“Chiyaʼ ujolom xoʼl cheʼ ri tikil pa bʼe,” xcha kʼut Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Ta xbʼekʼuyaʼoq ujolom xoʼl cheʼ, ta xwachin kʼu ri cheʼ. Maja bʼiʼ uwach, maja choka ri ujolom ri Jun Jun Ajpu chuxoʼl cheʼ. Are kʼu ri tzima kojchaʼ chire wakamik, ʼujolom Jun JunAjpuʼ kuchaxik.

Ta xumayijaj kʼut Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame uwach ri cheʼ, jumaj kʼolokʼaʼq uwach, ma kʼu qʼalaj kʼo chiwi ujolom Jun Jun Ajpu. Xa junam [15v] chik uwach rukʼ tzima kurilo ronojel Xibʼalbʼa ta chulkikayij.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Nim ukʼojeʼik ri cheʼ xux chi kikʼuʼx rumal jusuʼ xabʼanik [xbʼanik] ta xok ujolom Jun Jun Ajpu chuxoʼl. Xechaʼ kʼu ri Xibʼalbʼa chi kibʼil kibʼ: “Ma kʼo; machʼupuwik ri uwach. Ma kʼo nayipu; maʼ ok apanoq chuxeʼ cheʼ,” xechaʼ.

Xkiqʼataj kibʼ, xkiqʼil kibʼ Xibʼalbʼa konojel. Ma kʼu qʼalaj chiri ujolom Jun Jun Ajpu, xa junamatal chik rukʼ uwach cheʼ ʼri tzimaʼ ubʼiʼ xuxik.

Nim kʼut utzijoxik xuta jun qʼapoj; waʼ kʼuteʼ xchiqabʼij roponik.

IIxKikʼ Jun Qʼapoj

Waʼ chi kʼuteʼ utzijoxik Jun Qʼapoj, umeʼal Jun Ajaw, Kuchuma Kikʼ ubʼiʼ. Areʼ kʼut ta xuta Jun Qʼapoj, umeʼal Jun Ajaw. Kuchuma Kikʼ ubʼiʼ uqajaw. IIxKikʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ ri qʼapoj.

Ta xuta kʼut utzijoxik ri uwach cheʼ ta chitzijox chik rumal uqajaw. Chumayijaj kʼut ta chitzijoxik. “¿Ma kinaʼojwilaʼ ri cheʼ kabʼixik? Qitzij qʼus uwach?  kachaʼ, kanutaʼo,” xchaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ xbʼek, xa utukel xopon kʼut chuxeʼ cheʼ tikil chi Pusʼbʼal Chaj tikil wi.

“Jiyaʼaʼ! Naqiʼ xpewi uwach waʼe cheʼ? Makipaʼ qʼus chiwachin waʼ cheʼ? Ma kikamtaj, ma kisach taj? Laʼ ki ta xchinchʼup junoq?” xchaʼ kʼu ri qʼapoj.

Ta xchʼaw kʼut ri bʼaq kʼo ula xoʼl cheʼ.

“Nakipaʼ karayij chire ri xa bʼaq ri kʼolokʼoxinaq chuqʼabʼ taq cheʼ?” xchaʼ ri ujolom Jun Jun Ajpu ta xchʼawik chire ri qʼapoj.

“Ma karayij?” xuchaxik.

“Kanurayij!” xchaʼ kʼut ri qʼapoj.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Chalikʼibʼaʼ uloq ri awikiqʼabʼ, wilaʼ na,” xchaʼ ri bʼaq.

“We!” xchaʼ kʼu ri qʼapoj.

Xulikʼibʼaʼ aqʼanoq uwikiqʼabʼ chuwach bʼaq.

Kʼateʼ kʼut chipitzʼ kubʼan uchubʼ bʼaq, ta xpetik, taqal kʼut puqʼabʼ qʼapoj.

Ta xril kʼut upuqʼabʼ. Jusukʼ xunikʼoj, ma kʼu jabʼiʼ uchubʼ[16r] bʼaq puqʼabʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Xa retal mixnuyaʼ chawe, ri nuchubʼ, nukʼaxaj. Areʼ ri nujolom; maja bʼiʼ kachokon chiwi: xa bʼaq. Maja bʼiʼ chi uchʼaqʼ. Xawi kejeʼ ujolom we ki Nim Ajaw. Xa utiyoʼjil, utz wi uwach. Areʼ kʼut ta chikamik, chuxibʼij chirij winaq rumal ubʼaqil. Kʼejeʼ kʼut xa ukʼajol kejeʼ ri uchubʼ, ukʼaxaj, ukʼojeʼik we ukʼajol ajaw, we puch ukʼajol naʼol, ajuchan. Xmachisach wi chibʼek; chitzʼaqatajik. Mawi chupel, ma pu mayixel uwach ajaw, achij naʼol, ajuchan. Xaxi chikanajik [xchikanajik] umiʼal, ukʼajol. Ta chuxoq! Kejeʼ mixnubʼan chawe. Kataqʼan kʼu chilaʼ chuwach ulew. Mawi kakamik, katok pa tzij. Ta chuxoq!” xchaʼ ujolom Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ JunAjpu.

Xawi kinaʼoj ta xkibʼano areʼ utzij Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja chikech. Kejeʼ kʼu utzalijik chik qʼapoj chi rochoch. Kʼiya pixabʼ xbʼix chi rech. Jusuʼ kʼu xwinaqir ral chupam rumal ri xa chubʼ. Areʼ kʼut kiwinaqirik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Ta xopon kʼut chi rochoch ri qʼapoj.

Xtzʼaqat kʼut  waqibʼ ikʼ ta xnawachil[xnawachix] rumal uqajaw; riʼ Kuchuma Kikʼ ubʼiʼ uqajaw. Kʼateʼ puch unaʼtajik qʼapoj rumal uqajaw ta xil ri ral kʼo chik. Ta xkikuch kʼut kinaʼoj konojel ajawabʼ, Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame rukʼ ri Kuchuma Kikʼ.

“Areʼ numeʼal kʼo chi ral, ix Ajawabʼ. Xa ujoxbʼal,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Kuchuma Kikʼ ta xoponik kukʼ ajawabʼ.

“Utzbʼaʼ laʼ. Chakʼotoʼ uchiʼ riʼ. Ta ma kubʼij, chipus kʼut; chi najt chibʼe pusa wi.”

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, alaq Ajawabʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xutzʼonoj chirech umeʼal.

“Apa ajchoqʼe ri awal kʼo chapam, at numeʼal?” xchaʼ kʼut.

“Ma jabʼiʼ[16v]wal, lal nuqajaw, ma jabʼiʼ achij wetaʼm uwach,” xchaʼ kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Qitzij wi chi at joxol chʼek.”

“Chipusuʼ, Ix Rajpop Achij, “Chikʼama uloq ukʼuʼx chupam tzel. Chikikʼololej ajawabʼ wakamik,” xeʼuchax kʼut ri tukur. E kajibʼ ta xebʼek. Kitikʼem ri tzel ta xebʼek. Kichʼelem riqʼapoj, kukʼaʼm ri Saqitoqʼ, pusbʼal re.

“Mawi chutzinik kinikamisaj, ix Samajel rumal mawi nujoxbʼal ri kʼo chi nupam. Xaqi xwinaqirik. Xere xbʼe numayijaj ri ujolom ri Jun Jun Ajpu, kʼo chi Pusʼbʼal Chaj. Kʼekʼe ta kʼut! Mawi kipus [kinipusu], ix Samajel,” xchaʼ ri qʼapoj ta xchʼawik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
«Naki paʼ xchiqakoj ukʼexel ri ikʼuʼx? Mi xbʼix uloq rumal aqajaw: “Chikʼam uloq ri ukʼuʼx. Xchikitzololej ajawabʼ, xchikitzaqixtaj, xchikijunamwachij utzʼaqik. Chanim chikʼamaʼ uloq pa tzel, chikʼolobʼaʼ qajoq ukʼuʼx chupam tzel.” Ma pa mixojuchax uloq. Nakilaʼ kʼut xchiqayaʼ pa tzel? Kaqaj ta nabʼek ma ta katkamik,» xechaʼ kʼu ri Samajel.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ mawi kech ri kʼuʼx, ta chuxoq! Rukʼ mawi waral iwochoch chuxik. Ma kʼu xa chichij winaq chi kamik. Kʼateʼ qitzij iwech ri qitzij joxol. Kʼateʼ nayipuch rech Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame xa kikʼ xa jolomax rech ta chuxoq. Areʼ chi kʼut chuwach. Mawi areʼ ri kʼuʼx chi kʼat chuwach. Ta chuxoq! Chikojoʼ uwach cheʼ,”[x]chaʼ kʼut ri qʼapoj.

Kaq kʼut uwaʼal ri cheʼ xelik. Xkʼul [xkʼol] pa tzel, kʼateʼ puch xuwon ribʼ. Kʼolokʼik xuxik, ukʼexel ukʼuʼx ta yitzʼ chi kʼut uwaʼal kaq cheʼ. Kejeʼ ri kikʼ uwaʼal cheʼ xelik; ukʼexel ukikʼel.

Ta xukʼolo chilaʼ ri kikʼ chupam, ri uwaʼal kaq cheʼ. Kejeʼ kʼu ri kikʼ rij xuxik. Kaqlujluj chik kʼolom chi pa tzel. Ta xqʼup kʼut ri cheʼ rumal qʼapoj.

Chuj kaq cheʼ chuchaxik.[17r] Areʼ kʼu kikʼ xubʼinaʼaj rumal kikʼ jolomax chuchaxik.

“Chilaʼ kʼut kixloqʼoxwi chuwach ulew, kʼo iwech chuxik,” xchaʼ kʼut chike ri tukur.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, at qʼapoj. Xqabʼe bʼa qawabʼa [katbʼebʼaʼqawabʼaʼ] aqʼanoq. Xa kabʼin apanoq. Oj na qayaʼixtaj waʼ ukʼexewach akʼuʼx chi kiwach ajawabʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut ri Samajel.

Ta xopon kʼut chi kiwach ajawabʼ. Ketzelewachin [kitzʼelewachim] konojel.

“Mawi xutzinik?” xchaʼ Jun Kame.

“Mixutzinik, ix ajawabʼ. Waʼ na kʼu ukuʼx xe [we] kʼo pa tzel.”

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ wilaʼ kʼut ,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Jun Kame. Ta xuchuyej kʼu aqʼanoq. Katurur rij chikomaj. Kaqlujlujrij chi kikʼ.

“Utz chi luʼuʼ uwach qʼaqʼ. Chiyaʼ chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut Jun Kame. Kʼateʼ puch xkichaqʼij chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ; kʼokʼ kʼut xkinaʼ Xibʼalbʼa. Xekʼisyakataj uloq konojel xechʼikeʼ chuwiʼ. Qitzij chi qʼus xkinaʼo ri usibʼel kikʼ.

Areʼ kʼut e chʼikichʼoj wi kanoq, ta xebʼe ri tukur ewabʼay rech qʼapoj. Xukiyaʼ[Xkiyaʼ]apanoq chi jul chuwiʼ ulew. Xtzalij chi kʼu qajoq ri wabʼanel. Kejeʼ kʼut xechʼakataj wi rajawal Xibʼalbʼa riʼ rumal qʼapoj. Xemoywachixik konojel.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼut e kʼo ri uchuch Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen ta xul ri ixoq IxKikʼ ubʼiʼ. Ta xul kʼut ri ixoq IxKikʼ rukʼ ri uchuch Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Xkʼoloq ral chupam, xa xkʼaqin chik mawi keyakeʼik ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke kibʼiʼ.

Ta xul kʼu ri ixoq chire ri atiʼt.

Xchaʼ kʼu ri ixoq chireri atiʼt.

“Mixinulik, lal chichuʼ. In alibʼ la, In puch alkʼuʼal la, chichuʼ,” xchaʼ ta xok uloq rukʼ ri Atiʼt.

“Apa katpe wi uloq? Kʼo chi pa ri wal? Ma pa xekamik chi Xibʼalbʼa? E kʼu kaʼibʼ kanoq ketal, kitzijel puch Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. We awilaʼ katpe wi! Katel ubʼik!” xuchaxik ri qʼapoj rumal Atiʼt.

“Xere laʼ qitzij wi chi in alibʼ la. Xkʼo na reʼ in kʼo wi [17v] rech Jun Jun Ajpu waʼ ukʼaʼm. E kʼaslik. Mawi e kaminaq ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Xa kʼutbʼal ribʼ saq mixkibʼano, lal walibʼ. Kejeʼ kʼut iwilaʼ ta chi loqʼ uwach ri wukʼaʼm,” xuchax ri Atiʼt.

Areʼ kʼut keqʼaqʼal ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Xa suʼ, xa bʼix kakibʼano. Xa tzʼibʼanik xa pu kʼotonik kichakij chi juta qʼij. Areʼ kʼut kubʼul wi ukʼuʼx ri Atiʼt.

Xchaʼ chi kʼut Atiʼt: “xma kawaj wi at ta walibʼ. Xa ajoxbʼal ri kʼo chapam. At kʼaxtokʼ. Xekam wi wal kabʼij,” xchaʼ chi kʼut ri Atiʼt.

“Qitzij ibʼaʼ re waʼ kanubʼij: Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, at walibʼ, kanutaʼo. Jat bʼa laʼ jakʼamaʼ qechaʼ wi chi qiwaʼej. Jaʼ jachʼaʼ jun chi nima kʼat chipetik. At na kʼu walibʼ kanutaʼo,” xuchax kʼut ri qʼapoj.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ puch ta xbʼek pa abʼix. Kʼo wiʼ kabʼix ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Jokam ubʼeʼel kumal, xutaqej kʼut qʼapoj xopon puch chiriʼ pa abʼix. Xa kʼu ju wiʼ ri abʼix. Xma kʼo chi wi uka wiʼ, rox wiʼ. Xuwachelaʼm wi uwach chi ju wiʼ. Ta xkʼis kʼut ukʼuʼx ri qʼapoj.

“Kila in makol, in kʼasbʼol. Apa xchinkʼam wi ri jun kʼat echaʼ kabʼixik?” xchaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ puch usikʼixik chajal echaʼ rumal: “Ta tul wa uloq ta tul takʼaloq Ixtoj, Ixqʼanil, Ixkakaw Ix Pu Tziya, at chajal re kechaʼ Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen,” xchaʼ ri qʼapoj.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xukʼam kʼut ri tzamiʼy: utzamiʼyal uwiʼ jal. Xubʼoq aqʼanoq. Mawi xujachʼ ri jal, chikaw [chiqaj] kʼut ri jal echaʼ pa kʼat. Xkaxinik ri nima kʼat. Ta xpe kʼut ri qʼapoj. Xa kʼu chikop xeqan ri kʼat ta xpetik. Xbʼekiyaʼ ukoq xukut ja. Kejeʼ riʼ reqaʼn xopanik. Xril ri Atiʼt.

Kateʼ puch ta xril ri Atiʼt ri echaʼ, jun chi nima kʼat.

“Apa mi xpe wi ri echaʼ awumal, mixeʼaqʼatabʼa wi? We mixkʼis akʼam ula ri qabʼix. Chibʼena wilaʼ,” xchaʼ ri Atiʼt. Ta xbʼe puch.[18r] Xbʼerilaʼ ri abʼix; xawi xere kʼo wi ri juwiʼ abʼix, xawi kʼu xere qʼalaj ukʼolibʼal kʼat chuxeʼ. Anim chi kʼut xpe ri Atiʼt.

Xul chi kʼut chi rochoch, xchaʼ chi kʼut chire ri qʼapoj: “Xere wi retal ri qitzij wi chi at walibʼ. Chiwil chi na abʼanoj riʼ. E kʼo wi[y] ri e nawinaq chik,” xuchax kʼut qʼapoj.

Kalaxik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke

Areʼ chik xchiqatzijoj kalaxik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Areʼ kʼut kalaxik waʼe xchiqabʼij. Ta xuriq uqʼij kalaxik, ta xalan puch ri qʼapoj, IxKikʼ ubʼiʼ.

Ma kʼu xuwachij Atiʼt ta xeʼalaxik. Libʼaj chi xeyakeʼik. E kaʼibʼ chi kalaxik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke kibʼiʼ. Pa juyubʼ xeyakeʼ wi. Ta xeʼok kʼut pa ja, ma kʼu kewarik.

“Jeʼatzaqa uloq, qitzij chach kichiʼ,” xchaʼ ri Atiʼt. Kʼateʼ kʼut xeyaʼ pa sanik. Qʼus kʼu kiwaram chiriʼ.

Xeʼel chi kʼu chiriʼ. Xeyaʼ chik chuwiʼ kʼix. Areʼ ta xkaj Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen xekam ta chiriʼ pa sanik, xekam ta pu chuwiʼ kʼix xkaj rumal kichakimal, kiqʼaqʼwachibʼal puch, kumal Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Mawi xekʼulax pa ja kumal kichaqʼ [katz], nabʼek xa mawi ketaʼam, xawi kʼu pa juyubʼ xekʼiy wi.

E kʼu nimaʼq ajsuʼ ajbʼix ri JunBʼatzʼ Jun Chowen. Xenimaʼqir kʼut. Nima kʼaxkʼol rayil xeʼikʼow wi. Xekʼaxkʼobʼisaxik.

E nimaʼq etaʼmanel chik xeʼuxik. Xawi xere e ajsuʼ, e ajbʼix. E pu ajtzʼibʼabʼ, ajkʼot xeʼuxik. Ronojel chutzin kumal. Xax ketaʼam wi xeʼalaxik. Xa xenawinaq. E pu ukʼexel kiqajaw ri xebʼe chi Xibʼalbʼa kaminaq wi kiqajaw.

E kʼu nimaʼq etaʼmanel ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen; chi kikʼuʼx ronojel nabʼek ketaʼam. Ta xewinaqir ri kichaqʼ. Ma kʼu xel apanoq kinawikil rumal kikaqwachibʼal; xa chikij xqaj wi uyoqʼ kikʼuʼx. Mawi bʼanoj xepoyisaxik kumal ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xa kʼu [18v] wubʼanik chikibʼano juta qʼij. Ma wi keloqʼoxik rumal ri katiʼt, Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Mawi chiyaʼ kiwa. Xbʼaninaq waʼim, xeʼ pu waʼinaq ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen ta keʼulik. Ma kʼu keqʼaqʼarik, oyowarik xa chikikuyu. Xere ketaʼam kikʼojeʼik, kejeʼ riʼ saq kakilo.

Kukʼaʼm kʼut kitzʼikin ta keʼulik. Juta qʼij chikitiʼ kʼutri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen. Ma jabʼiʼ nakilaʼ chiyaʼ chi kech kikabʼichal: ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Xakʼu suʼ xa pu bʼix chikibʼano JunBʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen.

Ta xeʼul ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke ma jabʼiʼ chik kitzʼikin kukʼaʼm xeʼok uloq. Xqʼaqʼar kʼu ri Atiʼt.

“Nakipaʼ rumal ma jabʼiʼ chi tzʼikin iwukʼaʼam?” xeʼuchax kʼut ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Areʼ wi, ix qatiʼt, xa wi mixetanatobʼ qatzʼikin chuwiʼ cheʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut.

“Ma kʼu jabʼiʼ chaqʼan chuwiʼ cheʼ chiqech, ix qatiʼt. Chikaj ta pu ri qatz kebʼe ta qukʼ.

Chibʼe ta kiqasaj uloq ri tzʼikin,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ kojbʼe iwukʼ saqirik,” xechaʼ kʼu ri katz. Ta xechʼakowik.

Xkʼaminaq kʼut kinaʼoj kikabʼichal chirech kichʼakik Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen.

“Xa qatzolqʼomij kikʼojeʼik. E upam qatzij. Ta chuxoq, rumal nima kʼaxkʼol mixkibʼan chiqe. Xojkam taj, xojsach taj puch, xkaj ri oj kichaqʼ. Kejeʼ riʼ ala xojpe wi uloq chi kikʼuʼx, kejeʼ kʼut kechʼak wi. Xa retal chiqabʼano,” xechaʼ chikibʼil kibʼ.

Ta xebʼe kʼut chilaʼ chuxeʼ cheʼ, Qʼan Teʼ ubʼiʼ, kachbʼiʼlan kʼu ri katz ta xebʼek xkitikibʼaʼ chi kʼut wubʼanik. Mawi ajilan chi tzʼikin chuwiʼ cheʼ, kechʼititik. Xemayijan kʼut ri katz ta xkil ri tzʼikin. Areʼ ri tzʼikin ma jabʼiʼ junoq xqaj uloq chuxeʼ cheʼ.

“Ri qatzʼikin e mawi keqaj uloq. Xa jixqasaj uloq,” xechaʼ kʼut chire katz. [19r]

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ”, xechaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ puch xeʼaqʼanik chuwiʼ cheʼ. Xnimar kʼut ri cheʼ, xsipoj upam. Kʼateʼ kʼut xerajqaj uloq. Ma kʼu utz chi kiqajik uloq chuwiʼ cheʼ Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen.

Xechaʼ kʼu uloq chuwiʼ cheʼ: “Jupachaʼ kojuchanik[kojqajik] ix qachaqʼ? Toqʼobʼ qawach! Areʼ ri cheʼ kaxibʼin chik kaqilo, Ix Qachaqʼ,” xechaʼ uloq chuwiʼ cheʼ.

Xechaʼ kʼu ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke: “Chikiraʼ iwex; chiximaʼ uxeʼ ipam, najtik utzaʼm chijureje [chijururej] chiwij, kʼateʼ kʼut utz ibʼinik,” xeʼuchax chik kumal kichaqʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“We,” xechaʼ kʼut. Ta xkijurubʼaʼ kʼut utzaʼm kitoʼk, xa pu jusuʼ kijeʼ chi xuxik. Xa kʼoy xkiwachibʼej chik. Kʼateʼ kʼut xebʼe chuwiʼ taq cheʼ, Chʼuti Juyubʼ, Nima Juyubʼ; xebʼek pa taq Kʼicheʼlaj;  kewojon chik, kisilaj [kesilij] chik chuqabʼ taq cheʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼut kichʼakatajik Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen kumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke xa rumal kinawal ta xkibʼano.

Xa xeʼopan kʼut chi kochoch xechaʼ kʼut xeʼopanik rukʼ katiʼt, rukʼ pu kichuch: “IxQatiʼt, naqilaʼ mixikʼulwachij ri qatz? Xa rax kiwach mixebʼek; kejeʼ ri e chikop chik,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“We naqilaʼ mixibʼan chike iwatz, mixiniqʼalabʼaʼ, mi pu xinichʼikibʼaʼ. Ma ta kejeʼ xibʼan chike iwatz, Ix Wiy.” xchaʼ ri Atiʼt chikech Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Xechaʼ chi kʼut chire katiʼt: “Mixbʼisonik, Ix Qatiʼt. Xchiwil chik kiwach ri watz [qatz]; xkeʼulik. Xere chi kʼut utijowik waʼ chiwe, Ix Qatiʼt: laʼ qi mixtzeʼnik. Qatijaʼ na kiqʼij [qaqʼij],” xechaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ puch xkitikibʼaʼ suʼanik; Jun Ajpu Kʼoy xkisuʼaj. Kʼateʼ puch xebʼixanik, xesuʼanik, xeqʼojomanik ta ukʼamik ri kisuʼ, kiqʼojom. Ta xkubʼeʼ puch ri katiʼt kukʼ. Ta xesuʼanik. Xesikʼix pa suʼ, pa bʼix, ta xubʼinaʼaj ri Jun [19v] Ajpu Kʼoy ubʼiʼ suʼ.

Ta xeʼok kʼu uloq ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen, kexajowik ta xeʼulik. Kʼateʼ puch ta xmuqan[xmuqun] ri atiʼt; itzel kiwach xril atiʼt, ta xtzeʼnik. Ma wi xukuy utzeʼ Atiʼt; xa kʼu jusuʼ xebʼek; mawi xil chik kiwach; e yakatik xebʼe pa kʼecheʼlaj.

“Naqipaʼ chibʼano, Ix Qatiʼt? Xa kajmul xchiqatijo. Xa oxmul chik xkeqasikʼij pa suʼ, pa bʼix, kichikuyuʼ itzeʼ. Qatijaʼ chi na!” xechaʼ chik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Kʼateʼ xesuʼan chik, ta xeʼok chi uloq, kexajow chik xeʼul chik chi unikʼajal uwa ja. Xawi qʼusqʼus kakibʼano; xawi kakitaqchiʼj ri katiʼt chi tzeʼ. Libʼaj chi xtzeʼn chiri katiʼt. Qitzij tzeʼbʼal kiwach ri Kʼoy chi xiririk xeʼ kipam, chi chilita jeʼ pu chu chiʼ kikʼuʼx ta xeʼok uloq areʼ kʼut kʼi chu tzeʼej Atiʼt. Kateʼ xebʼe chik pa taq juyubʼ.

“Nakipaʼ chi qabʼano Ix Qatiʼt, xere chi waʼ roxmul chik xchiqatijo,” xchaʼ ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xesuʼan chik. Xeʼul chik; kexajowik. Xa kʼu chukuyukaʼ utzeʼ ri katiʼt. Xeʼaqʼan kʼu uloq chuqʼatanaj tzʼaq. Kaq ruxruj uchiʼ taq kiwach; mutzumaʼq kichiʼ; chi kʼimal[chikʼichaʼq] kichiʼ, kiwach; ma kʼama chi kijoqʼij chike. Ta xril chi kʼut ri Atiʼt kʼateʼ xpoqʼolij chi utzeʼ ri katiʼt. Ma chi kʼu xil chi kiwach rumal utzeʼbʼal Atiʼt.

“Xere wi kʼu waʼ Ix Qatiʼt, xkeqapixabʼaj ubʼik chu kajmul kʼut xesuʼax chik. Ma kʼu xeʼul chik chu kajmul; jusuʼ xebʼek pa Kʼecheʼlaj.

Xechaʼ kʼut chire Katiʼt: “Mi kʼu xqatijo, Ix Qatiʼt. Mi nabʼe xeʼulik, mi pu xqatij chik kisikʼixik. Mixbʼison kʼut: Oj kʼolik; Oj iwiy! Xa chiloqʼoj ri qachuch, Ix Qatiʼt. Kenabʼax ri qatz. Ta chuxoq!

Mi xekʼobʼik, mi pu xbʼinajik Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen, [20r] keʼuchaʼxik”, xechaʼ ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Xesikʼix kʼut rumal ri ajsuʼ, ajbʼix, ri Ojer Winaq. Areʼ puch chusikʼij ri ajtzʼibʼ, ajkʼot ojer. Xechikopirik; e Kʼoy xeʼuxik rumal xa xkinimarisaj kibʼ; kiyoqʼ ri kichaqʼ; kejeʼ ri kalabʼil chi kikʼuʼx. Kejeʼ kʼut kimayixik riʼ ta xesachik ri Jun Bʼatzʼ, Jun Chowen; e chikop xeʼuxik.

Areʼ kʼut e ramaqʼelal; kʼo pa kochoch chik. Xawi xere e ajsu, e ajbʼix. Nim chik xkibʼano ta xekʼojeʼik rukʼ ratiʼt, rukʼ pu kichuch. Ta xkitikibʼaʼ chi kʼut kibʼanoj, kikʼutbʼal kibʼ chuwach katiʼt, chuwach pu kichuch.

Nabʼe, xkibʼano ri abʼix: “Xa kojabʼixik, Ix Qatiʼt, Ix pu Qachuch,” xechaʼ.

“Mixbʼisonik, oj kʼolik, oj iwiy, oj kikʼexel qatz,” xechaʼ kʼu ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke ta xkikʼam kʼut kikaj, kimixkina, kixokem, xebʼek rukʼ jujun kiwubʼ xkitelej. Xeʼel chi kochoch, ta xkipixabʼaj kan katiʼt chire uyaʼik kiwa.

“Chitikʼoj na qʼij, chibʼeyaʼ qawa, ix qatiʼt,” xechaʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ la, ix wiy,” xchaʼ kʼut ri katiʼt.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xeʼopon chi riʼ keʼabʼix wi. Xaqi xkichʼikibʼaʼ ri mixkina pulew; xa kʼu kʼi chitajin ri mixkina pu ulew; ma kʼu kʼi chitajin ri mixkina chutukel areʼ kʼu ri ikaj xawi chi kʼi chʼikibʼaʼ chutolokʼ cheʼ, xawi chukabʼ ribʼ cheʼ chibʼek; chilajajik chibʼek ronojel cheʼ kʼaʼm. Kaq chakachoj chik chi qʼatoj cheʼ chubʼan ri xa jun ikaj.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼu ri mixkina tzatz chi qʼupuj; mawi ajilan tum kʼixik kubʼan ri xa jun chi mixkina; mawi ajilan qʼupuj; xa chʼuti juyubʼ, xa nima juyubʼ kabʼek.

Ta xkipixabʼaj kʼut jun chikop, Xmukur ubʼiʼ. Xkitʼuyubʼaʼ aqʼanoq chuwiʼ nima kutaʼm. Xechaʼ kʼut Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke: “Xa chawil ri qatiʼt chipetik, yaʼol wa. Jusuʼ katoqʼik ta petoq. Kʼateʼ kʼut [20v] chiqachap ri mixkina rukʼ ikaj.”

“Utzbʼaʼ laʼ,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Xmukur. Areʼ kʼut xa wubʼanik chikibʼano. Ma na qitzij abʼixik ta chikibʼano. Kʼateʼ puch choqʼ ri Xmukur, anim kʼut kepetik.

Jun chichapo[w] mixikina; jun kʼut chichapo ri ikaj. Chikipislaʼ kiwiʼ, xaloqʼ chubʼaqʼalaʼ ulew puqʼabʼ ri Jun; xa kejeʼ chutzʼilaj uwach; kejeʼ riʼ qitzij abʼixom.

Areʼ kʼu ri Jun chik xaloqʼ chupuqʼij uwebʼal cheʼ pu jolom; kejeʼ wi ri qitzij qʼatoj cheʼenel ta xil rumal katiʼt kʼateʼ kʼut kewaʼik. Ma qitzij abʼixik chikibʼano xaloqʼ chibʼeyaʼoq kiwa.

Ta xebʼe kʼut chi kochoch.

“Qitzij mixojkosik, Ix Qatiʼt,” kechaʼ keʼoponik. Xaloqʼ chikikʼikij chikiyuq puch kaqan, kiqʼabʼ chuwach katiʼt.

Ta xebʼe chi kʼut chuka qʼij; keʼopon kʼut pa kabʼix; kʼisyakatajinaq chik ronojel cheʼ, kʼaʼm uchapom chi ribʼ ronojel tum kʼixik ta xeʼoponik.

“Apachinaq kojmichʼowik?” xechaʼ kʼut.

Areʼ kʼut kebʼanow riʼ ronojel chʼuti chikop, nima chikop: koj, bʼalam, kej, umul, yak, utiw, aq, sis, chʼuti tzʼikin, nima tzʼikin. Areʼ xebʼanowik, xa jun aqʼabʼ xkibʼano.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkitikibʼaʼ chik abʼixik. Xawi xubʼan chi ribʼ ulew, rukʼ qʼatoj cheʼ. Ta xkʼam chi kʼu kinaʼoj chiriʼ pa qʼatoj cheʼ, pa qʼupuj puch.

“Xa qawaraj ri qabʼix. Anaʼ wi chi na kabʼano[w] ula; laki ta chi qariqo,” xechaʼ ta xkʼam kinaʼoj.

Ta xeʼopon chi kʼut chi ja.

“Nakiʼ riʼ lo kojmichʼowik, Ix Qatiʼt. Nima kʼim chik, nima kʼecheʼlaj chi puch ri qabʼix ta xojopon mier, Ix Qatiʼt,” xechaʼ kʼut chire katiʼt, chire pu kichuch.

“Xkojbʼe kʼut, xchiqawaraj rumal mawi utz kabʼan chiqe,” xechaʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut xebʼatzonik. Kʼateʼ kʼut kibʼeik chik pa kiqʼatoj cheʼ. Chiriʼ kʼut xematzejeʼ[21r] wi. E muqumuxinaq chik chiriʼ ta xekuchuw kʼu kibʼ ronojel chikop.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xa jun xkisep wi kibʼ ronojel chʼutichikop, nima chikop. Areʼ puch tikʼil ukʼuʼx aqʼabʼ ta xepetik. Xechʼawijʼeʼik konojel ta xepetik areʼ kichʼabʼal riʼ: “Yaklin cheʼ, yaklin kʼaʼm,” xechaʼ ta xepetik. Kenebʼebʼik xeʼ cheʼ, xeʼ kʼaʼm ta xeyopijik, ta xekʼutun kʼu chikiwach.

Areʼ kʼut unabʼe ri Koj, Bʼalam; xraj kʼu xkichapo, ma wi xuyaʼ ribʼ. Ta xyopijchik Kej, Umul; xa kʼu chu jeʼ xkichap wi; xa kʼu xqʼupukubʼ kanajoq ujeʼ Kej pa kiqʼabʼ; ta xukʼam ri ujeʼ Kej rukʼ ujeʼ Umul riʼ. Xtzqʼataq kijeʼ.

Ma kʼu xkiyaʼ kibʼ ri Yak, Utiw, Aq, Sis.; xeʼikʼow konojel chikop chi kiwach ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Chiqʼatat chi kʼut kikʼuʼx rumal ri maja bʼiʼ xkichapo.

Xpe kʼu ri jun chik, uxambʼe chik; katzotzotik ta xpetik. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkiqʼatej, xkise kʼut pa kul ri chʼo. Kʼateʼ puch xkichapo, xkiyotej puch chirij uwiʼ; xraj kibʼiyo. Xkiporoj ujeʼ chuwiʼ qʼaqʼ. Ta xukʼam ujeʼ chʼo; maja bʼi rismal ujeʼ; areʼ nayi pu ubʼaqʼ uwach ta xraj bʼiyik kumal kʼajolabʼ ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Ma ta kinkamik iwumal. Mawi areʼ ipatan ri abʼixik. Kʼo iwe,” xchaʼ ri Chʼo.

“Apa kʼo wi qe? Chabʼij na kʼut,” xechaʼ kʼu ri kʼajolabʼ chire Chʼo; “la kinitzoqopij ta na bʼaʼ laʼ! Kʼo nutzij chi nupam, kʼateʼ kʼut chinbʼij chiwe chiyaʼ ta na skʼaqin wechaʼ,” xchaʼ ri Chʼo.

“Kʼateʼ chi qayaʼo awechaʼ. Chabʼij na,” xuchaxik.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Areʼ bʼaʼ ri rech iqajaw ri Jun JunAjpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu ubʼiʼ ri xekam chi Xibʼalbʼa. Kʼo kʼu kanoq ri ketzʼabʼaʼl xekel kanoq chuwiʼ Ja: kibʼate, kipachqʼabʼ, kikikʼ puch. Xa mawi kakʼut chiwach rumal iwatiʼt; rumal ri areʼ xkam wi iqajaw.”

“Ma qitzij awetaʼm?” xechaʼ kʼu ri kʼajolabʼ[21v] chire Chʼo. Nim xkiʼkot kikʼuʼx ta xkitaʼo utzijel kikʼ ta xubʼij Chʼo. Ta xkiyaʼ kʼut rechaʼ Chʼo.

Areʼ kʼu rechaʼ riʼ: Ixim, Sakil, Ik, Kinaqʼ, Peq, Kakaw.

“Areʼ kʼut awech riʼ. We nakilaʼ kʼuʼn chi mes kʼutajinaq, awech kʼut; chakʼuxuʼ,” xuchax kʼu ri Chʼo kumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, Ix Kʼajolabʼ. Nakilaʼ kʼu kinwuchaʼaj we kiril ri iwatiʼt?” xchaʼ kʼut.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Mawi chitzaq akʼuʼx, oj kʼolik, kojnoʼjinik; kʼo ruchaʼxik ri qatiʼt. Xa jusuʼ kaqayaʼ aqʼanoq xikin ja. Ta kʼu joko [kojok] apanoq jusuʼ katopon chiriʼ xekel wi. Chiriʼ kʼut kaqil wi pu tum ja; xa pa qatiʼ kaqil wi,” xechaʼ kʼut chire Chʼo. Ta xkipixabʼaj jun aqʼabʼ xkʼam kinaʼoj ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Kʼi kʼu tikʼil qʼij xeʼoponik. Ma kʼu qʼalaj ri Chʼo kukʼaʼm ta xeʼoponik. Jun ri yakalik xok pa Ja. Jun kʼu xok xikin Ja, libʼaj chi xuya aqʼanoq ri Chʼo.

Ta xkitzʼonoj kʼut kiwa chire katiʼt. “Xa chiqʼutuʼ qatiʼ; kaqarayij ri qʼutum ik, Ix Qatiʼt,” xechaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkʼut kitiʼ: jun laq uwaʼal xtikʼibʼax chi kiwach.

Xawi kimichʼbʼal re katiʼt, kichuch puch. Xkitzajisaj ka jaʼ pa qʼeʼbʼal.

“Qitzij chaqiʼj qachiʼ. Chikʼamaʼ qukʼiyaʼ,” xechaʼ chire katiʼt.

“We,” xchaʼ kʼut, ta xbʼek. Areʼ kʼut kewaʼ kanoq. Ma kʼu qitzij ta kenumik; xa kimoywachibʼal xkibʼano. Ta xkil kʼut ri chʼo chupam qʼutum ik. Kʼolon uloq ri Chʼo chrij kikʼ xekel wi puwiʼ ja ta xkilo pa qʼutum ik. Ta xkitaq kʼut jun xaʼn-ri chikop ri xaʼn kejeʼ ri us. Xopon chi Jaʼ. Areʼ kʼu xworow uwach qeʼbʼal Atiʼt. Xa yakal jaʼ chel chuwach uqʼebʼal; chutijo, xma chitzʼapitaj wi uwach qʼeʼbʼal.

“Nakipaʼ mixubʼan ri qatiʼt? Oj jisbʼaj [jiʼslabʼaj] chi yaʼ, kojutzin rumal chaqiʼj chiʼ,” xechaʼ chik chire kichuch. Ta xkitaq ubʼik.

Kʼateʼ kʼu [22r] xukaqʼat [kuqʼat] ula chʼo ri kikʼ, xqaj ula pu tum ja, rukʼ bʼate, pachqʼabʼ, tzʼuʼum, xkimajixtaj kʼut. Kʼateʼ xbʼekewajpa bʼe: ubʼeʼl jom.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xebʼe chik rukʼ katiʼt chi yaʼ. Katajin kʼu ri katiʼt, kichuch tzʼapi uwach qʼeʼbʼal jujun. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xeʼoponik jujun chikʼu chi wubʼ ta xeʼoponik chi yaʼ.

“Naki paʼ mixibʼano? Xa mixkos qakʼuʼx, xojpetik,” xechaʼ.

“Chiwilaʼ na uwach nuqʼeʼbʼal. Mawi katzʼapitajik,” xchaʼ katiʼt. Libʼaj chi kʼut xkitzʼapij chik. Junam kʼut xepe chik, e nabʼe chwach katiʼt. Kejeʼ kʼu ukanajik kikʼ riʼ

Kekiʼkot chi kʼut, xebʼek e chaʼjel pa jom. Najt kʼu xechaʼjik kitukel. Xkimes ri jom [ujom] kiqajaw.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xkita kʼu uloq rajawal Xibʼalbʼa: “Apachina chiriʼ mixutikibʼaʼ chik etzʼanem pa qawiʼ? Ma pa kekʼixbʼik keniknot uloq? Ma pa xekam ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu xraj kinimarisaj kibʼ chiqawach? Jeʼ kʼu itaqa chik,” xechaʼ chik ri Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Konojel ajawabʼ xetaqa [Jetaqa] uloq, xechaʼ kʼut chire kisamajel:

«Kixchaʼ kixoponik: “Kepetoq, kechaʼ ajawabʼ. Waral taj kojchaʼj wi kukʼ.Wuqubʼix kojetzʼanik, kixchaʼ ajawabʼ,” kixchaʼ, kixoponik,» xeʼuchax kʼut ri Samajel.

Ta xepe kʼut nima jok kʼu kibʼe ri kʼajolabʼ chi kochoch kʼa toqʼol chi kochoch. Xa kʼu yakal ri Samajel xopon rukʼ katiʼt. Areʼ kʼut kechaʼjik ta xul kanoq Samajel Xibʼalbʼa.

«“Qitzij kepetik,” kechaʼ ri ajawabʼ,»xechaʼ kʼut ri usamajel Xibʼalbʼa. Ta xchoyeʼ kʼu kanoq kiqʼij kumal ri usamajel ri Xibʼalbʼa.

“Wuqubʼix ketzʼelawachixik,” xuchax kanoq IxMukane.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, xkebʼetaqoq, Ix Samajel,” xchaʼ ri Atiʼt. Xebʼe kʼu ri samajel, xetzalijik.

Ta xkʼis kʼut ukʼuʼx ri Atiʼt.

“Nakiʼ xchiwuchaj kitaqik ri wiy? Mawi kitzij ri [22v] Xibʼalbʼa? Xa kejeʼ rulik Samajel ojer ta xebʼekamoq ri kiqajaw,” xchaʼ ri Atiʼt. Qʼusqus choqʼ pa ja utukel.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xqaj ula jun ukʼ chukʼayak. Kʼateʼ kʼu xuchap aqʼanoq; ta xuyaʼ kʼut puqabʼ chimalmatibʼ[chimalmatik] kʼu ri ukʼ xbʼinik.

“At ukʼ, chawaj taj kanutaqo. Kebʼe ta ataqa ri wiy pa jom,” xuchax ri ukʼ, ta xbʼek taqonel.

«“Mixul Samajel rukʼ iwatiʼt,” kachaʼ katoponik: “Wuqubʼix kʼut keʼoponik, kachaʼ usamajel Xibʼalbʼa, kachaʼ iwatiʼt,” kachaʼ,» xuchax ri ukʼ.

Ta xbʼek, chi malmat kʼut xbʼek. Kubʼul kʼu rikʼajol pa bʼe; Tamasul ubʼiʼ ri Xpeq.

“Apa katbʼe wi?” xchaʼ kʼu ri Xpeq chi re Ukʼ.

“Kʼo bʼa nutzij chi nupam. Kinbʼe kukʼ kʼajolabʼ,” xchaʼ ri Ukʼ chire Tamasul.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, ma bʼa katanik, kawilo,” xuchax kʼu Ukʼ rumal Xpeq. “Ma chawaj kanubʼiqʼo? Chawila na peʼ kinanik waʼ xkojopon chanim!”

“Utz bʼalaʼ,” xchaʼ ri Ukʼ chirech Xpeq. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xriqʼtaxik [xbʼiqʼitajik] rumal Xpeq. Chibʼek, naj kʼu ri Xpeq ta xbʼek, chi mawi kaʼanik. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xukʼul chi kʼut jun Nima Kumatz, Saqiqʼas ubʼiʼ.

“Apakatbʼe wi, at Tamasul kʼajol?” xuchax chik ri Xpeq rumal Saqiqʼas.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“In Samajel, kʼo nutzij chi nupam,” xchaʼ chi kʼut Xpeq chire Kumatz.

“Ma bʼaʼ katanik kawilo. In taon xkinopon chanim,” xchaʼ kʼu Kumatz chire Xpeq.

“Katojoʼ,” xuchaxik. Kʼateʼ kʼu xbʼiqʼ chik ri Xpeq rumal Saqiqʼas. Ta xukʼam ri rechaʼ kumatz. Kebʼiqʼow xpeq wakamik.

Chʼan kʼu ri Kumatz ta xbʼek. Xkʼulutaj chiwi kʼut ri Kumatz rumal Wak, Nima Tzʼikin. Xbʼiqʼ chiwi ri Kumatz rumal Wak. Kʼateʼ pu xopon riʼ chuwiʼ jom. Ta xukʼam rechaʼ ri xik, ketiʼyoʼw kumatz pa taq juyubʼ.

Ta xopon puch ri Wak, xchakachobʼ chuwiʼ utzʼutzʼil jom. Kekiʼkot kʼu ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke kechaʼjik.

Ta xopon kʼut ri Wak, ta xoqʼ kʼu ri Wak: [23r] “Wak kʼo, Wak kʼo,” xchaʼ kʼu roqʼibʼal Wako [Wak].

“Nakipaʼ ri choqʼik?” Pe ta qawubʼ,” xechaʼ.

Kʼateʼ puch xkiwubʼaj ri Wak. Ke kʼu taqal ubʼaqʼ wubʼ chubʼaqʼ uwach, chisetet kʼut xqaj uloq. Qitzij wi kʼut xbʼekichapaʼ. Kʼateʼ xkitzʼonoj: “Jupa apetik?” xechaʼ chire Wak.

“Kʼo bʼa nutzij chinupam. Chikunaj ta na ubʼaqʼ nuwach nabʼe, kʼateʼ kʼut xchinbʼij,” xchaʼ ri Wak.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ xkelesaj skʼaqin rij kikʼ ri chaʼj, xkikoj chi uwach ri Wak.  Lotz kikʼ xubʼinaʼj kumal; libʼaj chi kʼut xkachʼoj kumal, utz chik umuqʼubʼal ri Wak xuxuik.

“Chabʼij kʼut,” xechaʼ chire Wak. Kʼateʼ kʼut xuxawaj Nima Kumatz.

“Kachʼawoq,” xechaʼ chik chire Kumatz.

“We,” xchaʼ chi kʼut, ta xuxawaj chi Xpeq.

“Nakipaʼ ataqikil? Kattzijonoq,” xuchax chi kʼu ri Xpeq.

“Kʼo bʼaʼ nutzij chi nupam,” xchaʼ chi kʼu ri Xpeq. Kʼateʼ kʼut xutij xabʼik. Ma jabʼi xuxawaj, xa kejeʼ chukʼaxaj [chukʼabʼ]uchiʼ. Chutijo, xma kʼo wi chuxawaj; kʼateʼ kʼut xraj chʼayik kumal Kʼajolabʼ.

“At kʼaxtokʼ,” xuchaxik. Ta xyik [xchʼayik] uwa rachaq chi aqan. Xqaj kʼu bʼaqil [ubʼaqil] uwa rachaq chi aqan. Xutij chi kʼut xa kʼejeʼ chu chubʼ [chukʼabʼ] uchiʼ.

Kʼateʼ puch xkirechʼ uchiʼ ri xpeq; xrechʼ kumal Kʼajolabʼ. Xkitzukuj pu chiʼ, xa kʼu nakʼal ri ukʼ chuware Xpeq; xa pu chiʼ kʼo wi ma na xubʼiqʼo; xa kejeʼ[x]xabʼik.

Kejeʼ kʼut xchʼakataj wi ri xpeq. Mawi qʼalaj uwach rechaʼ xkiyaʼo, rukʼ mawi [x]chanik, xa uchʼaqʼ kumatz xuxik.

“Katzijonoq,” xuchax chi kʼut ri Ukʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xubʼij kʼu utzij: «Kachaʼ iwatiʼt, ix kʼajolabʼ: “Jeʼataqʼaʼ! Xul taqol ke, kape chi Xibʼalbʼa, usamajel Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.Wuqubʼix keʼulik waral kojchaʼj [23v]wi.Chipe ri ketzʼabʼaʼl: kikʼ, bʼate, pachqʼabʼ, tzʼuʼum. Are chikʼastaj bʼej uwach waral, kechaʼ ajawabʼ, xul kitzij,” kachaʼ iwatiʼt ta xipetik.“Qitzij,” kachaʼ iwatiʼt koqʼik, kasikʼinik iwatiʼt, xipetik.»

“Ma qitzij?” xechaʼ kʼut Kʼajolabʼ chi kikʼuʼx ta xkitaʼo. Jusuʼ xepetik, xeʼopon kʼut rukʼ katiʼt; xa e pixabʼay chi re katiʼt xebʼek.

«Joʼ na, Ix Qatiʼt. Xa oj pixabʼay iwe. Waʼe kʼuteʼ retal qatzij xchiqakanaj. Jujun xchiqatik chire ʼWa Ajʼ. Chunikʼajal qochoch xchiqatik wi. Areʼ retal qakamik we chichaqijik. “Mi pa xekamik?” kixchaʼ ta chichaqijik. We kʼut ta chipe utux: “E pa kʼaslik,” kixchaʼ kʼut, Ix Qatiʼt, Ix pu Qachuch: Mixoqʼik: Ixoq Ikʼ. Kʼo retal qatzij kakanajik iwukʼ,» xechaʼ.

Ta xebʼek. Jun xutik Jun Ajpu; Jun chi kʼu xtikow Xbʼalanke.

Xa pa Ja xutik wi.

Ma na pa Juyubʼ taj; ma nayi pu pa Rax Ulew taj.

Xa pa Chaqiʼj Ulew, chunikʼajal upa kochoch xkitik wi kanoq.

Ta xebʼe kʼut jujunc hi wubʼ chike. Xeqaj chi Xibʼalbʼa.

Libʼaj chi xeqaj chu wa kumuk, xeʼikʼow chi wi kʼut chupam Jal Jaʼ Siwan...Xa chuxoʼl tzʼikin xeʼikʼow wi; areʼ ri Tzʼikin Molay kibʼi...Xeʼikʼow chi kʼut pa Pujiyaʼ, pa Kikʼiyaʼ: Chʼakbʼal ta ke chi kikʼuʼx Xibʼalbʼa, mawi xkiyikow[yeqʼo], xa chrij wubʼ xeʼikʼow wi. Xeʼel chi kʼu apanoq pa Kajibʼ Xalqʼat Bʼe; xa ketaʼm wi kʼut kibʼe Xibʼalbʼa: Qʼeqa Bʼe, Saqi Bʼe, Kaqabʼe, Raxa Bʼe.

Chi riʼ kʼut xkitaq wi Jun Chikop: Xaʼn ubʼiʼ; areʼ kʼamol kita xkitaq ubʼik.

“Jujunal keʼatiʼo nabʼe chatiʼ ri nabʼe kubʼulel, chatzaqonisaj qitiʼik konojel xa wech wi kʼut chatzʼubʼaj wi ukikʼel ri winaq pa bʼe,” xuchaʼxik ri Xaʼn.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” [24r]xchaʼ [xchaʼ] kʼu ri Xaʼn.

Ta xok pa Qʼeqa Bʼe taqal kʼu chrij ri Poy, Ajam Cheʼ. Nabʼe kuʼlel e kawutalik; nabʼe kʼut xkitiyʼo, mawi xchʼawik. Xutijo chi kʼut, ta xutiy chi ukabʼ kuʼlel, ma chi wi xchʼawik.

Xutiyʼo chi kʼu rox; kʼa chi rox kuʼlel kʼo wi Jun Kame.

“Aki! Aji!” xchaʼ kʼut jun ta xtiyʼik.

“Naki; Aji,” xchaʼ Jun Kame.”

“Nakiʼ Jun Kame?” (xchaʼ).

“Naki la mixitiowik?”
