source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Xa Aji [Aji]! Nakiʼ chi laʼ mi xitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik ukaj kuʼlel.

“Nakiʼʼ Wuqubʼ Kame?” (xchaʼ Jun Kame.)

“Nakiʼ laʼ mi xitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chi roʼ kuʼlel.

“Aji, aji!” xchaʼ na.

“Na? Xikiripat?” xchaʼ Wuqubʼ Kame chi re.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Xtiyʼik uwaqaq kuʼlel.

“Aji!”

“Nakiʼ, Kuchuma Kikʼ?” xchaʼ Xikiripat chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiyʼ uwuq kuʼlel.

“Aji!” xchaʼ chik.

“Nakiʼ Ajal Puj?” xchaʼ Kuchuma Kikʼ chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mi xitiyoʼwik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiʼ chik uwajxaq kuʼlel.

“Aji!” xchaʼ chik.

“Nakiʼ, Ajal Qʼanaʼ?” xchaʼ chi Ajal Puj chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mi xitiyʼowik?” xchaʼ [xchaʼ] chik.

Ta xtiyʼ chik ubʼelej kuʼlel.

“Aji!” xchaʼ.

“Nakiʼ, Chʼamiʼya Bʼaq?” xchaʼ Ajal Qʼanaʼ chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiyʼ chik, ulajuj kubʼulel.

“Aji!”

“Nakiʼ, Chʼamiʼya Jolom?” xchaʼ Chʼamiʼya Bʼaq.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiyʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiʼ chik, ujulajuj kuʼlel.

“Aji!” xchaʼ chik.

“Nakiʼ, (Kʼala Xikʼ)?” xchaʼ chik Chʼamiʼya Jolom chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiyʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiyʼ chik ukabʼlajuj kuʼlel.

“Aji!” xchaʼ chik.

“Nakiʼ, Patan?” xchaʼ chik chire.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiyʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiʼ chik roxlajuj kuʼlel.

“Aji!” “Nakiʼ, Kʼikʼ Reʼ?” xchaʼ Patan chirech.

“Nakiʼ laʼ mixitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

Ta xtiyʼ chik ukajlajuj kuʼlel.

“Aji! Naqiʼ laʼ mixitiʼowik?” xchaʼ chik.

“Kikʼ Rixkʼaq?” xchaʼ Kikʼ Re chirech.

Kejeʼ kʼut ubʼixik kibʼiʼ, ri xkibʼij konojel chi kibʼil kibʼ. Xkikʼut kiwach; Ix Kikʼutuwach. Xkibʼij kibʼiʼ[24v]jujun chi joloman ubʼixik kumal. Areʼ chibʼin ubʼiʼ jun ri kubʼul chuxukʼut. Ma jabʼiʼ junoq xkisach ubʼiʼ; kʼis kibʼij kibʼiʼ konojel. Ta xetiyʼ rumal rismal uwach uchʼek Jun Ajpu xumichʼ ubʼik. Mana qitzij Xaʼn ri xetiyʼowik, xbʼetaʼo wa wi na kibʼiʼ konojel rumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xebʼek, ta xeʼopon puch chilaʼ e kʼo wi Xibʼalbʼa: “Chiqʼijilaʼ Ajaw,” xchaʼ.

“Ri kubʼulik,” xchaʼ jun taqchiʼnel.

“Mawi areʼ Ajaw ri; Xa poy, Ajam Cheʼ riʼ,” xechaʼ ta xeʼoponik.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xeqʼaʼlaʼinik:

“Qʼaʼla Ta Jun Kame, Qʼaʼla Ta Wuqubʼ Kame.

Qʼaʼla Ta Xikiripat.

Qʼaʼla Ta Kuchuma Kikʼ.

Qʼaʼla Ta Ajal Puj.

Qʼaʼla Ta Ajal Qʼanaʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Qʼaʼla Ta Chʼamiʼya Bʼaq.

Qʼaʼla Ta Chʼamiʼya Jolom.

Qʼaʼla Ta Xikʼ.

Qʼaʼla Ta Patan.

Qʼaʼla Ta Kikʼ Re.

Qʼaʼla Ta Kikʼ Rixkʼaq,” xechaʼ xeʼoponik.

Ronojel xkʼis kʼut uwach, xkibʼij ubʼiʼ ronojel; ma jabʼiʼ jun xkisach ubʼiʼ. Areʼ ta xajawax chi kech, mata xkanaj ubʼiʼ kumal.

“Kixkuʼloq,” xeʼuchax kʼut; xerajoq chuwiʼ tem, ma kʼu xkaj.

“Mawi are qatem riʼ; xa chojim abʼaj ri tem,” xechaʼ Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Mawi xechʼakatajik.

“Utzbʼa laʼ, xa bʼa jix pa ja,” xeʼuchaxik.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xeʼok pa Qʼequʼma Ja. Mawi xechʼakatajik chiriʼ. Areʼ nabʼe utijobʼal Xibʼalbʼa ri xeʼok wi ke; chi kʼu utikarik kichʼakatajik ta chik chi kikʼuʼx Xibʼalbʼa. Nabʼe xeʼok pa Qʼequʼma Ja. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xbʼeyaʼoq kichäj.

Katilowik ta xoponik rukʼ jujun kisikʼ rumal usamajel Jun Kame.

“«“Waʼe kichäje,” kachaʼ Ajaw, “Chulkiyaʼ chik ri chäj saqarik rukʼ ri sikʼ; chulkimolobʼa,” kachaʼ Ajaw,»  xchaʼ Samajel ta xoponik.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Ma kʼu xkitzij ri chäj, xa kaqaj [25r] ukʼexwach xokik; areʼ ujeʼ kaqix; kejeʼ ri chäj xkilo waranel. Areʼ chi kʼu ri sikʼ xa Qʼaqʼachikop xkikojo chuwiʼ sikʼ. Jun aqʼabʼ chiyokowik kumal.

“Mixeqachʼako,” xechaʼ waranel. Ma kʼu jabʼiʼ xkʼis ri chäj; xere uwach. Areʼ kʼu ri sikʼ ma jabʼi nakilaʼ xkitzij chire. Xawi xere uwach xbʼeyaʼoq kukʼ Ajawabʼ.

“Naki paʼ keʼuxik?”

“Apa xepe wi?”

“Achinaq xekʼajolanik, xeʼalanik?”

“Qitzij kaqʼatat qakʼuʼx rumal ma utz kakibʼano chiqe.”

“Jalan kiwach, jalan nay pu kikʼojeʼik,” xechaʼ chikibʼil kibʼ.

Ta xetaqon kʼut konojel Ajawabʼ: “Oj ochaʼjoq, Ix Kʼajolabʼ,” xeʼuchaxik.

Ta xetzʼonox kʼut rumal Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

“Apa kixixpe wi? Chibʼij taj, Ix Kʼajolabʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut Xibʼalbʼaʼ.

“Mawi qetaʼm,” xa xechaʼ chike.

“A laʼ bʼa xojpe wi lo, mawi qetaʼam,” xa xechaʼ. Mawi xkibʼij.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Xa kabʼe kaqachaʼaj Ix Kʼajolabʼ,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa chike.

“Utz!”  xechaʼ.

“Areʼ bʼaʼ chiqakoj ri waʼ qakikʼ,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Ma taj. Areʼ ta chikojwaʼ qe,” xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ.

“Ma jabʼi,areʼ kaqakoj waʼ qe,” xechaʼ chik Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ.

“Jeʼ bʼaʼ laʼ, xa juchʼil!” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Ma bʼaʼ laʼ. Xa jolom kojchaʼ chik,” xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Maja bʼiʼ,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ!,” xchaʼ Jun Ajpu, ta xtzaq kʼu uloq rumal Xibʼalbʼa kikʼ utaqal chuwach ubʼate Jun Ajpu. Kʼateʼ puch ta xkil Xibʼalbʼa ri Saqi Toqʼ ta xel chupam ri kikʼ. Chitzʼininik xbʼe jeʼ chuwa taq ulew ri chaʼj.

“Naki paʼ laʼ?” xchaʼ ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Xa kamik kiwaj chi qech; ma ta xojbʼeʼitaqa? Ma ta pu xbʼe isamajel? Qitzij toqʼobʼ qawach. Xa kojbʼek,” xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ chike.

Areʼ ta kʼu xajawax chike[25v] Kʼajolabʼ, jusuʼ ta xkam ri jun chiriʼ, chiriʼ chi cha; xechʼakataj taj; mawi kejeʼ, xa Xibʼalbʼa xechʼakataj chik kumal Kʼajolabʼ.

“Ma bʼaʼ kixbʼek, Ix Kʼajolabʼ, kojchaʼj na. Xa areʼ kaqakojo ri iwech,” xuchax kʼut Kʼajolabʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Areʼ kʼu xok ri kikikʼ ta xqaj kʼu chaʼj; ta xkichoy [chaʼ] kichʼakoʼn.

“Naki paʼ chiqachʼako?” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Jeʼ na ikʼut,” xa xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ.

“Xa qachʼakaʼ kajkaj sel kotzʼiʼj,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Naki paʼ chi kotzʼiʼjal?” xechaʼ Kajolabʼ chike Xibʼalbʼa.

“Ju tiqʼabʼ kaqa muchij[muchit], ju tiqʼabʼ saqi muchit, jutiqʼabʼ qʼana muchit, jutiqʼabʼ kʼu ri nimaʼq,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut Kʼajolabʼ, ta xqaj kʼut kichaʼj; junam kichuqʼabʼ; tzatz pu kichaʼ ri Kʼajolabʼ.

Xa kʼu kʼi rutz kikʼuʼx ta xkiyaʼ kibʼ chi chʼakatajik ri Kʼajolabʼ. Kekiʼkot kʼut ri Xibʼalbʼa ta xechʼakatajik.

“Utz mixqabʼano. Nabʼe mixeqachʼako,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Apa xchibʼekikʼamaʼ wi ri kotzʼiʼj?” xechaʼ chi kikʼuʼx.

“Qitzij ta aqʼabʼ chiyaʼ ri qakotzʼiʼj qachakʼom puch,” xeʼuchax puch Kʼajolabʼ Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke rumal Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ! Aqʼabʼa chi kʼut kojchaʼjik,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xepixabʼan kibʼ.

Kʼateʼ chi kʼut ta xeʼok chi Kʼajolabʼ pa Chayim Ja, ukabʼ tijobʼal Xibʼalbʼa. Areʼ ta kʼut xajawax chik xeqʼataqʼox taj rumal cha; chanim taj chi kikʼuʼx xekam taj chi kikʼuʼx; ma kʼu xekamik. Ta xechaʼ chi re cha ta xkipixabʼaj: “Areʼ iwe ri ronojel utiyoʼjil chikop,” xechaʼ chire cha. Ma kʼu xesilabʼ chik; xa jun qaj chi wi cha ronojel. Areʼ kʼut e kʼo chi chiriʼ pa Chayim Ja chaqʼabʼ: ta xkisikʼij ronojel sanik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Chay [26r] sanik, chʼeken sanik, kixpetoq, kixojoqʼ iwonojel. Oj ikʼamaʼ ronojel uwach kotzʼiʼj kichʼakom Ajawabʼ.”

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xebʼe kʼu ri sanik konojel, e kʼamol kotzʼiʼj, utikoʼn Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Miʼeroq kʼu chi kipixabʼaj chajal kikotzʼiʼj ri Xibʼalbʼa.

“Laʼ qi chiwilaʼ qakotzʼiʼj. Miyaʼ chi elaqʼaxik rumal ri mixeqachʼako ri Kʼajolabʼ. Ana wiʼ xpe [kape] wi riʼ lo qachʼakʼon kumal? Maja bʼiʼ chiwaraj Jun Aqʼabʼ.”

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Ma kʼu xkinaʼ ri chajal tikoʼn; xa loqʼ chi kiraquj kichiʼ chuqʼabʼ taq cheʼ, tikoʼn puch. Kebʼechakala chiriʼ, xawi xere chkichʼabʼej ri kibʼix.

“Xpurpweq! Xpurpweq!”[x]chaʼ ri jun ta choqʼik.

“Pujuyu! Pujuyu!” [ka]chaʼ chik ta choqʼik ri Pujuyu[pujuy] ubʼiʼ.

E kaʼibʼ chi chajal utikoʼn Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame. Ma kʼu kakinaʼ ri sanik elaqʼay kichajem [kichajiʼn]. Kabʼolowik, katukuwik eray kotzʼiʼj ri kabʼeqʼatowa uloq kotzʼiʼj chuwiʼ cheʼ re kasikʼow kukʼ [qaj] chuxeʼ cheʼ ri kotzʼiʼj.

Xa kejeʼ chi kiraquj kichiʼ ri chajalibʼ. Mana re kakinaʼo kaqʼux kijeʼ, kaqʼux kixikʼ.

Areʼ kakirixik [kerexik] kotzʼiʼj; ka kaqaʼj uloq re kasikʼowik; re kabʼeqʼatowa uloq.

Libʼaj chiʼ kʼut xnoj kajibʼ tzel kotzʼiʼj; tikʼitoj chi kʼut ta xsaqirik. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xul Samajel, taqonel: “ʼKepetoqʼ!” kachaʼ Ajawʼ. Jusukʼ chikikʼam ula ri qachʼakoʼn,” xeʼuchax kʼut Kʼajolabʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Kitikʼelaʼon kʼu ri kotzʼiʼ, kajibʼ tzel ta xebʼek, ta xeʼopon kʼu chi kiwach Ajawabʼ [Ajaw]. Kukʼaʼam kotzʼiʼj, qʼus uwach. Kejeʼ kʼut xechʼakataj wi Xibʼalbʼa. Xa sanik xkitaq ri Kʼajolabʼ. Xa jun aqʼabʼil xkichap sanik. Ta xkiyaʼ pa tzel. Kejeʼ kʼut xesaqkʼajeʼ ri konojel Xibʼalbʼa. [26v] Saqbʼuʼq kiwach rumal ri kotzʼiʼj, kʼateʼ kʼut xkitaq ri chajal kotzʼiʼj.

“Nakipaʼ rumal mixiyaʼ qakotzʼiʼj chi eleqʼaxik? Areʼ qakotzʼiʼj waʼe kawilo,” xeʼuchax chajal.

“Ma bʼaʼ xqanaʼo, at Ajaw. Mi na reʼ xquyu qajeʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Kʼateʼ puch xjix kichiʼ, kitojbʼal kichajiʼn chi eleqʼaxik. Kejeʼ kʼut kichʼakatajik Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame kumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Uxeʼ ri bʼanoj riʼ ta xkikʼam [IxKikʼ] ri kichiʼ jerebʼaʼq; kichiʼ purpweq; jerejaʼq wakamik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kʼateʼ chi kʼut ta xqaj chaʼaj...Xawi xerejunam kechaʼajik...Xkelej chi kʼu chaʼaj, ta xepixabʼan chi kʼu kibʼ.

“Saqirik chik,” xechaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ Kʼajolabʼ ta xkelej.

Xeʼok chi kʼut pa Tew Ja. Mawi ajilam tew, tzatz chi saqbʼoqom chupam ja, rochoch tew.

Jusuʼ kʼu xtzaj tew rumal kutzinaq; maybʼal; xsach ri tew kumal Kʼajolabʼ...Mawi xekamik...Xawi ekʼaslik ta xsaqirik...Areʼ ta kʼu xkaj Xibʼalbʼa chiriʼ ta xekam wi...mawi kejeʼ...xawi kutz kiwach ta xsaqirik...Xekel chi ula taqol ke, xebʼe chik e chajal:

“Naki paʼ laʼ mawi mixekamik?” xchaʼ chi rajawal Xibʼalbʼa.

Xkimayijaj chik kibʼanoj Kʼajolabʼ: Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Kʼateʼ xeʼok chi kʼut pa Bʼalami Ja. Tzatz chi Bʼalam, Bʼalam rochoch.

“Mawi kojitiyʼo, kʼo iwech chuxik,” xeʼuchaxik  Bʼalam.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkipukʼij bʼaq chi kiwach chikop; kʼateʼ kʼut kepaqʼaqʼik chuwiʼ bʼaq.

“Mi kʼu xeʼutzinik. Mixutij kikʼux. Kʼateʼ wi riʼ mixkiyaʼ kibʼ; areʼ kibʼaqil riʼ kakʼuxuxik,” xechaʼ ri [27r] waranel.

Konojel kiʼ kikʼuʼx chire; ma kʼu xekamik, xawi xere utz kiwach xeʼel uloq pa Bʼalami Ja.

“Naki paʼ kichiʼ e winaqil. Apa ki xepe wi?” xechaʼ ri Xibʼalbʼa konojel.

Kʼateʼ chik xeʼok chupam Qʼaqʼ. Jun Ja chi Qʼaqʼ. Xa utukel Qʼaqʼ upam. Mawi xekʼatik rumal xa bʼolol, xa tzimaj wi. Xawi xere utz chi kiwach xsaqirik. Areʼ ta kajawaxik, jusukʼ ta kekamik chupam ri keʼikow wi. Mawi kejeʼ. Xawi kasach kikʼuʼx Xibʼalbʼa rumal.

Xekoj chik chi upam Sotzʼin Ja; utukel Sotzʼ chi Ja; Jun Ja chi Kama Sotzʼ: Nimaʼ Chikop, kʼejeʼ ri cha kitzaʼm, kikamisabʼal, jusuʼ chutzinik chopon chi kiwach. Xekʼoje kʼu chi riʼ chupam. Xa pa ubʼ xewar wi. Mawi xetiyʼik rumal ri e kʼo pa Ja. Chiriʼ kʼut xkiyaʼ wi kibʼ jun wi rumal jun chi Kama Sotzʼ chi kaj xpe wi: xawi ukʼutbʼal ribʼ ta xkibʼano rumal kʼo kakitzʼonoj wi kinaʼoj.

Jun aqʼabʼ kʼu ri Sotzʼ kebʼujujik.

“Kilitzʼ, kilitzʼ,” kechaʼ, kechaʼ Jun Aqʼabʼ.

Xtaneʼ kʼu riʼ sqaqiʼn; maja bʼiʼ chi kesilobʼik ri Sotzʼ. Chiriʼ kʼu chakal wi ri jun tzaʼm wubʼ.

Xchaʼ kʼu ri Xbʼalanke: “Jun Ajpu, kʼa janikʼ pa usaqirik kawilo?”

“ Kʼa janikʼan bʼa lo, wilaʼ na,” xchaʼ kʼut, kʼi kʼu areʼ karaj mukum [muqun] uloq chuchiʼ wubʼ, karaj ril uloq usaqirik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kʼateʼ puch ta xqʼupix ujolom rumal Kama Sotzʼ; qʼupul chi kanoq unimal ri Jun Ajpu.

“Juchaʼlik? Ma mixsaqirik?” xchaʼ ri Xbʼalanke. Ma jabʼiʼ chik chisilobʼ ri Jun Ajpu.

“Jupa chaʼ? Ma xaon mixbʼek Jun Ajpu?[27v] Jupa chaʼ mixabʼano?” Maja bʼiʼ chik chisilabʼik; xa kʼi chiqosos chik. Kʼateʼ kʼut xukʼixbʼij Xbʼalanke:

“Aqaroq! Mixqayaʼyan!” xchaʼ kʼut. Chilaʼ kʼut xbʼekʼola na wi ujolom chuwiʼ jom, xawi utzij Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame. Kekiʼkot kʼu ri Xibʼalbʼa konojel rumal ujolom Jun Ajpu.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xutaq chikop ronojel: Sis, Aq, ronojel Chʼuti Chikop, Nima Chikop. Chaqʼabʼ, xawi xare raqabʼal ta xutzʼonoj kʼut kechaʼ:

“Nakiʼ taq pa iwechaʼ chi jujunal? Areʼ kixnutaq wi. Chikʼam uloq ri iwechaʼ,” xchaʼ kʼut Xbʼalanke chike.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut; ta xebʼek e kʼamol rech; ta xeʼuljeʼ kʼut konojel.

Kʼo xa qʼumaʼr rech xbʼeʼukʼamaʼ.

Kʼo xa tzʼalik xbʼeʼukʼamaʼ.

Kʼo xa abʼaj xbʼeʼukʼamaʼ.

Kʼo xa ulew xbʼeʼukʼamaʼ.

Jalajoj kechaʼ ri Chʼuti Chikop, Nima Chikop.

Kʼi pu kʼu uxambʼe kanajoq ri Sis...Qʼoqʼ xbʼeʼukʼamaʼ...Kubʼulkutij chutzaʼm kapetik.

Areʼ kʼut xok jalwachibʼal ujolom Jun Ajpu. Libʼaj chixkʼotox ubʼaqʼ uwach. Tatz chi ajnaʼoj chikaj xpe wi areʼ Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Juraqan xulukʼuloq chiriʼ pa Sotzʼi Ja. Ma kʼu atan xutzinik uwach. Utz chik xuxik. Xawi xareʼ uchʼuq jebʼel xwachinik. Xawi xareʼ xchʼawik. Areʼ kʼut ta chi raj saqirik, chi kaqtarin uxeʼ kaj.

“Kaxaqi na chik, Amaʼ,” xuchax ri Wuchʼ.

“We,” xchaʼ ri Mamaʼ; ta chi xaqinik, kʼateʼ ta chi qʼequʼmar chik. Kajmul xaqin ri Mamaʼ.

“Kaxaqin Wuchʼ,” kachaʼ winaq wakamik.

Xa kʼu kaq rax utzinik, ta xutikibʼaʼ ukʼojeʼik.

“Ma utz?” chuchax[kuchax] kʼut Jun Ajpu.

“Jeʼ, utz,” xchaʼ kʼut. Xawi xareʼ chu bʼaqʼitilaʼ[28r] ujolom; kʼejeʼ ri qitzij ujolom xuxik. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xkibʼan kitzij; xepixabʼan kibʼ.

“Ma naki katchaʼajik. Xaqi cha yekuj awibʼ; xa in jun kʼi kinbʼanowik,” xchaʼ Xbʼalanke chire. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xupixabʼaj Jun Umul: “Katkʼojeʼ ta chi riʼ chuwiʼ jom; chiʼ wi katkʼojeʼ wi chi upam Pixk,” xuchax Umul rumal Xbʼalanke.

“Chopon na kikʼ awukʼ; kʼateʼ katelik. Kʼa in kibʼanowik,” xuchax ri Umul ta xpixabʼaxik chʼaqʼabʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xsaqirik xawi x areʼ utz kiwach kikabʼichal.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xqaj chi kʼu kichaʼj; kʼolan chi kʼu ujolom Jun Ajpu chuwiʼ jom.

“Mixqachʼakoyan! Mixibʼano! Kiyaʼn! Mixiyaʼo!” xeʼuchaxik.

Xawi kʼu xere chi sikʼin Jun Ajpu: “Chakʼaqaʼ ujolom chi kikʼ,” keʼuchaxik.

“Ma kʼu chi kʼi kaqʼaxow chik! Chiyekow qibʼ!” Areʼ kʼu xetzaqow kikʼ Rajawal Xibʼalbʼa. Xukʼul kʼut Xbʼalanke. Taqal kʼu ri kikʼ chuwach bʼate; chitanenik ta xelik; jusuʼ xikʼow kikʼ chuwiʼ jom. Xa jun xa ka nabʼ wi, taqal pa pixk.

Ta xel kʼu ri umul; chi kʼoxkʼotik ta xbʼek; oqotal kʼut ta xbʼe kumal ri Xibʼalbʼa. Kejuminik, kechʼaninik xebʼe chi rij ri Umul. Xekʼisbʼe konojel Xibʼalbʼa.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkikʼamixtaj (ixkikʼ) ri ujolom Jun Ajpu. Xtikixtaj chik uqʼoqʼ Xbʼalanke, areʼ chi kʼut xbʼekikubʼaʼ ri qʼoqʼ chuwiʼ jom. Qitzij jolom chi kʼu ujolom ri Jun Ajpu, kekiʼkot chi kʼu kikabʼichal. Areʼ kʼut kebʼetzukun na kikʼ ri Xibʼalbʼa. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkikʼamixtaj chi ri kikʼ pa pixk.

Ta xesikʼin chi kʼut: “Kixpetoq! Waʼe kikʼ qe, mi xqariqo,” xechaʼ. Kikʼolem chi kʼut ta xeʼul Xibʼalbʼa.

“Naki paʼ ri [28v] mixqilo?” xechaʼ kʼut. Ta xkitikibʼaʼ chi kut chaʼajik. Junam chaʼajik chi kʼut xkibʼan chik kikabʼichal. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkʼaqataj ri qʼoqʼ rumal Xbʼalanke, chi pakʼabʼin ri qʼoqʼ xqaj pa jom. Saqiram[Xsakiran] kʼu ri usaqilal chi kiwach.

“Naki paʼ chibʼeikʼamaʼ? Apa kʼo wi ri kʼamol re?” xchaʼ Xibʼalbʼa.

Kejeʼ kʼut kichʼakatajik rajawal Xibʼalbʼa rumal Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Nima kʼaxkʼol xekʼojeʼ wi, mawi areʼ xekam wi riʼ ronojel xbʼan chike.

Areʼ kʼut waʼe kinaʼbʼal kikamik Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Areʼ waʼ kinaʼbʼal kikamik xchqabʼij chik. Ta xepixabʼaj[xepixabʼax]kʼut xkibʼano; ronojel kʼaxkʼol, rayil xbʼan chike. Mawi xekamik rumal utijobʼal Xibʼalbʼa; mawi xechʼakatajik rumal ronojel tiyoʼnel chikop e kʼo chi Xibʼalbʼa. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xkitaq chi kaʼibʼ Nikʼwachinel, kejeʼ ri e Ilol. Areʼ kibʼiʼ waʼ: Xulu, Pakam. E etaʼmanel.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
«We kojtzʼonoxik chiwe kumal rajawal Xibʼalbʼa rumal ri qakamik. Kinaʼoj kakinukʼ rumal ri mawi mixojkamik, ma pu mixojchʼakatajik, mixqasach kitijobʼal, ma xa chikop chok chiqe. Areʼ kʼu retal waʼ chi qakʼuʼx: Chojim Abʼaj kamisabʼal qe kumal. Mixekuchuw kibʼ ronojel Xibʼalbʼa. Ma kʼu qitzij ta kojkamik. Areʼ kʼu inaoj waʼ xchiqabʼij we kixultzʼonobʼexoq kumal chirech qakamik: ta kojkʼatok. Nakiʼ xchikuchaj [chiwuchaj], Ix Xulu, Ix Pakam, we kechaʼ chiwe? Ma utz lo chi qatix ta kibʼaqil pa siwan? ʼWe ma bʼa utz xawi xere chik chikʼastaj kiwachʼ,  kixchaʼ.

“We bʼaʼ areʼ utz xa chqaxe[29r]kebʼaʼ chuwiʼ cheʼ, ta kechaʼ chik chiwe: “Xax ma utz wi xawi xere chi wil chi kiwach,” kixchaʼ. Ta kechaʼ chi kʼut chi roxmul: “Xa bʼa reʼ rutzil xa chiqatix kibʼaqil pa raqan jaʼ.We kʼut kixuchax chik kumal: “Areʼ utz bʼaʼ laʼ kekamik?” Kʼateʼ kʼu utz chijokʼ kibʼaqil chwach abʼaj, kejeʼ ri chikeʼex kʼajim jal. Jujunal kʼu chikeʼik, kʼateʼ kʼu chitix ubʼik chi raqan Jaʼ, chiriʼ qaj kʼwaʼ, chibʼe chʼuti juyubʼ, nima juyubʼ,” kixchaʼ kʼut ta chikʼutunisaj ri qapixabʼ mixqabʼij chiwe,» xechaʼ XJun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Ta xepixabʼik xketaʼmaj kikamik. Areʼ kabʼan ri Nima Chojim Abʼaj kejeʼ ri chojibʼal kiʼ xkibʼan Xibʼalbʼa. Nimaʼq xaq xkikojo. Kʼateʼ kʼut xul Samajel achbʼilay ke; usamajel Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

«“Kepetoq! Kojbʼe ta kukʼ Kʼajolabʼ. Chibʼetakilaʼ ka kixqachojij,” kachaʼ Ajaw, Ix Kʼajolabʼ,» xeʼuchaxik.

“Utzbʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Anim xebʼek. Xeʼopon kʼut chuchiʼ choj. Chiriʼ kʼut xerajchʼij wi chi etzʼanem.

“Qachʼopij waʼe ri qakiʼ. Kaj taq mul taj chi qaxikʼaj chiqajujunal, Ix Kʼajolabʼ,” xechax kʼut rumal Jun Kame.

“Mawi areʼ kojimichʼ wi riʼ. Ma pa qetaʼam qakamik, Ix Ajawabʼ? Chiwilaʼ na,” xechaʼ kʼut. Ta xkikʼulawachij kiwach, xkirip kiqʼabʼ kikabʼichal. E pu jupujuj ta xebʼek pa choj.

Chiriʼ kʼut xekam wi kikabʼichal. Kekiʼkot chi kʼut ronojel Xibʼalbʼa. Taqal kiyuyubʼ, taqal kixulqʼabʼ!

“Mixeqachʼako! Qitzij mawi atam xkiyaʼ kibʼ,” xechaʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut kitaqik ri Xulu, Pakam xkanaj wi kitzij. Xawi xere xtzʼonox ri xbʼe wi kibʼaqil. [29v]Ta xeqʼijin Xibʼalbʼa.

Xjokʼ kibʼaqil.

Xbʼetixoq chi Raqan Aʼ.

Ma kʼu xebʼe ta chi naj, xa jusuʼ xeqaj chuxeʼ Jaʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
E Chaʼom Kʼajolabʼ xeʼuxik.

Xawi xareʼ kiwach xuxik xekʼutun chik.

Chi robʼix chi kʼut xekʼutun chik.

Xeʼil chiyaʼ rumal winaq.

E kaʼibʼ kejeʼ riʼ xa Winaq-Kar xewachinik ta xil kiwach kumal Xibʼalbʼa.

Xetzukux kʼut chiʼ taq yaʼ.

Xchuweʼqa kʼut kekʼutunoq e kaʼibʼ chi Mebʼa: atzʼiyaq kiwach, atzʼiyaq pu kij, atzʼiyaq kʼut kiqʼuʼ. Mana chibʼanan ta kiwach ta kʼi xeʼilik rumal Xibʼalbʼa.

Jalan chi kʼut xkibʼano: Xa xajoj Pujuy; xajoj Kux; xa Ibʼoy xkixajo. Xa Xtzʼul, xa chʼitik xkixajchik. Kʼiya mayijabʼal xkibʼan chik. Xkiporoj ja; kejeʼ ri qitzij chikʼatik, libʼaj chi kʼut chiwinaqir chik. Tzatz chi Xibʼalbʼa chikaʼyik.

Kʼateʼ xkipus kibʼ. Chikam jun chike; chipuneʼ na chi kaminaqil. Nabʼe chi kikamisaj kibʼ, xawi xere libʼaj chikʼastaj wi chi uwach. Xa kikaʼy Xibʼalbʼa ta chi kibʼano. Ronojel xkibʼan chik uxeʼnajik chik chʼakbʼal kech Xibʼalbʼa kumal. Kʼateʼ chi puch roponik chik utzijel kixajoj chi xikin ajawabʼ Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Xchaʼ ta xkitaʼo: “Naqiʼ ri e kaʼibʼ mebʼaʼ? La qitzij wi chi qʼus, qitzij wi pu chi jeʼbʼelik kixajowik [kexajowik]?”

“Ronojel kakibʼano,” xchaʼ kʼut kitzijoxik xoponik kukʼ Ajawabʼ; qʼusqux xkitaʼo, ta xbʼe chi kʼut kisamajel, taqol chike.

«“Petoq chulta kibʼana qakaʼy, keqamayijaj taj, keqakaʼyij ta puch! kechaʼ ajawabʼ,” kixchaʼ chike,» xuchax ri Samajel.

Xeʼopon kʼut kukʼ ri Xajol, ta xchʼaʼo kʼut kitzij ajawabʼ chike.[30r] “Ma bʼaʼ chiqaj rumal ri qitzij kojxobʼik. Ma xa mawi kojkʼixbʼik kojok apanoq chi ajawal ja? Rumal kʼi itzel qawach? Ma xaqi nimaʼq ubʼaqʼ qawach chi mebʼaʼ? Ma xa on ril chi re xa Oj Xajol? Naqiʼ ta chiqabʼij chi ke qachmebʼaʼ? Kʼo kan, kʼu rayij nayipu ri qaxajoj .Kakikʼastaj kiwach qukʼ. Ma kejeʼ laʼ kʼu xchiqabʼan chi ke ri Ajawabʼ? Kejeʼ kʼu mawi kaqaj wi, Ix Samajel,” xechaʼ kʼut ri Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Xelejebʼex [xelajix] na kiwach chuwiʼ raʼil, chuwiʼ kʼax. Kaq raʼil xebʼek. Mawi atan xqaj bʼenam. Kʼiya mul xechʼijik, xa chimachkaʼij Samajel chi kiwach, kʼamol ke.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xebʼe kʼut rukʼ Ajaw. Xeʼopon puch kukʼ Ajawabʼ. Kemochochik, chikixulelaʼ kiwach xeʼoponik, xkikemelaj kibʼ; chikiluqʼ kibʼ; chikipach kibʼ; chimayow kibʼ chi atzʼiyaq. Qitzij wi chi mebʼaʼ kiwachibʼal xeʼoponik, ta xtzʼonox kʼut kijuyubʼal, kamaqʼ puch. Xtzʼonox nayipuch kichuch, kiqajaw: “Apa kixpe wi?” xeʼuchaxik.

“Ma bʼaʼ qetaʼam, at ajaw. Mawi xqetaʼmaj uwach qachuch, qaqajaw. Kʼa oj chʼutiʼqoq ta xekamik,” xa xechaʼ.

Mawi naqilaʼ xkibʼij.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Chibʼanaʼ ta bʼaʼ qakaʼy. Nakiʼ chiwaj? Iwajil chiqayaʼo,” xeʼuchaxik.

“Ma bʼaʼ kaqaj. Qitzij chi kaqaxibʼij qibʼ,” xechaʼ chik chire ajaw.

“Mixibʼij iwibʼ, mixobʼik. Kixajowoq. Areʼ ta nabʼe chixaj ri kixpusu ta iwibʼ, chi poroj ta kʼu ri wochoch. Chibʼanaʼ ronojel ri iwetaʼam. Kojkaʼy taj kaqaj. Areʼ rumal qakʼuʼx kixbʼetaqoq. Rumal Ix Mebʼaʼ chiqayaʼ iwajil,” xeʼuchax kʼut. Ta xkitikibʼaʼ kʼut kibʼix, kixajoj. Ta xul kʼut ronojel [30v] ri Xibʼalbʼa. Xepulik e kaʼyel. Ronojel kʼut xkixajo.

Xkixaj Kux, xkixaj Pujuy, xkixaj Ibʼoy. Xchaʼ kʼu Ajaw chike: “Chipusuʼ nutzʼiʼ, chikʼastaj chi uwach iwumal,” xeʼuchaxik.

“We,” xechaʼ. ta xkikpus tzʼiʼ, xkʼastaj chi uwach. Qitzij kʼu chi kikot ri tzʼiʼ ta xkʼastaj uwach. Chusaqbʼisalaʼ ujeʼ ta xkʼastaj uwach, xchaʼ kʼu ri ajaw chike: “Chi poroj nabʼe wochoch,” xeʼuchax chik. Ta xkiporoj kʼut rochoch ajaw; e pulinaq ajawabʼ pa ja konojel, mawi xekʼatik. Libʼaj chi chik xkutzinisaj. Mana jusuʼ sachik ri rochoch Jun Kame. Xkimayijaj kʼut konojel Ajawabʼ.

Xawi kʼu xere kexajowik.

Nim kekiʼkotik.

Xeʼuchax chi kʼut rumal Ajaw: “Chi kamisaj na kʼu Jun Winaq. Chipusuʼ, ma ta kʼut chikamik!” xeʼuchax kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ.

Ta xkichap kʼut Jun Winaq.

Kʼateʼ xkipusu, xkipoqʼoj kʼu aqʼanoq ukuʼx ri Jun Winaq.

Xkikʼolobʼaʼ kʼut chi kiwach Ajawabʼ. Xkimayijaj chi kʼut Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Libʼaj chi kʼut xkʼastaj chi uwach ri jun winaq kumal.

Nim chi kiʼkot ukʼuʼx ta xkʼastaj uwach.

Xkimayijaj kʼut Ajawabʼ.

“Chipusuʼ na chi na kʼu iwibʼ. Chiqil taj. Qitzij kurayij qakʼuʼx ri ixajoj,” xechaʼ chi kʼu Ajawabʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, At Ajaw,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Kʼateʼ puch xkipus kibʼ. Areʼ kʼu xpus ri XJun Ajpu rumal Xbʼalanke.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Jujunal kʼu xperepoʼxik raqan, uqʼab; xel ujolom; xkʼoleʼ  aponoq chi naj.

Xkʼotix uloq ukʼuʼx: xcheqeʼ chuwach tzʼalik.

Keqʼabʼar kʼu ri ronojel Rajawal Xibʼalbʼa chi kaʼy.

Xa kʼu jun chi kaxajowilabʼik: ri Xbʼalanke.

“Katwaʼlijoq [31r],” xchaʼ kʼut. Libʼaj chi kʼut xkʼastaj uwach. Nim kekiʼkotik. Xawi kejeʼ kekiʼkot Ajawabʼ xawi areʼ kebʼanowik; kakikot kikʼuʼx Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

Kejeʼ ri areʼ kexajowik kakinaʼo. Kʼateʼ puch urayinik, umalinik pu kikʼuʼx Ajawabʼ chire kixajoj XJun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Ta xel kʼu kitzij Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame.

“Chibʼanaʼ chiqe kojipusu,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Junal taj kojipusu,” xechaʼ kʼut Jun Kame, Wuqubʼ Kame chike ri XJun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Chikʼastaj iwach. Ma pa Ix kʼokam. Oj pu kiʼkotirisay iwe, Ix Pu rajawal iwal ikʼajol,” xechaʼ kʼut chike Ajawabʼ.

Areʼ kʼu nabʼe xpus ri qi ujolom Ajaw Jun Kame, ubʼiʼ rajawal Xibʼalbʼa.

Kaminaq chi kʼut Jun Kame ta xchap chik Wuqubʼ Kame. Mawi xkʼastaj chi kiwach. Kʼateʼ pu kelik Xibʼalbʼa chikaqan areʼ xkil ri Ajawabʼ xekamik.

E xaraxoj chuʼbʼik.

E pu xaraxoxinaq kikabʼichal.

Xa kʼu kʼajisabʼal kiwach xbʼanik.

Jusukʼ xukamibʼej ri Jun Ajaw.

Mana xkikʼastaj chi uwach.

Areʼ kʼu ri Jun Ajaw xelaj na, xok na chikiwach ri e xajol.

“Mawi xukʼulu, ma pu xuriqo.Toqʼobʼ nuwach,” xchaʼ ta xunaʼ ribʼ.

Xekʼis kʼu bʼeq ronojel kal, kikʼajol pa Nima Siwan.

Xa jun xkibʼalij wi kibʼ pa Nima Xoʼlbʼachan.

Chiriʼ kʼut tubʼul wi ta xkʼulun kʼut.

Mawi ajilan chi sanik, tukulij ula ke pa siwan.

Kejeʼ riʼ xebʼeyoʼx uloq ta xeʼul kʼut, xkʼixulkiya chi kibʼ konojel.

Xeʼulelajoq, xeʼul pu okoq.

Kejeʼ kʼut kichʼakatajik rajawal Xibʼalbʼa; xa mayijabʼal, xa pu [31v] kijalwachibʼal kibʼ ta xkibʼano. Kʼateʼ puch ta xkibʼij kibʼiʼ xkikobʼisaj kibʼ chi kiwach konojel Xibʼalbʼa.

“Chitaʼaʼ qabʼiʼ: xchiqabʼij.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xchiqabʼij nay puch ubʼiʼ qaqajaw chiwe. Oj waʼ, Oj XJun Ajpu ,Xbʼalanke qabʼiʼ. Areʼ kʼu qaqajaw ri xikamisaj. Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu kibʼiʼ. Oj kʼu pakʼol re waʼe kiraʼil, kikʼaxkʼol ri qaqajaw! Kejeʼ kʼut mixqakuyu wi ronojel kʼaxkʼol mixibʼan chiqe. Kejeʼ kʼut kixqasach wi iwonojel. Kixqakamisaj. Ma jabʼiʼ chik kʼolotajel chiwe,” xeʼuchax kʼut. Kʼateʼ puch kelajik, koqʼik konojel Xibʼalbʼa.

“Toqʼobʼ qawach, Ix Jun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke. Qitzij wi xojmakunik chike ri iqajaw, kibʼij laʼ. Kʼateʼ e muqul chi Pusʼbʼal Chaj,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Areʼ bʼaʼ ri qatzij xchiqabʼij chiwe. Chitaʼaʼ iwonojel, Ix Xibʼalbʼa rumal ma na nim chi iqʼij, iwalaxik chuxik, rukʼ nayipuch mawi nim chi ikochibʼal; xqʼaqiʼn chik chi kikʼ jolomax, mawi chʼajom kikʼ iwe. Xa xot, xa aqʼam, xa chuch chiwe, xjeraxik. Xa nayipu ral kʼim, ral tolobʼ chi wechaʼj. Ma kʼu iwech ri ronojel saqil al; saqil kʼajol. Xa noʼj chitzaqow ribʼ chiwach. Areʼ ri ajmak, ajlabʼal, ajbʼis, ajmoken, chok na umak, kixok wi. Mana xa rax chapom ronojel winaq chibʼano. Kixtaʼon puch chuwiʼ ri kikʼ jolomax,” xeʼuchax kʼut konojel Xibʼalbʼa.

Kejeʼ kʼut tikarinaq kisachik, umayixik nayi puch kisikʼixik.

Mawi nim kiqʼij ojer.

Xa xraj tza wi, winaq ojer.

Qitzij ma na kʼabʼawil kibʼiʼ ojer.

Xawi Xibʼal ojer.

Itzel kiwach, e ajtza, ajtukur.

E taqchiʼnel [32r]chi mak, chi labʼal.

E nayipu ajmuqulik kʼuʼx.

E qʼeqaʼil saqil, ajmox wach, ajlatzabʼ, keuchaxik.

Chixeʼon kiwach kekʼulutajik. Kejeʼ kʼut usachik kinimal, qʼaqʼal.

Mawi nim chi kajawarem xuxik.

Areʼ xebʼanow ri XJun Ajpu, Xbʼalanke.

Areʼ kʼut koqʼik, kasikʼin ri katiʼt chuwach ri aj, ri xkitik kanoq.

Xpe utux ri aj.

Kʼateʼ xchaqij chik areʼ kʼut ta xekʼat pa choj.

Ta xpe chi kʼut utux ri aj, kʼateʼ kʼut xkʼaton ri katiʼt.

Xukʼat ri pom chuwach ri aj, unaʼtabʼal kech riʼ.

Areʼ xkikot wi ukʼuʼx katiʼt riʼ chu kamul xpe utux ri aj.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xkʼabʼawilax rumal katiʼt; ta xubʼinatisaj kʼut Nikʼaj Ja, Nikʼaj Bʼichoqʼ, Kʼasam Aj, Chʼatam Ulew; ubʼiʼ xuxik. Areʼ kʼut xubʼinaʼj wi Nikʼaj Ja, Nikʼaj Bʼichoqʼ rumal xa chunikʼajal upa kochoch xkitik aj. Areʼ chi kʼu xubʼinaʼj wi Chʼatam Ulew, Kʼasam Aj chuwiʼ Chʼatam Ulew kitik wi aj. Areʼ nayipu xubʼinaʼj wi Kʼasam Aj rumal xpe utux Aj.

Ta xkoj ubʼiʼ rumal IxMukane xkitik kanoq JunAjpu, Xbʼalanke; xa naʼtabʼal ke rumal katiʼt.

Areʼ kʼu ri nabʼe kiqajaw xojeroq kekamoq ri Jun Jun Ajpu, Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Xkil chi kʼu uwach ri kiqajaw chilaʼ chi Xibʼalbʼa. Xchʼaw chik kiqajaw chike ta xkichʼak Xibʼalbʼa.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ uwiqik chik kiqajaw kumal. Areʼ xkiwiq wi Wuqubʼ Jun Ajpu. Chilaʼ xbʼekiwiqaʼ wi chi Pusʼbʼal Chaaj. Xawi xere uwach xrajuxik. Xtzʼonox kʼut chire ubʼiʼ ronojel: uchiʼ, utzaʼm, ubʼaqʼ uwach. Xurik nabʼe ubʼiʼ. Xa kʼu sqaqiʼn chik xchaʼtaj wi, xere mawi xubʼij [32v]chi ubʼiʼ ujunal puwi uchiʼ; xere pu xchaʼtaj chiwi. Kejeʼ kʼut ta xkinimaj wi kanajoq ukʼuʼx kiqajaw.

Xawi xkanaj chi Pusʼbʼal Chaj.

“Chiriʼ kixsikʼix wi. Chuxik,” xechaʼ chi ukʼajol chi rech, ta xkubʼax ukʼuʼx.

“Nabʼe chel iwe, nabʼe nayipuch kixqʼijiloʼxik rumal Saqil Al, Saqil Kʼajol. Mawi chi sachik ibʼiʼ. Ta chuxoq!” xechaʼ chirech kiqajaw.

Ta xkikʼubʼaʼ ukuʼx: “Xa oj pakol ikamik, isachik, kʼaxkʼol, rayil xbʼan chiwe.”

Kejeʼ kʼut kipixabʼik riʼ.  Xchʼakatajinaqoq ronojel Xibʼalbʼa ta xeʼaqʼan kʼu loq waral, eʼ Nikʼaj Saq. Jusuʼ kʼu xeʼaqʼan chi Kaj: Jun kʼu Qʼij; Jun nayipu Ikʼ chike.

Ta xsaqirik upam Kaj, uwach Ulew.

Chi Kaj xekʼojeʼ wi. Areʼ kʼut kʼa chaqʼanik ri Omuchʼ Kʼajolabʼ xekam rumal Sipakna. Areʼ kʼut kachbʼil xuxik; e uchʼumilal Kaj xeʼuxik.

Waʼe kʼut utikerik ta xnaʼojix winaq. Ta xtzukux puch ri chok utiyoʼjil.

Xechaʼ kʼut ri Alom, Kʼajolom, e Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Tepew, Qʼukumatz kibʼiʼ: “Mi xyopijik usaqirik. Mixtzʼaq utzinik. Mi pu xqʼaleʼik tzuqul, qʼoʼol, saqil al, saqil kʼajol. Mixqʼaleʼ winaq, uwinaqil uwach ulew!” xechaʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xmolomanik xulik, xbʼekinaʼoj chi qʼequʼmal, chi aqʼabʼal. Ta xkitzukuj, xkipukuj puch, xenaʼojinik, xebʼison puch waral. Kejeʼ kʼut xel wi aponoq kinaʼoj. Saqil, qʼalal xkiriqo, xkikanaʼisaj puch ri xok utiyoʼjil winaq. Xa sqʼaqin chik mawi kawachin qʼij, ikʼ, chʼumil pa kiwiʼ e Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol.

Pan Paxil, Pan Kayala ubʼiʼ xpe wi Qʼana Jal, Saqi Jal. Areʼ kʼu kibʼiʼ Chikop Waʼ, kʼamol rechaʼ: Yak, Utiw, Kʼel, Joj. E kajibʼ chi xbʼin utzijel Qʼana Jal, [33r]Saqi Jal chike. Chilaʼ kepe wi Pan Paxil; xkʼut ubʼeʼel Paxil, areʼ kʼut xkiriqo ri echaʼ.

Areʼ kʼut xok utiyoʼjil Winaq Tzʼaq, Winaq Bʼit. Jaʼ kʼut ukikʼel, ukikʼel winaq xuxik.

Areʼ xok kumal Alom, Kʼajolom ri Jal.

Kejeʼ kʼut xekikot wi rumal ri uriqitajik Utzilaj Juyubʼ nojinaq chi qʼus; tzatz chi Qʼana Jal; Saqi Jal. Tzatz nay puch chi Peq, chi Kako. Mawi ajilam chi Tulul, Kʼawex, Qʼinom, Tapaʼl, Ajacheʼ, Kabʼ. Nojinaq kʼiʼlaj echaʼ chi upam ri tinamit: Pan Paxil, Pan Kayalaʼ ubʼiʼ. Kʼo wi echaʼ; uwachinel ronojel Chʼuti Echaʼ, Nima Echaʼ; Chʼuti Tikoʼn, Nima Tikoʼn. Xkʼut ubʼeʼel kumal chikop ta xkeʼx kʼut ri Qʼana Jal, ri Saqi Jal.

Bʼelejebʼ kʼu ukaʼl xubʼan IxMukane. Echaʼ xokik, rukʼ Jaʼ ropenal xwinaqir uqʼabʼchiʼal, uqʼanaʼal winaq xuxik ta xkibʼan ri Alom, Kʼajolom, Tepew Qʼukumatz, keʼuchaxik.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkikoj pa tzij utzʼaqik, ubʼitik qanabʼe Chuch, Qajaw. Xa qʼanajal, saqijal utiyoʼjil; xa echaʼ raqan, uqʼabʼ winaq, ri e qanabʼe qajaw. E kajibʼ chi winaq tzʼaq, xa echaʼ okinaq kitiyoʼjil.

Waʼe kibʼiʼ Nabʼe Winaq xetzʼaqik, xebʼitik. Areʼ Nabʼe Winaq riʼ: Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ; Ukabʼ chi kʼut Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ; Rox chi kʼut Majukutaj; Ukaj kʼut, Iqʼi-Ikʼi-Iki Bʼalam.

Areʼ kʼu kibʼiʼ qanabʼe Chuch, Qajaw. Xa tzʼaq, xa bʼit keʼuchaxik. Ma jabʼi kichuch, ma jabʼi kiqakaw, xa utkukel achij chi qabʼij. Mana Ixoq xeʼalanik; ma nay pu xekʼajolaxik rumal ri Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit, ri Alom, Kʼajolom.

body:
Xa pus, xa nawal kitzʼaqik, kibʼitik rumal ri Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Alom, Kʼajolom, Tepew Qʼukumatz ta xewinaqwachin kʼut e winaq xeʼuxik; xechʼawik, xetzijon[33v]puch; xemukunik, xetaʼon puch; xebʼinik, xechapanik. E utzilaj winaq. E chaʼom achijil uwach kiwachibʼal. Kʼo kuxlabʼ xuxik. Xemukum nay puch, jusukʼ xopon kimukubʼal, xkʼiskilo, xkʼisketaʼmaj ronojel xeʼ kaj. We kemukunik, libʼaj chiʼ chikisolwachij chisolmukuj puch Upam Kaj, Upam Ulew.

Ma ju qʼatajil na chikilixtaj ronojel. Ma kebʼintanaʼon nabʼe, kʼateʼ ta chikil ri uxeʼ kaj xawi chire e kʼo wi ta kimukunik; tzatz ketaʼmabʼal xuxik.

Xikʼow kiwachibʼal pa cheʼ, pa abʼaj, pa cho, pa palo, pa juyubʼ; pa taqʼaj. Qitzij wi chi e loqʼolaj winaq ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iqʼi-Ikʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam!

Ta xetzʼonox kʼut rumal ri Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit: “Juchalik ikʼojeʼy kinaʼo? Ma kixmukunik? Makixtaʼonik? Ma utz ichʼabʼal rukʼ ibʼinibʼal? Kixmukuna na kʼut, chiwilaʼ uxeʼ kaj. Ma qʼalaj juyubʼ, taqʼaj kiwilo? Chitijaʼ na kʼut,” xeʼuchaxik.

Kʼateʼ puch xkʼiskil ronojel uxeʼ kaj.

Kateʼ kʼut kikʼamowanik riʼ chire Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol: “Qitzij wi chi kamul kʼamo, oxmul kʼamo, mixojwinaqirik, mi pu xojchiʼnik, xojwachinik, kojchʼawik, kojtaʼonik, kojbʼisonik, kojsilabʼik. Utz kaqanaʼo xqetaʼmaj naj, naqaj. Mi pu xqilo nim, chʼutiʼn upa kaj, upa ulew. Kʼamo kʼut chiwe mixojwinaqirik: Oj Tzʼaq, Oj Bʼit mixojuxik, at qatiʼt, at qamam,” xechaʼ ta xkikʼamowaj kitzʼaqik, kibʼitik. Xkʼisketaʼmaj ronojel. Xkimukuj Kaj Tzʼuq, Kaj Xukut, Upam Kaj, Upam Ulew. Ma kʼu utz xkitaʼo ri Ajtzʼaq, Ajbʼit.

“Ma wi utz ri mi xkibʼij qatzʼaq, qabʼit. Mi xketaʼmaj ronojel nim [34r]chʼutiʼn,” kechaʼ. Kejeʼ chi kʼut ukʼamik chikkinaʼoj Alom, Kʼajolom.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Jucha chik chiqabʼan chike? Xa ta naqajchopon wi kimukubʼal; xa ta sqaqiʼn uwach uwachulew chikilo? Mawi utz ri kakibʼij. Ma pa xa tzʼaq, xa bʼit kibʼiʼ? Xa labʼe e Kʼabʼawil keʼuxik chik. We mawi kepoqʼotajik, kekʼiritajik ta chawaxoq, ta saqiroq. We mawi kikʼiyarik.Ta chuxoq! Xa qayojoʼ chi sqaqiʼn chik kʼo chi karaj mawi utz kaqanaʼo. Xa pa xchijunamataj kibʼanoj qukʼ. Riʼ najt kopon wi ketaʼmabʼal. Kilon ronojel, ”xeʼuchaxik rumal UkʼuʼxKaj, Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, RaxaKaqulja, Tepew Qʼukumatz, Alom, Kʼajolom, Xpiyakok, IxMukane, Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol keʼuchaxik.

Ta xkibʼan kʼut ukʼojeʼik chi kitzʼaq, kibʼit; xa kʼu xwabʼax ubʼaqʼ kiwach rumal ri Ukʼuʼx Kaj. Xmoyik kʼeje ri xuxlabʼix uwach lemow. Xmoyomobʼik ubʼaqʼ kiwach. Xa naqaj chik xemukun wiʼ xere chi qʼalaj ri e kʼo wi. Kʼeje kʼut usachik ketamabʼal rukʼ ronojel kinaʼobʼal e kajibʼ chi winaq uxeʼ utikaribʼal. Kejeʼ kʼut kitzʼaqik, kibʼitik nabʼe qamam, qaqajaw rumal Ukʼuʼx Kaj, UkʼuʼxUlew.

Ta xkʼojeʼ chi kʼut kikʼulel, kixoqil puch xuxik; xawi Kʼabʼawil xnaʼojin chik. Kejeʼ ri xa pa waram xkikʼam wi. Qitzij e jebʼel chi ixoq kʼo rukʼ Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam. Kʼo chi kixoqil ta kʼi xekʼastajik; anim xkikot chik kikʼuʼx rumal kikʼulel.

Areʼ kʼu kibʼiʼ kixoqil waʼ: Kaqa Paluma ubʼiʼ rixoqil Bʼalam Kitzeʼ; Chomi Ja ubʼiʼ rixoqil Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ; Tzʼununi Ja ubʼiʼ rixoqil Majukutaj; Kaqkixa Ja ubʼiʼ rixoqil Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam. Areʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ kixoqil riʼ; e ixoq ajawabʼ xeʼuxik; e poqʼol Winaq: Chʼuti Amaqʼ, Nima Amaqʼ. Areʼ kʼut uxeʼ qech ri oj: Kʼecheʼ Winaq. [34v]

Tzatz kʼut xuxik ri Ajkʼixbʼ, Ajkʼajbʼ. Mana e kajibʼ chik xuxik; xere kajibʼ ri kichuch AjKʼicheʼ Winaq. Jalajoj chi kibʼiʼ chi kijujunal ta xepoqʼotajik chilaʼ chi Relebʼal Qʼij. Kʼi ubʼiʼ xuxik ri winaq: Tepew Oloman, Kojaj, Kinich Ajaw chuchax chik ubʼiʼ winaq.

Chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij xpoqʼotajik. Retaʼam chik utikarik chik rech Tamubʼ, rech Ilokabʼ. Xa jun xpe wi chi laʼ Relebʼal Qʼij.

Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ umam, uqajaw Bʼelejebʼ Nim Ja chi Kawiqibʼ.

Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ umam, uqajaw Bʼelejebʼ Nim Ja chi Nim Jayibʼabʼ-Nimjaʼibʼabʼ.

Majukutaj umam, uqajaw Najibʼ Nim Ja chi Ajaw Kʼicheʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ox chʼobʼ chinamit chi ukʼojeʼik.

Mawi sachel ubʼiʼ umam, uqajaw.

Areʼ poqʼol, kirol chi laʼ Relebʼal Qʼij.

Xawi xere xpe wi Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ rukʼ Oxlajuj Uqʼa Amaqʼ-Wuq-Amaqʼ, Oxlajuj Tekpan rukʼ Rabʼinalebʼ, Qʼaqʼchikelebʼ, Aj Tzʼkina Ja, rukʼ puch Saqajibʼ, rukʼ nay puch Lamakibʼ, Kumatz, Tujal Ja, Uchabʼa Ja, Aj Chʼumila Ja, rukʼ Aj Kibʼa Ja, Aj Bʼatena Ja, Akul Winaq, Bʼalami Ja, Kanchajelebʼ, Bʼalam Kolobʼ; xere kʼu unimaqil amaqʼ, ri uqʼa amaqʼ, wuqubʼ amaq, kojchaʼ chirech.

Xa unimaqil ri mixqacholo. Kʼi chik elenaq chi rij ri jutaq chʼobʼ chi tinamit. Mawi mixqatzʼibʼaj kibʼiʼ. Xa wi kʼu chilaʼ xpoqʼotaj wi uloq Relebʼal Qʼij. Kʼiya winaq xuxik chi qʼequʼmal ta xkʼiyarik. Maja chalaxoq Qʼij, Saq ta xekʼiyarik. Xa jun xekʼojeʼ wi konojel e tzatz chi kikʼojeʼik, kibʼinowik chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij.

Areʼ ma jabʼi chi kitzuquʼn, kikʼoʼn; xawi chikaj chikipaqʼabʼaʼ kiwach.

Mawi ketaʼam xebʼe wi najt xkibʼano ta xkʼojeʼ pa ki chiriʼ Qʼeqa Winaq, Saqi Winaq; kʼi wachibʼal winaq; kʼi uchʼabʼal winaq. Kekʼay uxikin, kʼoley uxeʼ kaj.

Kʼo kʼut Juyubʼal Winaq, mawi ilo [35r]uwach. Ma jabʼiʼ rochoch, xa Chʼuti Juyubʼ, Nima Juyubʼ kebʼek: “Kejeʼ richʼuʼj,” xechaʼ; “ta xkiyajobʼej ri Juyubʼal Winaq,” xechaʼ.

Chilaʼ xkil wi Relebʼal Qʼij; xa kʼu jun kichʼabʼal konojel; majaʼ chikisikʼijoq Cheʼ, Abʼaj. “Areʼ naʼtal chikech ri utzij Tzʼaqol, Bʼitol, Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Ukʼuʼx Ulew,” xechaʼ.

Xere kikʼuʼxlaʼan ri rewaxik; usaqirik.; xa tzʼononik chikibʼano; e ajloqʼ tzij; e ajnim; e ajxobʼ. Chikipaqʼabʼaʼ kiwach chi Kaj ta xkitzʼonoj kimeʼal, kikʼajol:

“Aqʼaroq at Tzʼaqol, at Bʼitol. Kojawilaʼ, kojataʼ, mojatzaqo, mojapiskʼalij; at Kʼabʼawil chi Kaj, chi Ulew, Ukʼuʼx Kaj, Ukʼuʼx Ulew.

Chayaʼ taj qetal, qatzijel chibʼe qʼij, chibʼe saq: Ta Chawaxoq! Ta Saqiroq!

Kʼi ta raxal bʼe, raxal jok kojayaʼ wi.

Liyanik saq, liyanik amaqʼ taj, utzilaj saq, utzilaj amaqʼ taj, utzilaj kʼaslem, winaqirem ta puch kojayaʼ wi. At Juraqan, Chʼipi Kaqulja, Raxa Kaqulja, Chʼipi Nanawak, Raxa Nanawak, Wok, Jun Ajpu, Tepew Qʼukumatz, Alom, Kʼajolom, Xpiyakok, IxMukane, Ratiʼt Qʼij, Ratiʼt Saq:  Ta Chawaxoq! Ta Saqiroq!” xechaʼ ta xeqʼijiloʼnik, xesikʼinik.

Xa selawachin usaqirik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xawi chi laʼ kimukun wi Relabʼal Qʼij.

Kilawachin ri Ikʼo Qʼij, Nima Chʼumil, rachalaxik Qʼij, tzijol re Upa Kaj, Upa Ulew; ubʼinibʼal Winaq Tzʼaq, Winaq Bʼit.

Xechaʼ e Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

“Qoyobʼej na usaqirik,” xechaʼ.

“E nimaʼq etamaʼnel, e naʼonel, e ajkʼixbʼ, e ajnim,” keʼuchaʼxik.

Maja bʼi kʼu jabʼiʼoq Cheʼ Abʼaj chichajin e qanabʼe Chuch-Qajaw. E xa kʼu xkos kikʼuʼx chiriʼ chi royobʼexik qʼij. E kʼi chik ronojel Amaqʼ, rukʼ Yaki Winaq, ajkʼixbʼ, ajkʼajbʼ.

“Xa jo! [35v]Oj qatzukuj, oj pu qilaʼ we kʼo chi chajin qetalaʼ. Chi qarik ri kojtzijon ta chuwach. Xaki kejeʼ oj kʼolik ma jabʼi chajal qe,” xechaʼ kʼut e Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam.

Xkitaʼo utzijel Jun Tinamit xebʼe wi. Areʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ Juyubʼ Waʼ xebʼe wi Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam, rukʼ Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ: Tulan Tzuy Wa, Wuqubʼ Pek, Wuqubʼ Siwan ubʼiʼ Tinamit xeʼopon wi e kʼamol Kʼabʼawil.

Xeʼopon kʼut chilaʼ Tulan konojel; mawi ajilam chi Winaq xoponik; tzatz kʼut chubʼinik: cholon kʼut relik uloq kikʼabʼawil. Nabʼe ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ-Kʼitzʼe-Kiʼtzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam.

Kekiʼkotik. “Areʼ qatzukum waʼ, mixqariqo”, xechaʼ. Areʼ kʼut nabʼe xel ri Tojil, ubʼiʼ Kʼabʼawil. Xekel ukok; riqʼaʼxik rumal Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ...Xel chi kʼu uloq Awilix, ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil; xrukʼaʼj BʼalamAqʼabʼ...Jaqawitz chik ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil xukʼamo Majukutaj...Nikʼaqʼaj Taqʼaj ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil xukʼamo Ikʼi Bʼalam.

Xere kʼut rach Kʼecheʼ Winaq riʼ xukʼaʼm chi kʼut re Tamubʼ. Xawi xere Tojil chi Tamubʼ kʼo ubʼiʼ xkʼamowik, umam, uqajaw Tamubʼ ajawabʼ, qetaʼam kʼutwakamik.

Rox chi kʼut Ilokabʼ, xawi Tojil ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil xukʼamo kimam, kiqajaw ajawabʼ, xawiqetaʼam wakamik. Kejeʼ kʼut ubʼinaʼam wi oxibʼ chi Kʼicheʼ. Xma xutzoqopij wi ribʼ rumal xa junam ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil: Tojil Kʼicheʼ, Tojil chi Tamubʼ, chi Ilokabʼ; xa jun ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil qe. Kʼu mawi xujach wi ribʼ roxichal Kʼecheʼ.

Oxibʼ riʼ.

Qitzij nimaʼq kikʼojeʼik: Tojil, Awilix, Jaqʼawitz.

Ta xok chi kʼut ronojel Amaqʼ: Rabʼinalebʼ, Qʼaqʼchekelebʼ, Aj Tzʼkina Ja, rukʼ[36r]Yaki Winaq, ubʼiʼ wakamik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Chiriʼ kʼut xjalqʼatij uchʼabʼal ri Amaqʼ; jalajoj kichʼabʼal xuxik; mawi qʼalaj chik xkitaʼo chikibʼil kibʼ ta xepetik chi Tulan.

Chiriʼ kʼut xkipaxij wi kibʼ.

Kʼo xbʼe chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij.

Tzatz kʼu ri xpe waral.

Xa kʼu jumaj tzʼuʼum kiqʼuʼ.

Ma jabʼi ri utzilaj taq kʼul taj kikojom.

Xa utzʼuʼmal chikop kikawubʼal.

E mebʼaʼ.

Ma jabʼi kech.

Xa e Nawal Winaq chi kikʼojeʼik.

Ta xepe chilaʼ Tulan Tzuy Wa, Wuqubʼ Pek, Wuqubʼ Siwan, chaʼ chi upam Ojer Tzij.

Tzatz chubʼinik xopon chi Tulan, ma kʼu ja bʼi qʼaqʼ.

Xaqi e kʼo ri Tojil, areʼ kʼu ukʼabʼawil Amaqʼ. Nabʼe xwinaqir uqʼaqʼ. Mawi qʼalaj uwinaqirik. Kanikʼow chik kiqʼaqʼ ta xkil ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ.

“Aqʼaroq! Ma jabʼi qaqʼaqʼ mixuxik. Xkojkam rumal tew,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xchaʼw kʼut ri Tojil: “Mixbʼisonik. Kʼo iwech. Chisach riqʼaqʼ kibʼij,” xchaʼ ri Tojil chike.

“Ma qitzij at kʼabʼawil; at qatzukuj; at pu qakʼoʼon; at qakʼabʼawil,” xechaʼ chire. Ta xkikʼamowaj ri xubʼij Tojil.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, qitzij in ikʼabʼawil. Ta chuxoq! In iwajawal. Ta chuxoq!,” xeʼuchax ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ rumal Tojil.

Are kʼut keqʼaqʼal ri Amaqʼ. Kekiʼkot rumal kiqʼaqʼ; kʼateʼ puch ta xtikarik Nima Jabʼ, areʼ katilow uqʼaqʼ amaqʼ. Tzatz kʼut chi saqbʼoch xqajik pa kiwiʼ ronojel Amaqʼ. Ta xchup kʼut kiqʼaqʼ rumal saqbʼoch.Maja bʼi chik kiqʼaqʼ xuxik.

Ta xkitzʼonoj chi kʼut kiqʼaqʼ ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ: “At Tojil, qitzij kojutzinik rumal tew,” xechaʼ kʼut chire Tojil.

“Utz mixbʼisonik,” xchaʼ Tojil.

Kʼateʼ ta xrelesaj qʼaqʼ. [36v]Xubʼaq uloq chupam uxajabʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut xekiʼkot ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Kʼateʼ kʼut xemiqʼik.

Areʼ kʼut chupinaq chik uqʼaqʼ Amaqʼ. Keʼutzin chik rumal tew. Kʼateʼ pu kipetik chik, e tzʼonoy kiqʼaqʼ kukʼ ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

Ma kʼu kakichʼij chik rumal tew, saqbʼoch; xa kelexlot chik, kesiksot chi puch; ma jabʼi e kʼas chi wi; kakoykot chik kaqan, kiqʼabʼ; mawi kechapon chik ta xeʼulik.

“Ma kʼi kojkʼix na iwukʼ? Chi qatzʼonoj ta ukok sqaqiʼn iqʼaqʼ,” xechaʼ ta xeʼulik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ma kʼu jabʼi xekʼulaxik. Ta xkʼoqon kikʼuʼx Amaqʼ. Jalan chik kichʼabʼal ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

“Aqʼaroq! A xqakanaj wi qachʼabʼal? Jupa chaʼ xqabʼano? Mixojsachik. Apa xojkʼaxtoqʼax wi? Xa jun qachʼabʼal ta xojpe chilaʼ Tulan.  Xa pu jun qatzʼuqibʼal, qawinaqiribʼal.  Mawi utz xqabʼano,” xechaʼ kʼut konojel Amaqʼ Xeʼ Cheʼ, Xeʼ Kʼaʼam.

Ta xukʼut kʼu ribʼ Jun Winaq chikiwach ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Xchaʼ kʼut Samajel Xibʼalbʼa: “Qitzij chi areʼ ikʼabʼawil. Ri areʼ itzuquʼn. Areʼ pu ukʼexwach, naʼtabʼal re tzʼaqol iwe, bʼitol pu iwe. Mi yaʼ kʼu kiqʼaqʼ ri Amaqʼ kʼu na chikiyaʼo chire Tojil. Miwaj Ajawabʼ chikiyaʼ chiwe. Chitzʼonojna chirech Tojil. Chire na chipe wi chikiyaʼo, kʼambʼal qʼaqʼ,” xchaʼ ri Xibʼalbʼa.

Kʼo uxikʼ kejeʼ ri uxikʼ sotzʼ.

“In Samajel kumal Tzʼaqol iwe, Bʼitol iwe,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Xibʼalbʼa.

Xekiʼkot chi kʼut. Xnimar chik chi kikʼuʼx ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz ta xchʼaw ri Xibʼalbʼa; libʼaj chi kʼu xusach ribʼ chikiwach; mawi xmayinik. [37r]

Ta xeʼul chi kʼut ri Amaqʼ; keʼutzin chik rumal tew. Tzatz chi saqbʼoch chi qʼeqal jabʼ; saqbʼoqom puch. Mawi ajilam tew ka kikʼulu, kelukʼlutik, kechʼakchʼot chik rumal tew ronojel Amaqʼ ta xeʼul chiriʼ e kʼo wi Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

Nim uqʼatat kikʼuʼx; chikimaj kichiʼ, chikimaj kiwach.

Kʼateʼ puch kulik chik e eleqʼom chikiwach Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iki Bʼalam.

“Ma qi chitoqobʼaj qawach? Chiqatzʼonoj taʼ ukoq sqaqiʼn iqʼaqʼ. Mawi xukʼulu, ma pu xuriqo. Ma pu xa jun qochoch? Xa pu jun qajuyubʼal ta xixtzʼaqik, xixbʼitik? Chitoqobʼaj ta kʼu qawachʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Nakilaʼ kʼu chikuyaʼo chiqatoqʼobʼaj kʼu iwach?” xeʼuchax kʼut.

“Utz chiqayaʼ pwaq chiwe,” xechaʼ kʼu ri Amaqʼ.

“Mawi kaqaj ri pwaq,” xechaʼ kʼut Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ.

“Nakipaʼ kʼi chiwaj? Xa ta bʼaʼ chiqatzʼonoj,” xechaʼ chi kʼut ri Amaqʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ, qatzʼonoj na chirech Tojil, kʼateʼ kʼut xchiqabʼij chiwe,” xeʼuchax chik.

Kʼateʼ puch xkitzʼonoj chire Tojil: “Naki paʼ chikiyaʼ ri Amaqʼ, at Tojil? Kulkitzʼonoj ri aqʼaqʼ,” xechaʼ kʼu ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“«“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Ma chikaj kituʼnik xeʼ kitolokʼ, xeʼ kimeskeʼl? Ma karaj on kikʼuʼx kinkiqʼulaj, ri in Tojil? Ta ma kʼu chiraj, ma kʼu chinyaʼ kiqʼaqʼ, kachaʼ Tojil,” kixchaʼchike.»

«“Kʼa tikʼal na kʼut, mana kamik taj xkituʼnik xeʼ kitolokʼ, kimeskeʼl, kachaʼ chiwech,” kixchaʼ,» xeʼuchax kʼut Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam.

Ta xkibʼij kʼut utzij Tojil.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ! chituʼnik. Utz puch chi qaqʼulaj,” xechaʼ kʼut.

Ta xkichoqʼobʼej, xkikʼulubʼaʼ puch utzij Tojil. [37v]

Mawi xkikiyalaj chik: “Utz”, xa jusuʼ xechaʼ.

Ta xkikʼam kʼut qʼaqʼ; kʼateʼ xemiqʼik.

Xa kʼu juchʼobʼ ri xa xreleqʼaj ubʼik qʼaqʼ pa sibʼ; areʼ ri Sotzʼila Ja.Chamalkan ubʼiʼ kikʼabʼawil Qʼaqʼchekelebʼ. Xa sotzʼ uwachibʼal, ta xeʼikʼow pa sibʼ, chitiltotik xeʼikʼowik ta xul ukʼamaʼ qʼaqʼ. Mawi xutzʼonoj uqʼaqʼ ri Kaqchekelebʼ. Mawi xuyaʼ ribʼ chi chʼakik. Xere xchʼakataj ri Amaqʼ ronojel ta xuyaʼo uxeʼ utolokʼ, uxeʼ umeskeʼl chituʼxik.

Areʼ kʼut utuʼxik ri xubʼij Tojil ta xpus ronojel Amaqʼ chuwach, ta xkʼotix uloq ukʼuʼx chu tolokʼ, chu meskeʼl. Majaʼ chitijowoq ubʼanik ta xnikʼwachixik rumal Tojil, ukʼamik puch qʼaqʼal, tepewal kumal Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ,Majukutaj, Ikʼi-Iqʼi-Ikiʼ Bʼalam.

Chilaʼ petinaq wi Tulan, Tzuy Wa. Ma kʼu kewaʼ taj. Junelik mewajik xkibʼano. Xere kʼiselewachin[kʼiskelewachim] ri usaqirik. Kelewachin [Kelewachim] relik ula qʼij.

Kejalow kibʼ chi rilik ri Nima Chʼumil, Ikʼoqʼij ubʼiʼ. Areʼ nabʼe chuwach qʼij ta chalaxoq ri qʼij, raxa iqoqʼij. Amaqʼel kʼu chilaʼ kʼo wi kiwach chi Relebʼal Qʼij ta xekʼojeʼ chi laʼ: Tulan, Tzuy Wa ubʼiʼ xpe wi kikʼabʼawil. Mana xa ta kʼa waral taj xkikʼam wi kiqʼaqʼal, kajawarem puch. Xawi chilaʼ xchʼataj wi, xeyoqʼotaj wi Nima Amaqʼ, Chʼuti Amaqʼ.

Ta xpusik chuwach Tojil. Xuyaʼo ukikʼel, ukomajil, utolokʼ, umeskeʼl ronojel winaq. Jusuʼ chi Tulan xpe wi kiqʼaqʼal. Nima etaʼmabʼal kʼo kukʼ, chi qʼequmal kʼut, chi aqʼabʼal puch xkibʼano. Xpe chi kʼut, xebʼoqotaj chi ula chilaʼ. Xkikanaj chik Relebʼal Qʼij. [37v]

“Mawi areʼ qochoch waʼ. Xajoʼ. Chiqil na kojtikeʼ wi,” xchaʼ kʼu ri Tojil. Qitzij chichʼawik chikech [38r] Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iki Bʼalam.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Kixkʼamowan na kanoq.”

“Chitajaʼ [Chitijaʼ] na kʼut ujutik ixikin, chitisaʼ [tʼisaʼ] ichʼuʼk.”

“Kixkʼajbʼoq! Areʼ ikʼamowibʼal chuwach kʼabʼawil.”

“Utzbʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut, ta xkijut kixikin.

Xoqʼ kʼut chupam kibʼix kipetik Tulan.

Xoqʼ kikʼuʼx ta xepetik, ta xkoqotaj kanoq Tulan.

“Aqʼaroq, mawi waral xchiqilwi usaqirik ta chalaxoq ri qʼij, saqirisay uwach ulew,” xechaʼ kʼut. Ta xpe kʼut; xa kʼu xukanajibʼej riʼ pa bʼe. Xax kʼowi winaq chi kanaj chiriʼ, kewar wi jujun winaq chi Amaqʼ, keyakataj wi uloq. Amaqʼel kʼut chi kilri chʼumil, retal qʼij; areʼ retal usaqirik chi kikʼuʼx. Ta xepetik chi Relebʼal Qʼij chi kijunamwach xeʼikʼow ula chilaʼ Nim Xol kabʼixik wakamik.

Ta xeʼul puch chi riʼ chuwiʼ jun juyubʼ. Chiriʼ xkikuch wi kibʼ konojel Kʼecheʼ [Kʼicheʼ] Winaq rukʼ Amaqʼ. Chiriʼ kʼu xeʼopon wi konojel; ta xkipixabʼaj kibʼ; ubʼinaʼam juyubʼ wakamik Chi Pixabʼ, ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xekuchuw wi kibʼ.

Chiriʼ kʼut xkikobʼisaj wi kibʼ.

“In waʼ in Kʼecheʼ Winaq! At kʼu riʼ, at Tamubʼ, areʼ abʼiʼ chuxik!” xuchax Tamubʼ.

Xchʼaʼ chi kʼut Ilokabʼ: “At Ilokabʼ, areʼ abʼiʼ chuxik! Mawi sachel oxibʼ chi Kʼicheʼ! Xa junam qatzij,” kechaʼ kʼut ta xkoj kibʼiʼ.

Ta xbʼinaʼaj [xubʼinaʼaj]chi kʼu Qʼaqʼchekelebʼ; Qʼaqʼchekelebʼ ubʼiʼ xuxik, rukʼ chi e Rabʼinalebʼ. Areʼ chi kʼu ubʼiʼ xuxik; mawi sachinaq wakamik. Areʼ chi kʼu Aj Tzʼkina Ja ubʼiʼ wakamik. Areʼ kʼu kibʼiʼ ri xkibʼij chikibʼil kibʼ. Chiriʼ na xeʼopon wi; xa chikoyobʼej na usaqirik. Chikilawachij relik [38v]ula chʼumil nabʼe chuwach qʼij ta chalaxoq.

“Chilaʼ xojpe wi, xa xojpaxin qibʼ,” xechaʼ chi kibʼil kibʼ. Areʼ chiqʼatat wi kikʼuʼx, ri nima kʼaxkʼol xeʼikʼow wi uloq. Maja bʼi wa; maja bʼi echaʼ; xa uxeʼ kichʼamiʼy chikisiqo. Kejeʼ ri kewaʼik kakinaʼo. Xma kewaʼ wi ta xepetik. Ma kʼu qʼalaj kiʼ ikʼowik uloq pa Palo; kejeʼ ri maja bʼi Palo xeʼikʼow wi uloq. Xa chuwiʼ taq abʼaj xeʼikʼow wi uloq kʼolejeʼ ula ri abʼaj pa sanayebʼ. Ta xkibʼinatisaj kʼut Cholochik Abʼaj, Bʼoqotajinaq Sanayebʼ ubʼiʼ kumal ri xeʼikʼow wi uloq chi upam Palo; ujachom ribʼ Jaʼ xeʼikʼowwi uloq.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼut chiqʼatat wi kikʼuʼx ta xepixabʼan kibʼ chiʼ, ma jabʼi kiwa. Juʼukʼ chikiqumej riʼ, xa juna ixim. Chiriʼ kʼut e kʼaʼal wi chuwiʼ juyubʼ Chi Pixabʼ ubʼiʼ. Xawi kʼu kukʼaʼm ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Nima mewajik kakibʼan ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ rukʼ rixoqil: Kaqa Paluma ubʼiʼ rixoqil. Xawi kejeʼ kubʼano Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, rukʼ rixoqil, Chomi Ja ubʼiʼ; rukʼ chik Majukutaj nima mewajik kʼo wi rukʼ rixoqil, Tzʼununi Ja ubʼiʼ; rukʼ Ikʼi Bʼalam, Kaqixa Ja ubʼiʼ rixoqil. Areʼ kʼut e Aj Mewa riʼ chi qʼequʼmal, chi aqʼabʼal.

Nim kibʼis ta xekʼojeʼik chuwiʼ juyubʼ: Chi Pixabʼ ubʼiʼ wakamik: xchaʼ chi kʼut kikʼabʼawil chiriʼ.

Ta xchaʼ kʼut rukʼ Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz chikech ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam: “Xa ta kojbʼek. Xa ta pu kojyakatajik. Ma ta waral kojkʼojeʼ wi. Chi ewal taj kojiyaʼ wi. Mixyopij usaqirik. Ma pu toqʼobʼ iwach we kojkanabʼixik rumal Aj Labʼal. Chi tzʼaq waʼ oj kʼo wi iwumal: Ix Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ. Jujun ta kʼut kojiyaʼ wi,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xechʼawik. [39r]

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Xa kojbʼoqotajik, qatzukuj taq ri kʼicheʼlaj,” xechaʼ kʼut konojel. Kʼateʼ puch xkikʼam chi reqaxik ukʼabʼawil jujun chi kech. Ta xok kʼut Awilix pa siwan, ubʼinaʼam Ewabʼal Siwan, chuchax kumal. Pa nima siwan chi kʼicheʼlaj: Pa Awilix ubʼiʼ wakamik; chiriʼ xkanaj wi. Xkʼu kakanajoq pa siwan rumal Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ. Cholom ukanjik; unabʼe riʼ.

Xkanaj chi kʼut Jaqawitz chuwiʼ jun Nima Kaq Ja, Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ juyubʼ wakamik. Xkitinamit kʼu riʼ xuxik; chiriʼ kʼut xkʼojeʼ wi kʼabʼawil Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ. Xawi xkanaj ri Majukutaj rukʼ ukʼabʼawil. Ukabʼ kʼut kʼabʼawil ri xewax kumal. Mana pa kʼecheʼlaj xkʼojeʼ wi Jaqawitz, xa saqi juyubʼ xewax wi Jaqawitz.

Ta xpe chi kʼut Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ. Xul chiriʼ pa nima kʼicheʼlaj xul ewaxo wi Tojil rumal Bʼalam Kitzeʼ. Pa Tojil chuchax wakami kubʼiʼ juyubʼ. Ta xkikobʼisaj riʼ ewabʼal siwan: Kunabʼal Tojil. Tzatz chi kumatz; tzatz puch chi bʼalam, sachoj, kʼantiʼ. Chiriʼ pa kʼecheʼlaj xekʼojeʼ wi, xewax wi kumal Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ. Xa jun xekʼojeʼ wi Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Xa jun xkoyobʼej wi usaqirik, chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xawi kʼu kok uxoʼl ri xkʼojeʼ wi kʼabʼawil Tamubʼ, rukʼ Ilokabʼ. Amaqʼ Tan [Tam] ubʼiʼ ri xkʼojeʼ wi ukʼabʼawil Tamubʼ. Chiriʼ xsaqir wi Amaqʼ. Uqʼinkʼat ubʼiʼ ri xsaqirik wi ri Ilokabʼ. Chiriʼ xkʼojeʼ wi ukʼabʼawil Ilokabʼ. Xa kok uxoʼl juyubʼ. Xa wi chiriʼ ronojel Rabʼinalebʼ, Kaqchekelebʼ, Aj Tzʼkina Ja, ronojel Chʼuti Amaqʼ,[39v]Nima Amaqʼ; Xa Jun xtakʼatobʼ wi. Xa pu Jun xsaqirik wi. Xa Jun xkoyobʼej wi relik uloq Nima Chʼumil, Ikʼoqʼij ubʼiʼ.

“Nabʼe chel loq chuwach Qʼij: Ta Saqiroq!” xechaʼ.

Xa kʼu Jun xekʼojeʼ wi Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Maja bʼi kiwaram, kiyakalem. Nim roqʼej kikʼuʼx, kipam chire usaqirik, upakatajik puch. Xawi chilaʼ xkʼixbʼ wi uwach, xepe wi nima bʼis, nima mokem, e chi karinaq rumal ukʼaxkʼol xa e kʼo wi uloq.

“Mawi qʼus mixojpe wi. Aqaroq! Oj taj xkojilowik ralaxik qʼij. Jalacha xqabʼano? Junam qawach chi qajuyubʼal. Xa xkoqotajqibʼ,” kechaʼ ta qi kechʼawik chi kibʼil kibʼ.

Chuwiʼ bʼis, chuwiʼ mokem, chuwiʼ puch oqʼej xechʼaw wi. Majaʼ kʼu chikubʼaʼoq kikʼuʼx chire usaqirik. Areʼ kʼut e kubʼukuxinaq wi ri kʼabʼawil pa taq siwan, pa taq kʼecheʼlaj.

Xa pa ekʼ, xa pa atzʼiyaq e kʼo wi. Ma na pa tzʼalam taj xeyaʼ wi. Kechʼaw na bʼek ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Nim kiqʼij, nim puch kabʼ kuxlabʼ chuwiʼ ronojel ukʼabʼawil Amaqʼ. Tzatz kinawal, tzatz puch kibʼinibʼal, kichakabʼal. Chitewnik, chixibʼinik kikʼojeʼik chikʼuʼx amaqʼ; kubʼulik kikʼuʼxlal kumal ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam.

Ma na chilik kʼayal ta kikʼuʼx chire ri kʼabʼawil kukʼaʼm, keqam puch xepe chilaʼ Tulan Tzuy Wa chi laʼ Relebʼal Qʼij. Xawi kʼu chi riʼ xekʼojeʼ wi pa kʼecheʼlaj.

Areʼ saqiribʼal: Pa Tojil, Pa Awilix, Pa Jaqawitz kuchaxik wakamik. Areʼ kʼut xeʼchawax wi, xesaqir wi qamam, qaqajaw. Waʼ chi qabʼij chik usaqirik, uwa[40r]chinik puch Qʼij, Ikʼ, Chʼumil.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ usaqirik uwachinik puch Qʼij, Ikʼ, Chʼumil. Nim kʼut xekiʼkotik Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam ta xril ri Ikoqʼij, nabʼe xel uloq. Chitiltotik uwach ta xel uloq, nabʼe kʼut chuwach Qʼij.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xkikir kipom, chilaʼ petenaq wi Relebʼal Qʼij.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kʼateʼ uchak [choqʼ] chi kikʼuʼx ta xkikiro koxichal, kikʼamowabʼal chi kikʼuʼx: Mixtam Pom ubʼiʼ pom rukʼaʼam Bʼalam Kitzeʼ; Kawistan Pom chik ubʼiʼ pom rukʼaʼam Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ; Kʼabʼawil Pom chuchaxik chik rukʼaʼm Majukutaj. E oxibʼ kʼo kipom.

Areʼ kʼut xkikʼato, ta xesaqbʼisanik aponoq chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij. Qʼus keʼoqʼikta xesakbʼisanik, xkikʼat kipom, loqʼolaj pom. Kʼateʼ kʼut xkoqʼej ri mawi xkilo, ma pu xkiwachij ralaxik qʼij.

Kʼateʼ puch ta xel ula Qʼij. Xkiʼkotik Chʼuti Chikop, Nima Chikop. Xkʼisyakataj uloq pa bʼe ya, pa siwan. Xekʼojeʼik tzaʼm taq juyubʼ. Xa jun xkʼi xe wi kiwach chilaʼ xel uloq Qʼij.

Kʼateʼ ta xeʼoqʼik koj, bʼalam. Nabʼe kʼut xoqʼ ri tzʼikin, Kʼeletzu ubʼiʼ. Qitzij chi xkiʼkot ronojel chikop. Xkirip kixikʼ kot, saq kʼuch, chʼuti tzʼikin, nima tzʼikin. E kʼu xukuxuxinaq ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ.

Nim kekiʼkotik rukʼ rajkʼixbʼ rajkʼajbʼ Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ rukʼ Rabʼinalebʼ, Kaqchekelebʼ, Aj Tzʼkina Ja, rukʼ Tujal Ja, Uchabʼa Ja, Kibʼaʼ, Aj Bʼatena, rukʼ Yaki Tepew; jarubʼ pa chi Amaqʼ kʼo wakamik. Mawi ajilam chi winaq: xa jun xsaqir wi ronojel Amaqʼ. Kʼateʼ puch xchaqijik Uwach Ulew rumal ri Qʼij. Kejeʼ ri jun chi winaq ri Qʼij ta xukʼut [40v]ribʼ.

Kʼatan uwach, areʼ xchaqij wi Uwach Ulew. Majaʼ chela ula Qʼij chʼaqalik, yitzʼil puch Uwach Ulew. Majaʼ chela ula Qʼij xa kʼu xkaʼoj [xkanaj] aqʼanoq ri Qʼij, kejeʼ ri jun chi winaq.

Ma kʼu xchʼijtajik ukʼatanal. Xa kʼu ukʼutbʼal ribʼ ta xalaxik, xa chi kʼu ulemow ri xkanajik. Mawi qitzij areʼ chi qʼij ri kawachinik, xchaʼ chupam kitzij.

Kʼateʼ puch jusuʼ xabʼajir ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz, rukʼ ukʼabʼawilal koj, bʼalam, sachoj,  kantiʼ. Saqi Kʼoxol xa xuchʼap uqʼabʼ ribʼ pa cheʼ. Ta xwachin Qʼij, Ikʼ, Chʼumil, jumaj abʼaj xuxik ronojel.

Ma ta oj yakamarinaq lo wakamik rumal ri tiyoʼnel chikop, koj, bʼalam, sachoj, kʼantiʼ; Saqi Kʼoxol ma ta ja bʼi qaqʼij lo wakamik, ma ta xabʼajirik unabʼe chikop rumal Qʼij.

Ta xel uloq, nima kikotem xkʼoje wi kikʼuʼx Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam, nim xekikotikta xsaqirik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Mana e ta kʼiyaʼ winaq chi kikʼojeʼik. Xa e chʼutiʼn ta xekʼojeʼ chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ Jaqawitz. Chiriʼ xesaqir wi; chiriʼ puch xekʼaton wi, xesaqbʼisan aponoq. Chilaʼ chi Relebʼal Qʼij xepe wi. Areʼ kijuyubʼal, kitaqʼajal, chi laʼ xepe wi Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam kibʼiʼ.

Chiriʼ kʼuteʼ xekʼiyar wi chuwiʼ juyubʼ areʼ kʼut kitinamit xuxik.

Chiriʼ kʼu kʼo wi ta kixwachin Qʼij, Ikʼ, Chʼumil.

Xsaqirik, xpakatajik Uwach Ulew, ronojel xeʼ Kaj.

Chiriʼ kʼut xtikar wi kibʼix, Qamaku ubʼiʼ xkibʼixaj.

Xa roqʼej kikʼuʼx, kipam xkibʼij chupam kibʼix: “Aqʼaroq! Xojsachik. Chi Tulan xojpaxin wi qibʼ. Xeqakanaj[41r]chik qatz, qachaqʼ. Awiʼ mi xkil wi Qʼij? Awiʼ on e kʼo wi ta mi xsaqirik?” xechaʼ chire rajkʼixbʼ, rajkʼajbʼ Yaki Winaq.

Xawi xere Tojil ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil Yaki Winaq.

“Yolkwat, Kitzalkwat ubʼiʼ xqajach chilaʼ chu Tulan, chi Tzuy Wa. Areʼ qachelik uloq, areʼ kʼut utzʼaqat qawach, ta xojpetik,” xechaʼ chikibʼil kibʼ ta xkinaʼtaj chi aponoq katz, kichaqʼ, ri Yaki Winaq ri xsaqirik chilaʼ Mexiko; ubʼinaʼam wakamik.

Kʼo chi nayipuch Chajkar Winaq xkikanaj chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij: Tepew Oliman kibʼiʼ “Xeqakanaj kanoq,” xechaʼ.

Nim uqʼatat kikʼuʼx chiriʼ chuwiʼ Jaqawitz. Xawi kʼeje kakibʼan ri rech Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ; xawi xere kʼo wi chi riʼ pa kʼicheʼlaj. Amaqʼ Tʼan (Dan) ubʼiʼ xsaqir wi rajkʼixbʼ, rajkʼajbʼ Tamubʼ, rukʼ ukʼabʼawil; xawi xere Tojil. Xa jun ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil roxchʼobʼichal Kʼecheʼ Winaq.

Xawi kʼu xere chik ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil Rabʼinalebʼ, xsqaqiʼn ujalkʼat ubʼiʼ.

Jun Toj chuchaxik ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil Rabʼinalebʼ.

Xa kʼu chaʼ riʼ xa chiraj junamataj chi Kʼecheʼ chi kichʼabʼal. Areʼ kʼut jalkʼatajinaq wi chʼabʼal rukʼ Qʼaqʼchekelebʼ rumal jalan ubʼiʼ ukabʼawil ta xpe chilaʼ Tulan Tzuy Wa: Sotzʼi Ja Chimalkan/Chamalkan ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil.

Xa kʼu chaʼ jalan uchʼabʼal wakamik; rukʼ nay puch chirij ukʼabʼawil xkʼamon wi ubʼiʼ uchinamit: Aj Poʼ Sotzʼil, Aj Poʼ Xajil keʼuchaxik. Xawi ukʼabʼawil xjalkʼatij wi uchʼabʼal, ta xyaʼ uloq ukʼabʼawil chilaʼ Tulan. Chirij abʼaj xjalkʼatij wi uchʼabʼal ta xepe Tulan chi qʼequʼmal. Xa kʼu jun xawax wi, xsaqir wi ronojel Amaqʼ. Kʼolejeʼ ubʼiʼ ukʼabʼawil chu jutaq chʼobʼil.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kʼut xchiqabʼij chik kiyalubʼik, kibʼayatajik puch chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ; xa jun xekʼoje wi kikajichal: Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iki Bʼalam kibʼiʼ. [41v]Koqʼ kikʼuʼx chire Tojil, Awilix, Jaqʼawitz. Areʼ kʼo chik pa ekʼ, pa tzʼiyaq kumal.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ kikʼatonik, uxeʼ chi puch kʼojbʼal rech Tojil, ta xebʼe kʼut chuwach Tojil, Awilix. Xbʼekilaʼ. Xbʼeʼ pu kiqʼijilaʼ. Xekʼamowan chik chuwach chire usaqirik. E kʼu wonowoj chik chi abʼajil chiriʼ pa kʼecheʼlaj. Xa kinawal wach chik xchʼawik ta xeʼopon ri ajkʼixbʼ, ajkʼajbʼ chuwach ri Tojil. Ma kʼu nim ri kukʼaʼm; kikʼatoj puch xa qʼol, xa rachaq noj, rukʼ iyʼa xkikʼato chuwach kikʼabʼawil. Ta xchaʼw kʼut ri Tojil, xa unawal chik, ta xyaʼ uloq kinaʼoj ri e Aj Kʼixbʼ, e Aj Kʼajbʼ.

Xechaʼ ta xechʼawik: «Xawi waral qajuyubʼal, qataqʼajal chuxik! Oj iwech chik mixuxik nim qaqʼij, nim pu qalaxik rumal ronojel winaq. Iwech ri ronojel Amaqʼ. Xawi kʼu ojiwachbʼil chiʼ na itinamit; xawi chiqayaʼ inaʼoj. Mojikʼut chuwach ri Amaqʼ, ta kojqʼaqʼanij rumal ri kitzij wi chi e kʼi chi kikʼojeʼik. Kejeʼ kʼu mawi kojiralajobʼisaj wi. Xere kʼut chiyaʼ chiqech ri ral kʼim, ral torobʼ. Xere kʼu ri xnaʼm kej, xnaʼm tzʼikin chultaiyaʼ sqaqiʼn ukʼikel chi qech: toqʼobʼ qawach!

Chikanaj kʼut rismal ri kej, chichajij, areʼ e ri umuquwach. Chimichʼ kanoq. Areʼ ukej chuxik, areʼ nay puch qakʼexwach chi kʼut chuwach Amaqʼ! Apa kʼo wi Tojil?” ta kixuchaxik. Areʼ kʼut chi kʼut ri kʼuʼkej chi kiwach. Mikʼut nay pu iwibʼ. Kʼo chi kʼut chibʼan chik, nim ikʼojeʼik chuxik. Chichʼak ronojel Amaqʼ! Chikukʼaʼj ukikʼel, ukomajil chi qawach. Chul wi kojkiqʼaluj eqech chik,» xchaʼ kʼu ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz.

Kʼajolal uwach chi kiwachibʼej ta keʼilik, ta chopon puch[42r]kʼatoj chi kiwach. Ta xtikar kʼut utzukuxik ri ral taq tzʼikin, ral kej; kʼamobʼ tzukuxik kumal ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ.

Areʼ kʼut ta chikiriq ri ral tzʼikin, ral kej, kʼateʼ kʼut chibʼekikʼulu ri ukikʼel kej, tzʼikin puchiʼ ri abʼaj ri Tojil, Awilix.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xuka ri kʼut ukʼaʼj kikʼ kumal kabʼawil. Jusuʼ chichʼaw ri abʼaj, ta keʼoponik ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ ta chibʼekiyaʼ kikʼatoj. Xawi kejeʼ chik chikibʼano chuwach ri kʼuʼkej, chikikʼat qʼol, chikikʼat puch iyʼaʼ, jolom okox.

Xkʼojeʼ kikʼuʼkej chi kijujunal chiriʼ kʼuʼl wi kumal chuwiʼ jujubʼ. Mawi kilaqabʼen ri kochoch chi qʼijil, xa pa taq juyubʼ kebʼiʼn wi. Areʼ kʼut chi kechaʼj riʼ xa ral wonon, xa ral sitaʼl, xa pu ral aqaj chikitzukuj. Mana ʼUtzilaj Waʼ, ʼUtzilaj Aʼ ta puch.

Mawi qʼalaj ubʼeʼel kochoch; mawi qʼalaj kʼo wi kanoq kixoqila. Areʼ kʼut tzatz chik ri Amaqʼ, jujun chi sepesoj wi, kikuchun chi kibʼ ri jutaq chʼobʼ chi Amaqʼ. Kebʼe lo chik pa taq bʼe, qʼalaj chi kibʼe.

Areʼ kʼu ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam xma qʼala je kʼo wi. Areʼ kʼut ta chikil ri Amaqʼ chikʼowik pa bʼe, kʼateʼ kʼut ta keʼoqʼ uloq tzaʼm taq juyubʼ; xa roqʼibʼal utiw, xa pu roqʼibʼal yak chikoqʼibʼej; xa pu roqʼibʼal koj, bʼalam chikibʼano.

Ta chi kil ri Amaqʼ kʼi chubʼinik. “Xa utiw riʼ koqʼik. Xa pu yak riʼ. Xa koj. Xa bʼalam,” kechaʼ kʼut Amaqʼ. Kejeʼ ri ma winaq chu kʼuʼx ri ronojel Amaqʼ. Xa kʼu michʼbʼal kech Amaqʼ ta chikibʼano. Kʼo karaj kikʼuʼx riʼ. Ma na qitzij ta chixibʼin ta ribʼ chikibʼano.

Kʼo kakaj chire roqʼibʼal koj, roqʼibʼal bʼalam chkoqʼebʼej.

Ta chikil kʼu ri winaq xa jun, xa kaʼibʼ chubʼinik, chi kaj kimayij chi[42v]kech.

Jutaqʼij ta keʼul chi kʼut chiriʼ chi kochoch rukʼ kixoqil. Xawi ral wonon, ral sitaʼl, xa pu ral aqaj kʼu kukʼaʼam, chikiyaʼo chirech kixoqil jutaqʼij.

Ta xebʼe chi kʼut chuwach Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz, xechaʼ kʼut chi kikʼuʼx: “Areʼ ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz xa ukikʼel kej, tzʼikin kaqayaʼ chi re. Xa qatʼisaʼ qaxikin, qachʼuʼk.

Qatzʼonoj qakowil, qachijilal chire Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Nakiʼ taj chikuchʼaʼj kikamik ri Amaqʼ. Xa ta jujunal keqakamisaj,” xechaʼ chi kibʼil kibʼ. Ta xebʼe kʼut chuwach Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Ta xkitʼis kixikin, kichʼuʼk chuwach kʼabʼawil.

Xkiwakuj ri kikikʼel, xqʼijik ukoq puchiʼ ri abʼaj. Ma kʼu qitzij ta chi abʼaj chuxik, kejeʼ ri e jujun chi kʼajolabʼ ta keʼulik. Xekiʼkot chik chirech ri kikikʼel Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ. Ta xpe chi kʼu retal kibʼanoj riʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Chichakonisaj kʼi jeʼ areʼ ikolbʼal iwibʼ; chilaʼ xpe wi chi Tulan ta xojikʼam uloq,” xeʼuchaxik kʼut ta xyaʼ uloq ri tzʼuʼum Pa Silisibʼ ubʼiʼ. Rukʼ kikʼ chok chi kij; kijabʼ ribʼ ri kikʼ xuxik uyaʼoʼn Tojil, rukʼ Awilix, Jaqawitz.

Waʼe utikarik chik relaqʼaxik Winaq Amaqʼ kumal Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Kʼateʼ puch ukamisaxik Amaqʼ riʼ. Areʼ xkikam ri xa jun chubʼinik, xa kaʼibʼ chubʼinik. Mawi qʼalaj ta chikikʼamaʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut ta chibʼekipusuʼ chuwach Tojil, Awilix. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta chikiyaʼ kikʼ pa bʼe; kʼolik ujolom, chikikʼolobʼaʼ pa bʼe.

Kechaʼ kʼut Amaqʼ: “Bʼalam mi xtiʼowik,” xa kechaʼ rumal kejeʼ ri raqan bʼalam, kaqan ta chikibʼano. Mawi chikikʼut kibʼ. Tzatz chi Amaqʼ xkeleqʼaj; kʼa unajt kʼut xunaʼ wi ribʼ Amaqʼ.   [43r]

“Waʼe areʼ ri Tojil, Awilix kok chiqe. Xa keqatzukuj ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ ta la kʼo wi kochoch. Chiqataqej ri kaqan!” xechaʼ kʼut konojel Amaqʼ ta xkikʼam kinaʼoj ch ikibʼil kibʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkitikibʼaʼ utaqexik kaqan ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ, ma kʼu qʼalaj. Xa raqan kej, xa raqan bʼalam chikilo. Mawi qʼalaj kaqan. Xma kʼo wi qʼalaj wi. Areʼ nabʼe kaqan ri xa kipich, kejeʼ ri kaqan; xa sachbʼal re kumal, mawi qʼalaj kibʼe. Xa chiwinaqir sutzʼ, xa chiwinaqir qʼeqal jabʼ. Xa pu chiwinaqir xoqʼoʼl, xa chiwinaqir musmul jabʼ chikilo chi kiwach Amaqʼ. Xa kʼu chikos kikʼuʼx chi kitzukuxik ta chi koqotaj kibʼe rumal nim ukʼojeʼik ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Najt kʼut xkibʼan chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ chu xikin ri Amaqʼ xkikamisaj.

Areʼ ta xwinaqir ri eleqʼik e chalami qʼat, ta chikikʼam ri Amaqʼ pa taq bʼe, chikipus chuwach ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Xkolo kʼut kikʼajol chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ. Areʼ Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz, oxibʼ chi kʼajolabʼ kiwachibʼal kebʼinik; xa unawal ri abʼaj.

Xkʼojeʼ jun jaʼ, areʼ keʼatin wi. Chiriʼ chuchiʼ Jaʼ xa kikʼutbʼal kibʼ. Xubʼinaʼaj kʼut Chi Ratinabʼal Tojil; ubʼiʼ Jaʼ xuxik. Kʼiya mul kʼut chikilo Amaqʼ. Libʼaj chi chikisachix taj kibʼ ta keʼilik rumal Amaqʼ.

Ta xuxtaj utzijel ri e kʼo wi ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Areʼ kʼu waʼ ukʼamik unaʼoj Amaqʼ chi re ukamisaxik taj. Nabʼe kʼut xraj kinaʼojij Amaqʼ uchʼakik Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xechaʼ ronojel ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ chuwach Amaqʼ. Xkejekʼ[xkijekʼ] kibʼ, xketaq [xkitaq] pu kibʼ konojel. Ma jabʼi juchʼobʼ, kachʼobʼ ta chik xkanaj chike. [43v]Konojel xekuchuw kibʼ. Xetaqow pu kibʼ ta xkʼam kinaʼoj. Xechaʼ kʼut ta xkitzʼonobʼej kibʼ: “Naqipaʼ chiquchaj kichʼakik ri Kaweq, Kʼecheʼ winaq rumal mixkʼis qal, kʼajol? Mawi qʼalaj usachik winaq kumal. We kojkʼisik chi eleqʼaxik. Ta chuxoq! We areʼ nim uqʼaqʼal ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Areʼ ta kʼut qakʼabʼawil ri Tojil chuxik. Chikanabʼij [chiqakanabʼij] taj. Mawi chutzinik kojkichʼako. Ma pa oj kʼiya winaq chi qakʼojeʼik? Areʼ kʼu ri Kaweq mawi jarubʼ chi kikʼojeʼik,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xeponik [xeʼopanik] konojel.

Xchaʼ chik chajkar chi kech ri Amaqʼ ta xechʼawik:

“Apachina rilo keʼatin chuchiʼ yaʼ juta qʼij? We areʼ Tojil, Awilix, Jaqʼawitz, areʼ ta keqachʼak na nabʼe. Chiriʼ ta kʼut chitikar wi kichʼakatajik ri e Aj Kʼixbʼ,e Aj Kʼajbʼ,” xechaʼ chi kʼut chajkar chik ta xechʼawik:

“Nakilaʼ kʼut chi qachʼakbʼej kech?” xechaʼ chi kʼut.

“Areʼ ta qachʼakbʼalkech chuxik rumal ri e kʼajolabʼ kewachinik ta keʼilitaj chi Jaʼ. Kebʼeta kʼut e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ. Areʼ ta riʼ qitzij chi e chaʼom, e ta saqloqʼojlaj chi qʼapojibʼ; chibʼe ta kʼut kirayibʼal chire,” xechaʼ kʼut.

“Utzbʼaʼ laʼ. Xa bʼaʼ keqatzukuj e ta kaʼibʼ chi utzilaj taq qʼapojibʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut, ta xkitzukuj kʼut kimeʼal. Areʼ ri qitzij e saqilaj taq qʼapojibʼ ta xkipixabʼaj kʼut ri qʼapojibʼ:

«Kixbʼek, ix qamiʼal. Oj ichʼajaʼ ri kʼul chi Yaʼ; chi Jaʼ; chi Aʼ. We kʼut ta keʼiwil ri e Oxibʼ Kʼajolabʼ, chitzonobʼaʼ kʼa iwibʼ chikiwach. We kʼut chirayin kikʼux chiwe, kixchoko : “Kojopon ta chi wij!” ta kechaʼ chiwech.“We,” kixchaʼ kʼut. Ta kixtzʼonox kʼut: “Apa kixpe wi? Apa ajchoqʼ miʼal?” ta kechaʼ.“Oj kimiʼal Ajawabʼ,” kixchaʼ kʼu chike. Chipe kʼu retal iwumal. Ta[44r]naki laʼ chikiyaʼ chiwe. Taseq chikirayij iwach, qitzij chiyaʼ iwibʼ chikech. We kʼut ta mawi chiyaʼ iwibʼ, kixqakamisaj kʼut. Kʼateʼ utz qakʼuʼx ta kʼo retal chikʼam uloq. Areʼ kʼut retal chi qakʼuʼx ta keʼopon chiwij,» xechaʼ kʼu ri Ajawabʼ ta xepixabʼax ri qʼapojibʼ.

E kaʼibʼ.

Areʼ kibʼiʼ waʼ: IxTaj ubʼiʼ jun qʼapoj, IxPuch chi kʼut ubʼiʼ jun chik.

body:
E pu kaʼibʼ, IxTaj, IxPuch kibʼiʼ, xetaq ubʼi chi Yaʼ, chi atinabʼal Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz.

Areʼ kinaʼoj ronojel Amaqʼ riʼ.

Kʼateʼ puch xebʼek, xekawuxik. Qitzij wi chi jebʼelik chi wachinik ta xebʼek chilaʼ chatin Tojil. Kikariloʼon kʼu ri kichʼajoʼm ta xebʼek. Kekikot chi kʼu ri Ajawabʼ kumal ri e kaʼibʼ kimiʼal xkitaq ubʼik.

Ta xeʼopon kʼut chi Yaʼ, chi Jaʼ, chi Aʼ, kʼateʼ xkitikibʼaʼ chʼajonik. Xkitzʼonobʼaʼ kibʼ kikabʼichal.

E chakachaxinaq chuwach taq abʼaj ta xekʼulunkʼu ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqʼawitz. Xeʼopon chi laʼ chuchiʼ yaʼ. Xa kʼu sqaqiʼn xrokʼowibʼej kiwach ri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ kechʼajonik. Areʼ kʼu ri qʼapojibʼ xa jusuʼ xekʼixbʼik ta xeʼopon ri Tojil. Ma kʼu ja bʼi xbʼe kirayibʼal ri Tojil chire chri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ. Ta xetzʼonox kʼut: “Apa kixpe wi?” xeʼuchaxik chirech ri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ.

Xeʼuchaxik: “Nakipaʼ kiwaj? Kixul waral chuchiʼ wi qaʼAʼ?” xeʼuchax kʼut.

«Oj bʼaʼ taqon uloq kumal Ajawabʼ, ta xojpetik.“Chibʼeʼiwilaʼ kiwach ri Tojil. Kixchʼaw kukʼ!” xechaʼ Ajawabʼ chiqe.

“Kejeʼ kʼut chipe wi retal qitzij we chiwil kiwach,” xojojuchaʼxik,» xechaʼ kʼu ri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ ta xkisukʼubʼaʼ kitaqikil. Areʼ ta kʼu xkaj ri Amaqʼ, xejox ta ri qʼapojibʼ rumal kinawal Tojil.

Xechaʼ kʼu ri Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz[44v]ta xechʼaw chik chikech ri IxTaj, IxPuch, kibʼiʼ ri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ: “Utz chibʼek retal qatzij iwukʼ. Chiwoyobʼejna chi Yaʼ aponoq chi kech Ajawabʼ,” xeʼuchax kʼut.

Kʼateʼ puch kinaʼojinik chik ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ. Xeʼuchax ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam: “kixtzʼibʼanoq oxibʼ kʼul. Chitzʼibʼaj retal ikʼojeʼik, chopon kukʼ Amaqʼ. Chibʼe kukʼ ri e kaʼibʼ qʼapojibʼ ke chʼajonik. Chiyaʼ ubʼik chike,” xeʼuchax kʼut Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj. Kʼateʼ kʼut xetzʼibʼanik koxichal.

Nabʼe xtzʼibʼan ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ. Bʼalam uwachibʼal xuxik xutzʼibʼaj chuwach kʼul. Areʼ kʼu ri chi Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Kot chik uwachibʼal xutzʼibʼaj chuwach kʼul. Ta xtzʼibʼan chi kʼu ri Majukutaj. Jumaj wonon , jumaj sitaʼl uwachibʼal utzʼibʼ xutzʼibʼaj chuwach kʼul. Xutzin kʼut kitzʼibʼ roxichal. Oxbʼusaj xkitzʼibʼaj. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xebʼekiyaʼ kʼul (chike) ri IxTaj, IxPuch kibʼiʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xechaʼ kʼu ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj: «Waʼe retal itzij kixoponik chikiwach Ajawabʼ.“Qitzij xchʼaw ri Tojil chiqe,” kixchaʼ.“Waʼe retal xqakʼam uloq,” kixchaʼ chike. Chi kiqʼuʼuj kʼu ri kʼal [kʼul] chiyaʼ chike,»  xeʼuchax kʼut ri qʼapojibʼ xkipixabʼaj ubʼik.

Ta xebʼe kʼut, xkukʼaʼj ubʼi ri tzʼibʼan kʼul. Ta xeʼopon kʼut. Jusuʼ xekiʼkot ri Ajawabʼ ta xil kiwach. Xekel uqʼabʼ kitzʼonoxik ri Qʼapojibʼ.

“Ma xiwil uwach ri Tojil?” xeʼuchaxik.

“Xqil bʼaʼ laʼ,” xechaʼ kʼu ri IxTaj, IxPuch.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Naki paʼ retal xikʼam uloq? Ma qitzij?” xechaʼ ri Ajawabʼ.

Kejeʼ riʼ bʼaʼ ri retal ki makunik xkinaʼ ri Ajawabʼ.

Ta xkiritaj kʼu ri tzʼibʼan [tzʼibʼam] kʼul kumal Qʼapojibʼ.

Jumaj bʼalam, jumaj [45r]kot, jumaj naiʼ puch wonon, sitaʼl; utzʼibʼal upam kʼul.

Chiyulinik uwach. Ta xkirayij kʼut uwach kʼul.

Kʼate xkikoj chikij. Ma kʼu jabʼi xubʼan ri Bʼalam, utzʼibʼal nabʼeʼoq chrij Ajaw.

Ta xukoj chi kʼut Ajaw ri ukabʼ tzʼibʼam kʼul, kot utzʼibʼal. Xa utz xunaʼ ajaw chupam; xawi kasolowik chi kiwach, katzʼonon uqʼuʼxik chi kiwach konojel. Ta xok chi kʼut rox tzʼibʼam kʼul chi rij Ajaw. Areʼ ri wonon, sitaʼl upam xukoj kʼu chirij. Kʼateʼ puch ta xtiyʼik utiyoʼjil rumal wonon, sitaʼl. Mawi xchʼijtajik. Ma pu xkuyutaj kitiyoʼbʼal chikop. Ta kʼu xuraquj kʼu uchiʼ Ajaw rumal chikop. Xa tzʼibʼam kiwachibʼal chupam kʼul, utzʼibʼ Majukutaj kʼu rox tzʼibʼ ta xechʼakataj wi. Kʼateʼ puch kiyajik qʼapojibʼ riʼ rumal Ajawabʼ: riʼ IxTaj, IxPuch kibʼiʼ.

“Naki paʼ chi kʼulal ri iwukʼaʼm uloq? Apa xbʼeʼikʼama wi? Ix Kʼaxtoqʼ,” xeʼuchax ri qʼapojibʼ ta xeyajik.

Kichʼakatajik chi kʼu riʼ ronojel Amaqʼ rumal Tojil. Areʼ ta xkaj xbʼe ta kiʼibʼal ri Tojil chi kij IxTaj, IxPuch. E ta joxol chʼek xeʼuxik chukʼuʼx Amaqʼ taqchiʼbʼal ta ke xuxik.

Ma kʼu xbʼantajik kikchʼakatajik rumal e Nawal Winaq ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj. Ta xenaʼojin chi kʼut ronojel Amaqʼ.

“Nakipaʼ kequchʼaj? Qitzij nim kikʼojeʼik ta chuxoq,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xkikuch chik kinaʼoj.

“Xa ta keqokibʼej, keqakamisaj! Chiqawik qibʼ chi Chʼabʼ chi Pokobʼ. Ma pa oj kʼi? Ma ja bʼi jun kaʼibʼ chik chiqakanaj chike,” xechaʼ kʼut ta xkʼam kinaʼoj.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xa xuwiq ribʼ ronojel Amaqʼ; tzatz chi kamisanel ta xemolotajik ronojel Amaqʼ, e kamisanel. Areʼ kʼut e kʼo ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj,[45v]Iki Bʼalam.

Areʼ e kʼo chuwiʼ juyubʼ. Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ juyubʼ e kʼo wi. Xkʼolow kʼut kikʼajol chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ. Mawi e ta kʼiya winaq. Mana kejeʼ ta kikʼiyal ri ukʼiyalamaqʼ.

Xa sqaqiʼn uwiʼ juyubʼ kikʼatem, kiqʼatem xa kʼu chaʼ ta xnaʼojix kikamisaxik rumal Amaqʼ. Ta xkikuch kibʼ; konojel xeʼoponik, xetaqow kibʼ konojel. Waʼe kʼateʼ kimolowik kibʼ konojel Amaqʼ. E kawutal chik chichʼabʼ, chi pokobʼ konojel. Mawi ajilamchi pwaq kikawubʼal.

Jebʼej oj kiwachibʼal konojel Ajawabʼ, Achijabʼ. Qitzij bʼanoj kitzij konojel.

“Qitzij e qalabʼil chuxik.”

“Areʼ kʼu ri Tojil, areʼ kʼabʼawil, areʼ pu chikaqʼijilaʼ!”

“Xere ta chi qakanabʼij,” xechaʼ chikibʼil kibʼ. Xawi kʼu karetaʼmaj ri Tojil, kaketaʼmaj naiʼ pu ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj.

Kakitaʼo ta kanaʼojixik rumal maja bʼi kiwaram, kiyakalem. Ta xekawutajkʼut ronojel [cha] ajlabʼal. Kʼateʼ kut xeyakatjik ronojel ajlabʼal. Chaqʼabʼ taj xkokibʼejchi kikʼuʼx.

Ta xebʼek, ma kʼu xeʼoponik.

Xa pa bʼe xewaraj [xewar]wi konojel ri ajlabʼal. Kʼateʼ puch kichʼakatajik chik kumal ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj. Xa kʼu jun xewaraj wi pa bʼe. Maja bʼi chik xkinaʼ chi kibʼ, xekʼiswarik konojel. Kʼateʼ kʼu utikarik umichʼik kimukuwach rumal, rukʼ kismachiʼ.

Ta xkir kʼu ri pwaq chi kiqul, rukʼ kiyachwach, rukʼ puch kichachal. Areʼ kʼu uqul kichʼamiʼy, xere xkikʼam ri pwaq. Kʼajisabʼal kiwach. Xa pu michʼbʼal kech xbʼanik. Retal unimal Kʼicheʼ Winaq. Kʼateʼ puch xekʼastajik. Jusuʼ xkichapalaʼ[46r]kiyachwach rukʼ u rukʼ uqul kichʼamiʼy.

Ma jabʼi chi pwaq chiqul rukʼ kiyachwach.

“Nakipaʼ mixojkʼamowik? A on chinaq mixojmichʼowik? Apa mi xpe wi mi xelaqʼan qapwaq?” xechʼ kʼut konojel Aj Labʼal.

“Areʼ laʼ yi bʼaʼ ri lo e kʼaxtokʼ keʼelaqʼan winaq. Ma kʼu chutzinik chiqaxibʼij ta qibʼ chike. Qi wi chiqokibʼej kitinamit. Xawi xere chiqil uwach ri qapwaq, chiqabʼan qech,” xechaʼ kʼut konojel amaqʼ.

Xawi xere bʼanoj tzij konojel.

Xawi kʼu kubʼul kikʼuʼx ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ e kʼo chuwiʼ juyubʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xawi xere nima naʼoj kakibʼano ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Ta xenaʼojin kʼut Bʼalam Kitze, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iki Bʼalam, xkibʼan kʼoxtun chuchiʼ kitinamit. Xa tzʼalam, xa chʼut xchikejbʼej rij kitinamit. Kʼateʼ xkibʼan ri poy, kʼejeʼ ri winaq xuxik kumal. Kʼateʼ xkichol chiriʼ chuwiʼ kʼoxtun; xawi xere kʼo kipokobʼ, kʼo pu kichʼabʼ; xekawuxik. Xok ri yachwach pwaq pa kiwiʼ. Xok pu kʼu xa Poy, xa pu Ajam Cheʼ xkojow ri pwaq rech Amaqʼ ri xbʼekikʼamaʼ pa bʼe. Areʼ xukawubʼej poy kumal. Xekotkomijik chrij tinamit.

Kʼateʼ puch ta xkitzʼonoj chi kinaʼoj chirech Tojil.

“We kojkamik? We puch kojchʼakatajik?” xechaʼxoq  kikʼuʼx chuwach ri Tojil.

“Mixbʼisonik. Inkʼolik. Areʼ kʼut chikoj waʼ chi kech, mixibʼij iwibʼ,” xeʼuchax ri Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Iki Bʼalam. Ta xyaʼ uloq ri wonon, sitaʼl; areʼ kʼut xbʼekikʼamaʼ, kukʼaʼam ta xepetik. Kʼateʼ xkiyaʼo chi upam kajibʼ nimaʼq kukubʼ, kajibʼ xkʼojeʼ wi chrij tinamit. Xkitzʼapij wi ri wonon, sitaʼl chi upam kukubʼ. Areʼ kʼululebʼal rech Amaqʼ [46v]kumal. Xenikʼwachij kʼut. Xemukcheʼex puch. Xnikʼox kitinamit rumal usamajel amaqʼ.

“Mawi e jurubʼ,” xechaʼ kʼut. Xere kʼut xulkilaʼ ri poy , ajam cheʼ. Kesilajeʼik kukʼaʼla on kichʼabʼ, kipokobʼ; qitzij winaq kewachinik; qitzij chi e kamisanel kewachinik ta xkil amaqʼ.

Kekikotik kʼut ronojel Amaqʼ, mawi janikʼ xkilo. Tzatz ri Amaqʼ chu kʼojeʼik. Mawi ajilan chi winaq, e Aj Labʼal, e pu Kamisanel; e kamisay rech ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj. Areʼ kʼo chuwiʼ juyubʼ. Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ e kʼo wi. Areʼ kʼut kokibʼexik waʼ xchiqabʼij chik. Areʼ kʼut e kʼo chiriʼ Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Xa jun e kʼo wi chuwiʼ juyubʼ rukʼ kixoqil, kalkʼwʼal.

Ta xpe kʼut ronojel Aj Labʼal, e Kamisanel.

Mawi xa kachuy, oxchuy chi Amaqʼ xkotkomij chrij tinamit.

Keʼominik.

E wiqitalik chi chʼabʼ, chi pokobʼ.

Chikiqʼosij kichiʼ, kelulutik, kechʼaninik, chiʼominik, kiyuyubʼ kixulqʼabʼ ta xeʼok chuxeʼ tinamit.

Ma kʼu jabʼi kakixibʼij kibʼ ri Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ xa kekaʼy uloq chuchiʼ kʼoxtun, e cholon uloq rukʼ kixoqil, kalkʼwʼal; xa kuʼl kikʼuʼx.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Bʼanoj kʼu kitzij ri amaqʼ ta xeʼaqʼan kʼut chuwach juyubʼ.

Xa kʼu sqaqiʼn chik mawi ketzʼaqonik chuchiʼ tinamit, kʼateʼ puch ta xjaq uwiʼ ri kokobʼ.

Kajibʼ kʼo wi chiʼ tinamit. Ta xeʼel kʼu ri wonon, sitaʼl. Kejeʼ ri sibʼ ta xel chi upam ri jujun chi kokobʼ. Kutzin kʼu ri Aj Labʼal rumal chikop.

Takʼatoj chubʼaqʼ kiwach, takʼatoj puch chi kitzaʼm, chi kichiʼ, chi kaqan, chi kiqʼabʼ. A kʼo wi xchibʼe kichapa. A on kʼo wi, chibʼe kimajaʼ, ronojel kʼo wi wonon, sitaʼl. E takʼatoj chutiyʼoma [47r] ubʼaqʼ uwach, xchikilij chubʼuchuw jeʼ taq chikop chrij ri jujun chi winaq.

Xeqʼabʼarik rumal wonon, sitaʼl. Mawi xchapataj chik ki chʼabʼ, ki pokobʼ. Kewonqʼoʼyejeʼik chuwach taq Ulew. Kelajajik. Xeqajik chuwachjuyubʼ.

Areʼ kʼut mawi kakinaʼ chik ta xekʼaq chi chʼabʼ, xechoychi ikaj. Xa bʼolaj cheʼ xkikoj chik Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ; xok kixoqil e kamisanel. Xawi kʼu xetzalij ri chajqar chik. Xa xel chi chikaqan ronojel amaqʼ. Areʼ xkiriq ki nabʼe xeʼutzinik, xekamisaxik; ma na xa skqaqiʼn chi winaq xkamik. Mawi areʼ xkam wi ri xkitzaʼij chi kikʼuʼx. Xa kʼu chikop xok chike.

Mana kʼulaʼ achijilal taj xkibʼano.

Mawi chʼabʼ, mawi pokobʼ taj xekam wi; ta xeyoqʼotajik ronojel Amaqʼ. Xa kʼu xeʼelajik chi ri amaqʼ chi kiwach ri Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj:

“Toqʼobʼ qawach. Ma ta kojkamik,” xechaʼ.

“Utz bʼaʼ laʼ. Xax ix wi kamel chuxik, Ix Aj Patan chibʼe qʼij, chibʼe saq,” xeʼuchaxik.

Kejeʼ kʼut uchʼakatajik ronojel Amaqʼ riʼ kumal qanabʼe chuch, qajaw.

Chiriʼ xbʼan wi chuwiʼ juyubʼ, Jaqawitz, ubʼinaʼam wakamik. Areʼ nabʼe xetikeʼ wi.

Chi riʼ xepoqʼ wi, xekiritaj wi.

Xemiʼalanik, xekʼajolanik chuwiʼ Jaqawitz.

Kekiʼkot chik ta xkichʼako ronojel Amaqʼ; chiriʼ chʼakatajinaq wi chuwiʼ juyubʼ.

Kejeʼ kʼut xkibʼan riʼ, xkichʼak na Amaqʼ, ronojel Amaqʼ.

Kʼateʼ kʼut xkubʼeʼ kikʼuʼx .

Xetzijon chire kikʼajol.

Xnaqajoqn kekamoq ta qixeraj kamisaxik.

Areʼ chik wi xchiqabʼij chik kikamik Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam kibʼiʼ. Xkinaʼ kʼut kikamik, kisachik. Ta xepixabʼik chirech kikʼajol. Mana e ta yabʼ, ma pu kejilowik, kepolowtaj xkanaj kitzij chire kikaʼjol. [47v]

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Areʼ kibʼiʼ kikʼajol waʼ. E kaʼibʼ xukʼajolaj Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ: Kʼo Kaʼibʼ ubʼiʼ nabʼeʼal.

Koqʼawibʼ chikubʼiʼ ukabʼal, ukʼajol Bʼalam Kitzeʼ,umam, uqajaw Kawiqibʼ.

E chi wi kʼu kaʼibʼ chik xukʼajolaj Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ. Areʼ kibʼiʼ waʼ: Kʼo Akul ubʼiʼ unabʼe ukʼajol. Kʼo Akutek chuchax chik ukabʼ ukʼajol Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, rech Nijayibʼabʼ.

Xa kʼu jun xukʼajolaj Majukutaj:  Kʼo Ajaw ubʼiʼ. E oxibʼ xekʼajolanik; maja bʼi ukʼajol ri Ikʼi Bʼalam. Qitzij Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ. Areʼ kʼut kibʼiʼ kikʼajol riʼ.

Areʼ xkipixabʼaj kanoq; xa jun e kʼo wi kikajichal. Xebʼixanik, chiqʼatat kikʼuʼx; choqʼ pa kikʼuʼx chupam kibʼixik. Qamaku ubʼiʼ kibʼix xkibʼixaj. Ta xepixabʼ kʼut chire kikʼajol: “Ix Qakʼajol, kojbʼek, kojtzalij puch. Saqil tzij, saqil pixabʼ qapixabʼ chiwe.”

“Mi kʼu xixulqakanajt chi juyubʼal, ix qixoqil,” xechaʼ chire kixoqil chi kijujunal xepixabʼik:

“Kojbʼe chi qamaqʼ. Cholan chik Qajawal Kej: Leman chikaj. Xa tzalijem xchiqabʼano. Mixbʼanatajik qapatan, mixtzʼaqat qaqʼij. Kojinaʼ kʼut. Mojisacho, mojimes kʼu taj puch! Chiwil na iwochoch, ijuyubʼal puch, kixtikeʼ wi. Ta chuxoq! Kixbʼe kʼut chibʼeʼ iwilaʼ chik xojpe wi,” xchaʼ kʼu kitzij ta xepixabʼik. Ta xkanaj kʼut retal ukʼojeʼik Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ.

“Areʼ inatabʼal wech, waʼ xchinkanaj iwukʼ. Areʼ iqʼaqʼal waʼe. Mixnupixabʼaj, xnubʼisoj,” xchaʼ kʼut. Ta xukanaj ri retal ukʼojeʼik: Pisom Qʼaqʼal chuchaxik.

Mawi qʼalaj uwach.

Xawi qi pislik.

Xma kiromwi.

Mawi qʼalaj tʼisbʼal re rumal maja bʼiʼ xilowik ta xpisik.

Kejeʼ kʼut kipixabʼik riʼ ta xesach kʼut chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ Jaqawitz.

[48r]Ma na xemuqtaj rumal kixoqil, kalkʼwaʼal.

Mawi qʼalaj kisachik ta xesachik.

Xere qʼalaj wi kipixabʼik, loqʼ kʼu ri Pisom chikech xuxik; areʼ nabʼabʼal rech kiqajaw.

Xa jusuʼ xekʼaton chuwach kinabʼabʼal rech kiqajaw. Areʼ ta xwinaqir wi winaq kumal Ajawabʼ. Ta xekam chrij Bʼalam Kitzeʼ; Tikarinaq wi umam, uqajaw Kawiqibʼ.
