source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Xma kʼu wi kʼut xkisach wi ri ukʼajol riʼ: Kʼo Kaʼibʼ, Kʼo Kawibʼ kibʼiʼ. Kejeʼ kʼut kikamik ri kikajichal, e nabʼe qamam, qaqajaw; ta xesachik; ta xkanajchik kikʼajol chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ Jaqawitz xeyalaj chi wi kikʼajol chiriʼ. Qajinaq chik, yoqʼotajinaq chi puch kiqʼij konojel Amaqʼ. Ma jabʼi chik kiqʼaqʼal. Xaqi e kʼo chik. Xawi kukʼaʼm kibʼ konojel juta qʼij. Chikinabʼaj kiqajaw. Nim uqʼij ri Pisom chike. Mawi chikikiro. Xawi pislik chiriʼ kukʼ. Pisom Qʼaqʼal, chuchaʼxik kumal ta xkʼojiʼk. Xbʼinaʼj puch kikʼuʼum xyaʼ kanoq rumal kiqajaw; xa retal kikʼojeʼik ta xkibʼano. Kejeʼ kʼu kisachik, kimayixik Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam, e nabʼe winaq xepe chilaʼ chʼaqa palo, chi Relebʼal Qʼij. Ojeroq keʼul waral. Ta xekamik, e riʼj chik: E Aj Kʼixbʼ, Aj Kʼajbʼ; kibʼinaʼam.

Kʼisbʼal Tzij rech ri Ojer Tzij Kʼicheʼ Winaq, Kʼicheʼ Amaqʼ

Kʼateʼ puch xkikʼuʼxlaʼaj kibʼik chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij. Areʼ kikʼuʼxlaʼn ri upixabʼ kiqajaw, mawi xkisacho. Xojeroq kekamoq kiqajaw. Xyaʼ kixoqil Amaqʼ xkijiʼaj ta xechokow ixoq e Oxibʼ.

Xechaʼ kʼut ta xebʼek: “Kojbʼe chi laʼ Relebʼal Qʼij. Chilaʼ xepewi qaqajaw,” xechaʼ ta xkikʼam kibʼe e oxibʼ chi kʼajolaxel. [48v] Kokaʼibʼ ubʼiʼ jun, ukʼajol Bʼalam Kitzeʼ rech ronojel Kawiqibʼ. Ko Akutek ubʼiʼ ukʼajol Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, xa rech Nijayibʼabʼ. Koʼ Ajaw ubʼiʼ jun chik, ukʼajol Majukutaj, rech Ajaw Kʼicheʼ areʼ kʼu kibʼiʼ ri xebʼe chilaʼ chʼaqa palo.

E Oxibʼ ta xebʼek. Xa wi kʼo kinaʼoj. Kʼo pu ketaʼmabʼal. Mana xa ʼEt Winaqʼ kikʼojeʼik. Xkipixabʼaj kanoq ronojel katz, kichaqʼ. Kekiʼkotik xebʼek.

“Mawikojkamik, kojulik,” xechaʼ ta xebʼek e Oxibʼ.

Xawi xere xeʼikʼowik Chuwiʼ Palo; ta xeʼopon kʼut chilaʼ Relebʼal Qʼij; ta xbʼekikʼamaʼ ri Aj Awarem.

Areʼ kʼu ubʼiʼ Ajaw waʼ: Rajawal Aj Relebʼal Qʼij xeʼopon wi. Ta xeʼopon chuwach Ajaw Nakxit; ubʼiʼ Nima Ajaw. Xa jun Qʼatol Tzij, tzatz rajawarem. Areʼ kʼut xyaʼow uloq retal Aj Awarem, ronojel uwachinel.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ta xpetik retal Aj Popol, Aj Pop Kʼamjayil. Ta xpe kʼut uqʼaqʼal rajawarem puch Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼamja. Xkʼisuyaʼ uloq Nakxit, uwachibʼal Aj Awarem. Areʼ taq ubʼiʼ waʼ: muʼj, qʼaʼlibʼal, subʼaq, chamcham, tatil, qʼanabʼaj, tzʼikwil koj, tzʼikwil bʼalam, jolom, pich kej, makutax, tʼotʼ tatam, kʼus bʼus, kaxkon, chiyom, astapulul.

Ronojel kʼu kekʼaʼm riʼ xepetik.

Ta xkikʼam ula riʼ chʼaqa palo ʼUtzʼibʼal Tulanʼ.

Utzʼibʼal xechaʼ chire ki okinaq chupam, chi upam kitzij.

Kʼateʼ puch ta xeʼulik chiriʼ chuwiʼ kitinamit, Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ. Chiriʼ kʼut xekuch wi  ronojel Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ. Xekuch wi kibʼ ronojel Amaqʼ. Xekiʼkotik ta xeʼulik Koʼ Kaʼibʼ, Koʼ Akutek, Koʼ Ajaw. Xawi chi riʼ chik xkikʼam wi Kajawarem Amaqʼ. Xekiʼkotik e Rabʼinalebʼ, e Kaqchekelebʼ, Aj Tzʼikina Ja. [49r] Xa retal xkʼutun chi kiwach ri unimal Aj Awarem. Nim chik kikʼojeʼik chuxik Amaqʼ. Ma nabʼe xkʼis ta kikʼut Kajawarem areʼ e kʼo chi riʼ Jaqawitz. Xa kʼo kukʼ konojel ri xpe Relebʼal Qʼij. Najt chi kʼut xkibʼan chiriʼ chuwiʼ juyubʼ.

E kʼiy chik chi konojel. Chiriʼ kʼut xekam wi kixoqil Bʼalam Kitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj. Ta xepetik; xkoqotaj chi kanoq ri kijuyubʼal. Jun chi juyubʼ xkitzukuj areʼ ketikeʼ wi.

Mawi ajilam juyubʼ xetikeʼ wi. Ta xeqobʼik, ta xebʼinaʼaj puch chire riʼ xemolomanik, xechʼijomanik e nabʼe qachuch, e nabʼe qaqajaw, xechaʼ Ojer taq Winaq ta xkitzijoj; ta xkitolobʼaʼ pu kanajoq kitinamit Jaqawitz ubʼiʼ. Ta xeʼul chi kʼu chiriʼ, xkitikilibʼej chikjun tinamit Chi Kʼix ubʼiʼ.

Najt chi xkibʼan chiriʼ chuwiʼ juchʼobʼ tinamit; kemiʼalanik, kekʼajolanik puch. Chiriʼ ke e kʼo taq wi. Areʼ taq Kajibʼ Juyubʼ waʼ. Xa jun xchok wi ubʼiʼ ri kitinamit xkikʼulubʼaʼ kimiʼal, kikʼajol. Xaqi chi kisipaj; xa toqʼobʼanik; xa pu mayijanik chikibʼano rajil kimiʼal chikikʼamo. Xa utz kikʼojeʼik xkibʼano ta xeʼikow chiriʼ chuwiʼ jutaq chʼobʼ chi tinamit. Waʼ taq ubʼiʼ: e Chi Kʼix, Chi Chak, Jumeta Ja, Kʼulbʼa, Kawinal ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xeyaluj wi. Areʼ kʼut kakinikʼ wachij ri juyubʼ, kitinamit puch.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ulaj juyubʼ kakitzukuj. E kʼu kʼiy chik chi konojel. Xa kʼu kaminaqoq ri kʼamol Aj Awarem Relebʼal Qʼij. E mamaxel chik xeʼul chi riʼ chuwiʼ jun tinamit. Mana xukʼaʼm kiwach ri xeʼikʼow wi jeʼ taq wi uloq kʼaxkʼol rayil xkibʼano. Kʼa unajt xkiriq wi kitinamit e mamaxel e pu qajawixel. [49v] Waʼ kʼu ubʼiʼ tinamit e xeʼul wi: Chi Ismachiʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ juyubʼ, kitinamit xekʼojeʼ wi. Chiʼ naʼi puch xeamaqʼelabʼ wi. Chiriʼ kʼut xkitij wi qʼaqʼal.

Xqaj kichun, kisajkabʼ chukajleʼoq ajawabʼ.

Xechaʼ kʼu ri Kʼonacheʼ xu [rukʼ]Bʼelejebʼ Kej rukʼ puch Qʼalel Ajaw taxajawar kʼut Ajaw Kʼotuja rukʼ Istayul [Stayul], kibʼiʼ Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼamja; xeʼajawar chiriʼ Chi Ismachiʼ.

Utzilaj tinamit xuxik, xkibʼano. Xa kʼu Oxibʼ ri Nim Ja xux chiriʼ Chi Ismachiʼ.

Maja bʼiʼoq ri juwinaq Kajibʼ chi Nim Ja. Kʼa oxibʼoq kinimja: xa jun unimja Kawiqibʼ, xa kʼu jun Nim Ja chuwach Nijayibʼabʼ, xa naʼi pujun rech Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Xa qikaʼibʼ chi Nim Ja ri kachʼobʼ chichinamit areʼ e kʼo Chi Ismachiʼ. Xa jun kikʼuʼx. Ma jabʼiʼ kitzelal. Ma pu ja bʼiʼ kikayewal. Xa liʼanik Aj Awarem. Maj abʼiʼ kichʼaʼoj, kiyujuj puch. Xasaq, xa amaqʼ kʼo chi kikʼuʼx.

Maja bʼiʼ moxwachinik, ma pu ja bʼiʼ qʼaqʼwachinik xkibʼano. Kʼa chʼutiʼnoq kiqʼaqʼal. Majaʼ ki kanukʼ mayjoq. Majaʼ pu kanimaroq. Ta xkitij kʼut, xkikowisaj poqobʼ chi riʼ Chi Ismachiʼ!

Xretal kʼut kajawarem riʼ ta xkibʼanox retal kiqʼaqʼal, retal naʼi pu kinimal. Ta xil kʼut rumal Ilokabʼ, ta xwinaqir labʼal rumal Ilokabʼ. Xraj ul kamisaxoq ri Ajaw Koʼ Tuj Ja, KoʼTuja. Xa kʼu Jun Ajaw xraj kʼu kibʼ.

Areʼ ri Ajaw Xtayul xraj kitijoj, xraj tijoxkumal Ilokabʼ chi kamisanik.

Ma kʼu xel aponoq kimoxwachibʼal chirij Ajaw Koʼ Tuja, xa chikij xqaj wi ma[50r]nabʼe xkam ta ri ajaw rumal Ilokabʼ. Kejeʼ kʼut uxeʼnajik yujuj, chakimal, labʼal puch. Xkokibʼej nabʼe tinamit. Xebʼek e kamisanel. Areʼ ta kʼu xkaj riʼ sach ta uwach Kʼicheʼ; xa ta kitukel xajawarik chikikʼuʼx. Xa kʼu areʼ xeʼulkʼamoq. Xetelecheʼexik, xekanabʼix puch.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Mawi jurubʼ chik xkolotaj chike, ta xtikerkʼut pusunik. Xpus ri Ilokabʼ chuwach kʼabʼawil. Areʼ chik tojbʼal kimak xuxik rumal Ajaw Ko Tuja. Kʼi chi kʼut xok chi munil, xealabʼilaxik, xewinaqix puch. Xa xbʼekiyaʼ kibʼ chi chʼakix rumal kinukʼbʼal labʼal chirij Ajaw; chirij Siwan, Tinamit.

Xmayixik. Xqʼutux ta uwach rajawal Kʼicheʼ xraj kikʼuʼx. Ma kʼu xbʼanatajik, kejeʼ kʼut uwinaqirik upusik winaq chuwa kʼabʼawil. Ta xbʼan ri pokobʼ labʼal, uxeʼ ta xtikarik upokobʼaxik tinamit Chi Ismachiʼ. Chilaʼ xtikar wi uxeʼnajik qʼaqʼal rumal ri xax nim wi rajawarem Kʼicheʼ Ajaw. Jumaj e Nawal Ajawabʼ. Xma kʼo wi kiyoqʼotajik wi. Xma kʼo wi alachinaq chok chike. Xawi bʼanol rech nimal ajawarem, chiriʼ xeʼnajinaq wi Chi Ismachiʼ. Chiriʼ xnimar wi ukʼixik kʼabʼawil.

Chixibʼin chik. Xuxibʼij pu ribʼ ronojel Amaqʼ; Chʼuti Amaqʼ, Nima Amaqʼ.

Xkiwachij rokik telecheʼ winaq. Xkipusu, xkikamisaj rumal kiqʼaqʼal, kitepewal ri ajaw KoTuja, Ajaw Istayul rukʼ Nijayibʼabʼ, Ajaw Kʼicheʼ.

Xa ox chʼobʼ chi chinamit xkʼojeʼ chiriʼ Chi Ismachiʼ, ubʼiʼ tinamit. Kʼa chiriʼ chi naʼi puch xkitikibʼaʼ wi waʼim, ukʼaj Jaʼ chirech kimiʼal ta xkisiʼij  uloq. Areʼ kikuchubʼal kibʼ ri oxibʼ chi nima ja, ubʼiʼ kumal. Chiriʼ kʼut chikukʼaʼj wi kukʼiyaʼ. Chiriʼ puch chi kiweʼj[51v]wi kiwa, rajil kanabʼ, rajil pu miʼal. Xa kiʼkotem chi kikʼuʼxta xkibʼano. Xewaʼik, xeʼachaʼ chupam kinimja.

“Xa qakʼamowabʼal, xa pu qapaqʼubʼal chirech qetal, qatzijel, retal qatzij chuwiʼ ixoq al, achij al,” xechaʼ. Chi laʼ xkʼobʼ wi uloq. Chilaʼ puch xkibʼij wi kichinamit kibʼ, Wuk Amaqʼ kibʼ, kitekpan kibʼ.

“Qakʼulel qibʼ, oj Kawiqibʼ, oj Nijayibʼ, oj pu Ajaw Kʼicheʼ,” xechaʼ e oxibʼ chinamit, oxibʼ puch nimja. Najt kʼut xkibʼan chiriʼ Chi Ismachiʼ. Ta xkiriq chik, ta xkil puch jun chik tinamit. Xkoqotaj chiwi ri Chi Ismachiʼ. Kʼateʼ puch ta xeyakataj chi uloq, xeʼul chiriʼ pa tinamit Qʼumaʼr Kaʼaj, ubʼiʼ kumal Kʼicheʼ chuchaxik. Ta xeʼul chik Ajawabʼ KoʼTuja, rukʼ Qʼukumatz, rukʼ naʼi puch ronojel Ajawabʼ. Xroʼkʼexoq, xroʼleʼa puch winaq uxeʼ saq, uxeʼ amaqʼ, uxeʼ kʼaslem, winaqirem.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Chiriʼ kʼut qixkibʼan wi kochoch. Chiriʼ naʼi puch xkibʼan wi rochoch kʼabʼawil. Chunikʼajal uwiʼ tinamit xkiyaʼ wi ta xeʼulik, ta xkitikilibʼej puch. Kʼateʼ puch unimarik chik kajawarem. E kʼi chik. E pu tzatz chik. Ta xkinaʼojij chik kinimja xemoloxik. Xejachajox puch rumal xwinaqirk ichʼaʼoj. Xeqʼaqʼwachin chi kibʼ chuwiʼ rajil kanabʼ, rajil kimiʼal rumal xa mawi chitzʼaqon; kukʼiyaʼ chikiwach. Areʼ chi kʼut uxeʼ chi kijachowik kibʼ. Ta xkitzolbʼej kibʼ, tzolkʼaqbʼej bʼaq, ujolom kaminaq xkiqʼaqbʼej kibʼ. Ta xkipax ri bʼelej taq chi chinamit. Xbʼanomoq uchʼaʼojil anab,, miʼal ta xbʼan unaʼojixik ajawarem.

Juwinaq kajibʼ chi Nim Ja xuxik. Xojeroq keʼulik konojel chiriʼ chuwiʼ kitinamit ta xetzʼaqat juwinaqkajibʼ Nim Ja chiriʼ pa tinamit Qʼumaʼr Kaʼaj.

Xutzirisaxik [51r] rumal Señor Obʼispo ri tinamit kʼa xtoleʼ kanoq. Xeqʼaqʼar chiriʼ, Xnukʼmayijinaqoq kitem, kichʼat. Xjachatzox kiwach jutaq wi chi qʼaqʼ jujun chi ajawabʼ.

Bʼelejebʼ taq chi chinamit xukʼolelaʼ ribʼ.

Bʼelejebʼ chi Ajawabʼ Kawiqibʼ.

Bʼelejebʼ chi Ajawabʼ Nijayibʼabʼ.

Kajibʼ chi Ajawabʼ Ajaw Kʼicheʼ.

Kaʼibʼ chi Ajaw Saqikʼibʼ.

Kʼiya taq xuxik; kʼi chi nayipuch chirij jujun Ajawabʼ. Xa unabʼe riʼ kʼo chiwi ral, ukʼajol. Tzatz, tzatz uchinamital jujun chi Ajawabʼ. Chiqabʼij kibʼiʼ Ajawabʼ chu jujunal jujun unim ja. Waʼe kʼuteʼ kibʼiʼ Ajawabʼ chuwach Kawiqibʼ. Areʼ nabʼe ajaw waʼ: Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼamja, Aj Tojil, Aj Qʼukumatz, Nim Chʼokoj Kaweq, Popol Winaq chi Tuy, Lolmet Kejnay, Popol Winaq Pa Jom Tzalatzʼ, Uchuch Kʼam Ja. Areʼ kʼut Ajawabʼ riʼ chuwach Kawiqibʼ.

Bʼelejebʼ chi Ajawabʼ, kʼolejeʼ unim ja chujujunal. Kʼateʼ chik chiwachin uwach. Areʼ chi kʼu Ajawabʼ waʼ chuwach Nijayibʼabʼ. Areʼ Nabʼeʼ Ajaw waʼ: Ajaw Qʼalel, Ajaw Aj Tzikʼ Winaq, Qʼalel Kʼam Ja, Nima Kʼam Ja, Uchuch Kʼam Ja, Nim Chʼokoj Nijaʼibʼabʼ, Awilix, Yakolatam Utzaʼm Pop Saqlatol, Nima Lolmet Yeʼoltux. Bʼelejebʼ kʼut chi Ajawabʼ chuwach Nijayibʼabʼ.

Areʼ chi kʼut Ajaw Kʼicheʼ waʼ. Waʼe kibʼiʼ Ajawabʼ: Aj Tzikʼ Winaq, Ajaw Lolmet, Ajaw Nim Chʼokoj Ajaw, Ajaw Jaqawitz. Kajibʼ Ajawabʼ chuwach Ajaw Kʼicheʼibʼ. Kʼolojeʼ unim ja.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Kaʼibʼ chinamit chi naʼipuch Saqikʼibʼ Ajawabʼ: Tzʼutuja, Qʼalel Saqikʼ. Xa jun chi nima ja, e kaʼibʼ chi Ajawabʼ. Kejeʼ kʼut xtzʼaqat wi juwinaq kajibʼ chi Ajawabʼ. [51v] Juwinaq Kajibʼ naʼi puch chi Nim Ja xuxik. Ta xnimarik qʼaqʼal, tepewal pa Kʼicheʼ, ta xqʼaqʼarik, ta xtepewarik unimal, ralal Kʼicheʼ

Ta xchunaxik, ta xsajkabʼix puch Siwan, Tinamit. Xul Chʼuti Amaqʼ, Nima Amaqʼ. Kʼo kʼut ubʼiʼ Ajaw xnimarisan Kʼicheʼ ta xwinaqirik qʼaqʼal tepewal. Ta xwinaqirik rochoch kʼabʼawil, kochoch naʼipu Ajawabʼ. Ma naʼipu areʼ xebʼanowik. Mawi xechakun taj. Ma pu xkibʼanta kochoch, ma naʼipu xa ta xkibʼan rochoch kikʼabʼawil, xa rumal xekʼiyarik kal kikʼajol.

Ma na xa kibʼochi, xa ta pu keleqʼ, kikupun ta puch. Qitzij wi chikech Ajawabʼ chi kijujunal. Tzatz naʼipuch katz,kichaqʼ xuxik. Xmolomoxik ukʼojeʼik. Xmolomox nayipu chu taʼbʼal tzij jun chi ajawabʼ. Qitzij wi chi eloqʼ. Qitzij puch chi nim kiqalem ajawabʼ. Nima talik, xowatal puch uqʼij ralaxik ajawabʼ rumal ral ukʼajol. Ta xkʼiyarik Aj Siwan, Aj Tinamit rukʼ naʼipuch. Mana xa ta qi kejeʼ xulkiyaʼ kibʼ ronojel Amaqʼ. Kʼa labʼal kʼut xqaj wi usiwan utinamit. Kʼa rumal kinawal Ajawabʼ xeqʼaqʼarwi ri Ajaw Qʼukumatz, AjawKʼotuja.

Qitzij chi Nawal Ajaw ri Qʼukumatz xuxik.

Juwuq chaqʼan chikaj.

Juwuq chi kʼut chibʼeʼubʼanaʼ qajoq chi Xibʼalbʼa.

Juwuq chi kʼut chikʼojeʼik chi kumatzil.

Qitzij chi kumatz chuxik.

Juwuq chi naʼipuch chubʼano chi kʼotal; juwuq chik chi bʼaʼlamil.

Qitzij wi chi kot, chi bʼalam uwachibʼal chuxik.

Juwuq chik chire meʼik chi kikʼel.

Utukel remanik kikʼ chuxik. [52r]

Qitzij chi Nawal Ajaw ukʼojeʼik.

Xibʼixibʼ chuwach rumal ronojel Ajawabʼ.

Xpaxin ribʼ utaʼik; xuta ronojel Ajawabʼ, Amaqʼ ukʼojeʼik Nawal Ajaw. Are kʼut utikarik unimarik puch Kʼicheʼ. Ta xubʼan Ajaw Qʼukumatz retal nimal. Xma sachel uwach umam, ukʼajol chu kʼuʼx. Maja bʼi a ta laʼ xbʼan wi ri xkʼojeʼ ta Jun Ajaw; Nawal ta ukʼojeʼik. Xa yoqʼbʼal rech ronojel Amaqʼ ta xubʼano. Xa ukʼutbʼal ribʼ xere ju kʼisik ujolom Amaqʼ xuxik.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ukaj leʼ Ajaw ri Nawal Ajaw Qʼukumatz ubʼiʼ. Xawi xe Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja. Xkanaj chi kʼut ketal, kitzijel. Xeqʼaqʼarik, xetepewar puch. Ta xekʼajolan chi kʼut. Kʼa kikʼajol kʼut tzatz chik xubʼano. Xkʼajolax ri Tepepul, Istayul. Xa kʼi Ajawarem xubʼano: Roʼ Leʼ Ajaw xuxik. Xawi xekʼajolanik jutaq leʼ chi Ajawabʼ.

Waʼ chi kʼuteʼ kibʼiʼ chik Uwaq Leʼ Ajawabʼ. E kaʼibʼ chi Nimaʼq Ajawabʼ. E qʼaqʼ. Kʼiqʼabʼ ubʼiʼ jun ajaw;  Kawisimaj ubʼiʼ jun chik. Areʼ kʼut tzatz xubʼan ri Kʼiqʼabʼ, Kʼawisimaj. Areʼ chi xnimarisan Kʼicheʼ rumal qitzij Nawal ukʼojeʼik.

Areʼ qʼajowik, areʼ puch xpaxinik usiwan, utinamit Chʼuti Amaqʼ, Nim Amaqʼ. Naqaj taq uxoʼl kʼo wi ri tinamit ojer. Areʼ ujuyubʼal ri Kaqchekelebʼ ri Chuwiʼ La wakamik. Ujuyubʼal chi naʼipu Rabʼinalebʼ ri Pa Maqʼa. Ujuyubʼ kʼu Kaʼoqkebʼ ri Saqabʼaj Jaʼ.

Utinamit chi kʼut Saqulewabʼ, Chuwiʼ Miqʼinaʼ, Xelajuʼ, Chuwa Tzʼaq, rukʼ Tzʼoloj Cheʼ. Areʼ xrixowaj Kʼiqabʼ, xubʼan labʼal. Qitzij wi xqajik, xpaxik usiwan, utinamit Rabʼinalebʼ, Kaqchekelebʼ, Saqulewabʼ. Xuleʼik, xpakʼaʼik ronojel Amaqʼ. Kʼa xtokʼe [52v] chi najt ukamisaj Kʼiqʼabʼ. Juchʼobʼ kachʼobʼ ta chik mawi kukʼaʼm upatan chirech ronojel, xqaj utinamit.

Xukʼam upatan chuwach Kʼiqabʼ, Kʼawisimaj. Xeʼok chi munil. Xelotzik, xekʼaqik chi cheʼ. Ma jabʼi kiqʼij, ma jabʼi kalaxik xuxik.Xa chaʼ mi xkʼojeʼ paxibʼal tinamit. Jusuʼ chijixtajik uchiʼ ulew, kejeʼ ri chiqopin kaqulja chupaxij abʼaj chi xibʼinik. Libʼaj chik chelaj Amaqʼ chuwach Qʼol Cheʼ, retal tinamit rumal. Wakamik jun juyubʼ abʼaj. Xsqaqiʼn chik mawi xqʼatatajik. Kejeʼ ri xchoy chi ikaj rumal.

Chilaʼ kʼo wi pa taqʼaj, Petatayubʼ ubʼiʼ. Qʼalaj wakamik, karil ronojel winaq keʼikʼow wi. Retal rachijilal Kʼiqabʼ. Ma jabʼi xkam wi, ma pu jabʼi xchʼakataj wi. Qitzij wi chi achij. Xukʼam kʼut upatan ronojel amaqʼ. Ta xenaʼojin kʼut Ajawabʼ konojel. Ta xbʼek qʼatey rij siwan, rij tinamit. Xqajinaqoq utinamit ronojel amaqʼ. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta relik waranel, ilolaj labʼal.

Ta xkibʼan kʼut uwachinel chinamit, laqʼabʼey juyubʼ: “We chipe chik, ta chululaqʼabʼej utinamit amaqʼ,” xechaʼ ta xkikuch kinaʼoj konojel ajawabʼ. Ta xel kiwabʼaʼn.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
“Kejeʼ ri qakʼejoj, kejeʼ pu qʼaka chinamit, kejeʼ nayipuch qatzʼalam, qakʼoxtun chuxik. Areʼ chik qoyowal, qachijilal. Ta chuxoq!” xechaʼ konojel ajawabʼ.

Ta xeʼelik uwabʼaʼn jujun chi chinamit, kʼulelaʼay rech Aj Labʼal. Ta xepixabʼax kʼut. Ta xebʼe puch wabʼaʼn, laqʼabʼey ujuyubʼal Amaqʼ.

“Chibʼek rumal qajuyubʼal chik. Mixibʼij iwibʼ. Wekʼo chik Aj Labʼal chul chik iwukʼ ta kamisay iwe, anim chulibʼij. Chibʼenukamisaj,” xchaʼ kʼut Kʼiqʼabʼ chikech ta xepixabʼaxik konojel uwach rukʼ Qʼalel Ajtzikʼ  Winaq. Ta xbʼeʼijeʼik wi uchiʼ cha, uchiʼ kʼaʼam,[53r] chuchaxik. Ta xpaxin ribʼ umam uqajaw riʼ ronojel kʼecheʼ winaq kʼo pa jujun chi juyubʼ. Xa chajal juyubʼ, xa pu chajal cha, kʼaʼam. Chajal labʼal puch ta xbʼek.

Ma na jun ta xsaqir wi, ma naʼipuch jun ta ukʼabʼawil. Xa qʼatey rij tinamit. Ta xelik ronojel Aj Uwiʼla, Aj Chʼumilal, Saqiyaʼ, Xabʼakej, Chilemaj, Wajxalajuj rukʼ chik Aj Kabʼrakan, Kabʼikak, Chi Jun Ajpu, rukʼ Aj Maqʼa, Aj Xoyajabʼaj, Aj Saqkabʼaj Jaʼ, Aj Siya Jaʼ, Aj Miqʼinaʼ, Aj Xelajuj, ta qʼajal juyubʼ ri xelik, waray labʼal, chajal ulew ta xbʼek rumal Kʼiqabʼ, Kʼawisimaj, Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, Qʼalel, Aj Tzikʼ Winaq. E kajibʼ chi ajawabʼ xetaqonik, xewaran puch Aj Labʼal. Kʼiqʼabʼ, Kʼawisimaj ubʼiʼ ajaw chuwach Kawiqibʼ. E kaʼibʼ.

Keʼema ubʼiʼ Ajaw chuwach Nijayibʼ, Achaq Ibʼoy kʼut ubʼiʼ Ajaw chuwachAjaw Kʼicheʼ.

Areʼ kʼut kibʼiʼ ri xetaqowik, xesamajelan puch. Ta xebʼek kal, kikʼajol pa juyubʼ.

Pa jujun chi juyubʼ xbʼe na kʼu nabʼe xul na kanabʼ, xul na telecheʼ chuwach Kʼiqabʼ, Kʼawisimaj, Qʼalel, Ajtzikʼ Winaq. Xkibʼan chi wi labʼal uchiʼ cha, uchiʼ kʼaʼam. Xekanabʼ chik. Xetelecheʼen chik. E achij xeʼux chik ri e wabʼaʼn. Xeyaʼik, xekʼiyar kʼut.

Kʼichi kʼut kikʼuxlal kumal ajawabʼ ta chulkiyaʼ kikanabʼ, kitelecheʼ ronojel. Kʼateʼ kʼut ta xkuchnaʼoj kumal Ajawabʼ Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, Qʼalel, Ajtzikʼ Winaq. Ta xel kʼu naʼoj.

Xa kachaʼ pa kinabʼe: “Chikʼojeʼ ta qeqalem; wachinel chinamit chok wi. In Aj Pop. In Aj Pop Kʼam Ja chiwe qalej. We chok chi kʼu awe, at Ajaw Qʼalel, Qʼalel ri qalem xchuxik,” xechaʼ kʼut ronojel Ajawabʼ ta xkʼam kinaʼoj. Xa wi kʼu kejeʼ xubʼano Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Junam uwach Ox Chʼobʼ chi [53v] Kʼicheʼ. Ta xbʼan chaponik xkiqʼobʼisaj unabʼe kal, kikʼajol. Kejeʼ kʼut wakamik naʼoj. Ma kʼu chiriʼ xchap wi Kʼicheʼ. Kʼo ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xchap wi unabʼe al, kʼajol. Ta xetaq kʼut ronojel kʼo pa jujun chi juyubʼ. Xa jun xekuch wi. Xebʼalax, Xkamak ubʼiʼ juyubʼ xechap wi ta xok kiqalem. Chiriʼ Chulimal xbʼan wi.

Waʼ kʼuteʼ kiqʼobʼik, kichapik ,ketaxik puch juwinaq Qʼalel, juwinaq Aj Pop, xchapik rumal Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, rumal Qʼalel, Ajtzikʼ Winaq. Xok keqalem ronojel: Qʼalel, Aj Pop, Julajuj Nim Chʼokoj, Qʼalel Ajaw, Qʼalel Saqikʼ, Uqʼalel Achij, Rajpop Achij, Rajtzʼalam Achij, Utzaʼm Achij kibʼiʼ achijabʼ xokik ta xeqʼobʼik, xebʼinaaj puch chuwiʼ kitem, chuwiʼ kichʼakat. E unabʼe ral, ukʼajol Kʼecheʼ winaq.

Ilol rech, taʼol rech uchiʼ cha, uchiʼ kʼaʼam, kʼejoj, tzʼapibʼ tzʼalam, kʼoxtun chrij Kʼicheʼ. Xawi kʼu kejeʼ xubʼan Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ. Xuchapo, xuqʼobʼisaj unabʼe ral, ukʼajol kʼo pa jujun chi juyubʼ. Areʼ kʼut uxeʼnajik Qʼalel, Aj Pop re qalem pa jujun chi juyubʼ wakamik. Kejeʼ relik riʼ ta xeʼelik. Chrij Aj Pop,Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, chrij puch Qʼalel, Aj Tzikʼ Winaq xel wi.

Areʼ kʼut xchiqabʼij chik ubʼiʼ rochoch kʼabʼawil. Xawi xere xubʼinaʼaj rochoch ri ubʼiʼ kʼabʼawil. Nimaq Tzʼaq. Tojil ubʼiʼ Tzʼaq,  rochoch Tojil rech Kawiqibʼ; Awilix kʼut ubʼiʼ Tzʼaq Rochoch Awilix rech Nijayibʼabʼ. Jaqawitz chi kʼut ubʼiʼ Tzʼaq Rochoch ukʼabʼawil Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Tzʼutuj Ja, kilna Kʼajbʼa Ja ubʼiʼ chik Nimaq Tzʼaq xkʼojeʼ wi abʼaj xqʼijiloʼxik rumal Ajawabʼ Kʼicheʼ, xqʼijiloʼx puch rumal ronojel amaqʼ. Chok na ukʼatoj Amaqʼ nabʼe chuwach ri Tojil, kʼateʼ kʼut ta chuqʼijilaʼ chik Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja.

[54r] Kʼateʼ chulkiyaʼ kiqʼuqʼ, kipatan chuwach ajaw; areʼ Ajaw chik; areʼ chi puch kitzuquʼn, kikʼoʼn.

Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja xqasan kitinamit, e nima ajawabʼ, e nawal taq winaq, nawal ajaw ri Qʼukumatz, Kʼotuja: Nawal Ajaw kʼu ri Kʼiqabʼ, Kʼawisimaj. Ketaʼam we labʼal chibʼanik; qʼalaj chikiwach. Ronojel chikilo. We kamik, we waʼij, we chʼaoj chibʼanik xa xketaʼm wi.

Kʼo kʼut ilbʼal re. Kʼo uwuj: Popol Wuj ubʼiʼ kumal.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Ma na xa kejeʼ e Ajawabʼ. Nim kikʼojeʼik, nim puch kimewajik. Areʼ loqʼbʼal tzʼaq, loqʼbʼal pu ajawarem kumal. Najtik chik kemewajik. Xekʼajbʼik chuwach kikʼabʼawil. Waʼ kʼuteʼ kimewajibʼal: bʼelej winaq kemewajik. Jubʼelej kʼut kekʼajbʼik, kekʼatonik. Oxlaju winaq chik kimewajibʼal, oxlaju chi kʼut kekʼajbʼik, kekʼatonik chuwach Tojil, chuwach pu kikʼabʼawil. Xa tulul, xa ajacheʼ, xa qʼinom chikiloʼo. Areʼ ma jabʼiʼ wa chi kiweʼej. We kʼut wuqlajuj winaq kekʼajbʼik, wuqlajuj chik kemewajik, mawi kewaʼik. Qitzij wi chi nima awas inik chikibʼano. Areʼ retal kikʼojeʼike Ajawabʼ. Rukʼ kʼut ma jabʼiʼ ixoq chiwar kʼut. Xa kitukel chi kichajij kibʼ. Kemewajik. Xa pa rochoch kʼabʼawil kekʼojeʼ wi jutaqʼij. Xa qʼijiloʼnik, xa kʼatonik, xa pu kʼajbʼik chikibʼano. Xawi chiriʼ e kʼo wi xqʼeq, xsaqirik.

Xa choqʼ kikʼuʼx, xa pu choqʼ kipam taketzʼononik chirech usaq, ukʼaslemkal, kikʼajol, chire naʼipuch kajawarem. Chikipaqabʼaʼ kiwach chikaj. Waʼ kʼuteʼ kitzʼonobʼal chuwach kikʼabʼawil ta ketzʼononik, areʼ kʼut roqʼej kikʼuʼx waʼ:

“Aqʼaroq, at Joʼobʼ uqʼij, at Juraqan, at Ukʼuʼx Kaj Ulew, at Yaʼol rech qʼanal, raxal, at pu Yaʼol [54v] miʼal, kʼajol .Chatziloj, chamaqʼij uloq araxal, aqʼanal. Chayaʼ taj ukʼaseʼik, uwinaqirik wal, nukʼajol. Chipoqʼ taj, chi winaqir taj tzuqul awe, kʼoʼol awe, sikʼiy awe pa bʼe, pa jok, pa bʼeya, pa siwan, xeʼ cheʼ, xeʼ kʼaʼam .Chayaʼaʼ kimiʼal, kikʼajol. Ma ta jabʼiʼ il tzap, iyan kexo. Ma ta chok kʼaxtokʼonel chikij chikiwach. Mepajik, mesokotajik, mejoxowik, meqʼatowik. Meqajik rikem bʼe, rajsik bʼe. Mata jabʼiʼ pak, toxkom chikij, chikiwach. Keʼayaʼ taj pa raxa bʼe, pa raxa jok. Ma ta jabʼiʼ kil kitzap, awil, awitzmal. Utz taj kikʼojeʼik tzuqul awe, qʼoʼol awech achiʼ, chawach, at Ukʼuʼx Kaj, at Ukʼuʼx Ulew, at Pisom Qʼaqʼal, at puch Tojil, Awilix, Jaqawitz. Upam Kaj, Upam Ulew; Kaj Tzʼuq, Kaj Xukut; xa ta Saq, xa ta Amaqʼ upam chachiʼ, chawach, at Kʼabʼawil.”

Kejeʼ kʼut ri Ajawabʼ ta kemewajik chupam ri bʼelej winaq, oxlaju winaq, wuqlaju winaq puch kimewayij qʼij.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Choqʼ kikʼuʼxchuwiʼ kal, kikʼajol, chuwiʼ puch ronojel ixoq, alkʼwʼal ta xkibʼan kipatan jujun chi ajawabʼ. Areʼ loqʼbʼal saq kʼaslem, loqʼbʼal puch ajawarem. Areʼ rajawarem Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, Qʼalel, AjTzikʼ Winaq. E kakabʼ ta keʼokik. Kejalow kibʼ chire qalixik amaqʼ, rukʼ ronojel Kʼicheʼ Winaq. Xa jun xel wi uxeʼ tzij, uxeʼ puch tzuquj, kʼoʼoj.

Xawi kejeʼ kubʼano Tamubʼ, Ilokabʼ, rukʼ Rabʼinelebʼ, Kaqchikelebʼ, Aj Tzʼkina Ja, Tujala Ja, Uchabʼa Ja. Xa jun cheʼel wi ta xikin chiriʼ Kʼecheʼ. Ta xubʼano rech ronojel. Ma na xa qi kejeʼ xeʼajawarik. Ma na xa xkikʼaqkochij tzuqul ke, kʼoʼl ke. Xa ta kiwaʼin ukʼajax kibʼano. Ma pu xaloqʼ taj[55r] xkitzubʼu xkeleqʼaj kajawarem, kiqʼaqʼal, kitepewal. Ma naʼi pu xa ta kejeʼ xqaj usiwan, utinamit, chʼuti amaqʼ, nima amaqʼ.

Nim rajil xkiyaʼo.

Xul xit, xul pwaq.

Xul puch kajqʼabʼ raqan, tuwik raqan chi kʼwal, chi yamanik.

Xul puch raxon, kubʼul chak tik.

Upatan ronojel Amaqʼ xul chi kiwach Nawal Ajawabʼ Qʼukumatz, Kʼotuj [Kʼotuja] , chuwach puch Kʼiqʼabʼ, Kʼawisimaj, ri Aj Pop, Aj Pop Kʼam Ja, Qʼalel, Ajsik Winaq.

Ma wi xa chʼutiʼn xkibʼano, ma naʼipu xa ta sqʼaqiʼn chi Amaqʼ xkiqasaj. Kʼiya chʼobʼ chi Amaqʼ xul upatan Kʼicheʼ. Kʼaxkʼol kʼut xkʼam wi, xyakex wi kumal. Mawi atam xwinaqirik kiqʼaqʼal. Kʼa Qʼukumatz, uxeʼ unimal chi ajawarem. Kejeʼ kʼut utikarik, unimarikriʼ, uwinaqirik puch Kʼicheʼ. Areʼ chi kʼut xchiqacholo uleʼel ajawabʼ rukʼ kibʼiʼ konojel ajawabʼ xchiqabʼij chik.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ uleʼel, utasel ajawarem chi ronojel kisaqiribʼem Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ, Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ, Majukutaj, Ikʼi Bʼalam. Nabʼe qa mam,nabʼe qaqajaw ta xwachin qʼij, xwachin ikʼ, chʼumil. Waʼe kʼuteʼ uleʼel, utasel ajawarem chiqatikibʼaʼ uloq qi chuxeʼ. Kʼulukʼuj chi rokik ajawabʼ ta chokik. Ta chikamijeʼik ju taq leʼ chi ajawabʼ, ri mama rukʼ rajawal chi tinamit, ronojel chi jujun chi ajawabʼ. Waʼe kʼuteʼ x chiwachin uwach chujujunal ajawabʼ.

Waʼe kʼuteʼ xchiwachin uwach jujun chujujunal ajawabʼ Kʼicheʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ uxeʼnabʼal Kawiqibʼ. Koqʼawibʼ ukaʼ leʼ chik Bʼalam Kʼitzeʼ. Bʼalam Ko Nacheʼ xtikibʼan Aj Popol. Rox leʼ kʼu riʼ. Kʼotuja, Istayul ukaj leʼ. Qʼukumatz, Kʼotuja uxeʼ Nawal Ajaw.[55v]Roʼ leʼ xkʼojeʼ wi. Tepepul, Istayul chi uwaq tas. Kʼiqʼabʼ, Kʼawisimaj uwuq jal ajawarem; nawal chiwi. Tepepul, Istayul uwajxaq leʼ. Tekum, Tepepul ubʼelej leʼ. Wajxaqi Kʼaʼam, Kʼiqʼabʼ kʼut ulajuleʼ ajawabʼ. Wuqubʼ Noʼj, Kʼawatepech chik ujulaj utas ajawabʼ. Oxibʼ Kej, Bʼelejebʼ Tzʼiʼ ukabʼlajuleʼ ajawabʼ, areʼ kʼut keʼajawarik ta xul Donadiu: Xejitzʼaxik rumal Castillan Winaq. Tekum, Tepepul xepatanijik chuwach Castillan Winaq. Areʼ xekʼajolan kanoq roxlaju leʼ ajawabʼ. Don Juan de Rojas, Don Juan Cortes kajlaju leʼ ajawabʼ. E kʼajolaxel rumal Tekum, Tepepul. Areʼ kʼut uleʼel, utasel ajawarem, ri ajaw Aj Pop Kʼam Ja chuwach Kawiqibʼ Kʼicheʼ.

Areʼ chi xchiqabʼij chik re chinamit. Waʼ chi kʼuteʼ nim ja rech jujun chi ajawabʼ chirij Ajpop, Ajpop Kʼamja. Areʼ ubʼinaʼam ri bʼelejebʼ chinamit chi Kawiqibʼ. Bʼelejebʼ unim ja. Waʼ taq ubʼiʼ e rajawal jujun chi nim ja: Ajaw Ajpop jun unim ja. Kaja ubʼiʼ nim ja. Ajaw Ajpop Kʼamja, Tzʼikina Ja ubʼiʼ unim ja. Nim Chʼokoj Kaweq jun unim ja. Ajaw Ajtojil jun unim ja. Ajaw Ajqʼukumatz jun unim ja. Popol Winaq Chituy jun unim ja. Lolmet Kejnay jun unim ja. Popol Winaq Pajom Tzalatz Xkuxebʼajun unim ja. Tepew Yaki jun unim ja.Areʼ kʼu ri bʼelejebʼ chinamit chi Kawiqibʼ. Tzatz ral, ukʼajol, ajilatal chrij bʼelejebʼ chi nim ja.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
Waʼ kʼuteʼ rech Nijayibʼabʼ.Bʼelejebʼ chi wi chi nim ja. Areʼ nabʼe xchiqa[56r]bʼij uleʼabʼal ribʼ ajawarem. Xajun uxeʼ xtikar chuwach uxeʼ qʼij, uxeʼ saq chi winaq. Bʼalam Aqʼabʼ nabʼe mamaxel, qajawixel. Koʼ Akul Koʼ Akutek uka leʼ. Koʼ Chajuj Koʼ Tzibʼaja rox leʼ. Bʼelejebʼ Kij [Kej] ukaj leʼ chik. Koʼ Tuja roʼ leʼ ajaw. Bʼatza chi kʼut uwaq leʼ chik. Istayul chi kʼut uwuq leʼ Ajaw. KoʼTuja chi wi uwajxaq tas ajawarem. Bʼelejebʼ Kej ubʼelej tas. Kema chuchax chik ulaju leʼ. Ajaw Koʼ Tuja ujulaju leʼ. Don Cristowal chuchaxik xajawarik chuwach kaxtilan winaq. D.Pedro de Robles Ajaw Qʼalel wakamik. Areʼ kʼu chi ronojel ajawabʼ elenaq chrij ri Ajaw Qʼalel. Areʼ chik xchiqabʼij rajawal jujun chi nim ja. Ajaw Qʼalel unabʼe ajaw chuwach Nijayibʼabʼ, jun unim ja. Ajaw Ajtzikʼ Winaq jun unim ja. Ajaw Qʼalel Kʼamja jun unim ja. Nima Kʼamja jun unim ja. Uchuch Kʼamja jun unim ja. Nim Chʼokoj Nijayibʼ jun unim ja. Ajaw Awilix jun unim ja. Yakolatam jun unim ja. Areʼ kʼut nim ja riʼ chuwach Nijayibʼabʼ. Areʼ ubʼinaʼam wi bʼelejebʼ chinamit chi Nijayibʼabʼ chuchaxik. Kʼiyataʼq kʼut uchinamital jujun chike ajawabʼ. Areʼ unabʼe ri mi xqabʼij kibʼiʼ. [56v]

Areʼ chi kʼut rech Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Waʼ umam, uqajaw; Majukutaj Nabʼe Winaq. Koʼ Ajaw ubʼiʼ uka leʼ ajaw. Kaqʼalakam KokosomKomajkun, Wuqub Aj Koʼ Kamel Koʼ Yabʼa Koj, Winaq Bʼam areʼ kʼut Ajawabʼ riʼ chuwach Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Areʼ uleʼel, utasel puch. Areʼ kʼut ubʼiʼ Ajawabʼ waʼ chupam Nim Ja: Xa Kajibʼ Nim Ja. Ajtzikʼ Winaq Ajaw ubʼiʼ nabʼe ajaw, jun unim ja. Lolmet Ajaw, ukabʼ ajaw, jun unim ja. Nim Chʼokoj Ajaw rox ajaw, jununim ja.

Jaqawitz kʼut ukaj ajaw, jununim ja. Chi kajibʼ kʼut nim jachuwach Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Areʼ kʼu ri e oxibʼ chi Nim Chʼokoj kejeʼ riʼ e kajawixel rumal ronojel Ajawabʼ Kʼicheʼ. Xa jun chikikuch wi kibʼ. E oxibʼ chik Chʼokojibʼ.

source: Popol Wuj, K'iche' version: Mondloch transcription with amendments by Vincent James Stanzione
body:
E alanel, e uchuch tzij, e uqajaw tzij, nim sqaqiʼn ukʼojeʼike oxibʼ chi Chʼokojibʼ: Nim Chʼokoj kʼut chuwach Kaweqibʼ, chuwach Nijaʼibʼ, ukabʼ kʼu ri. Nim Chʼokoj Ajaw chuwach Ajaw Kʼicheʼ; Rox Nim Chʼokoj chuwach Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Chi oxibʼ kʼut ri Chʼokojibʼ; jujun chiwach chinamit. X areʼ kʼut ukʼojeʼik Kʼicheʼ riʼ rumal ma jabʼi chi ilbʼal re. Kʼo nabʼe ojer kuma lajawabʼ, sachinaq chik.

Xere kʼu riʼ mi xutzinik chi ronojel Kʼicheʼ, Santa Cruz ubʼiʼ.

Kabʼlajuj Aj, 21 de Febrero, 2023   Utzibʼabʼal Popol Wuj

Santiago Atitlan, Ukʼuʼx Juyubʼ, Ukʼuʼx Taqʼaj, Ukʼuʼx Ulew
